# Welcome to Magical Farm
### @explicitHints true
## Start your farm

Your farm has work to do, and your defenders need programs of their own. You will build the code that responds to farm jobs and powers, then see what your current program makes happen in the world.

Move with the arrow keys. Face a station or character and press **A** to interact or choose a menu option. Press **B** to use your blade outside a menu, or go back while a menu is open. Use the arrow keys to move through menus. Play in fullscreen at **480 × 360** so the farm and its instructions fit on screen.

On your first visit, you start at the home hub. Use the greeting menu to choose your character and skin tone. Find the soil bed marked **1**, face it, and press **A** to reach **A1 — Starter Beds**. Arrows mark usable exits; stone closes routes to areas you have not earned yet. After a code edit or restart, you return directly to your saved area. You can change your appearance at the shop without losing earned progress.

At the hub, face the shop or armory door and press **A** to enter. Inside, walk up to a counter or weapon stand and press **A** to open its menu. Walk through the bottom doorway to return to the hub.

In A1, walk to the **Plant** and **Water** stations just below the Starter Beds. Face a station and press **A** to run its Plant or Water job. Open the first Recipe for the code that controls those jobs:

[Open R01](#recipe:https://github.com/mrbrackebusch-code/magical-farm/docs/tutorials/r01)

The **Next:** message names your next action and the Recipe to open when code is needed. Follow the blinking arrow above the work or practice pad, then face the pad and press **A** to run your current code.

#### ~ tutorialhint

```blocks
farm.onPlant(function (job) {
    for (let index = 0; index < farm.plantCount(job); index++) {
        farm.plantNext(job)
    }
})

farm.onWater(function (job) {
    for (let index = 0; index < farm.waterCount(job); index++) {
        farm.waterNext(job)
    }
})
```

## Recipe directory

Each Recipe continues in this same Magical Farm project. Your earned areas and upgrades are saved as world progress; your current program determines how each new task behaves. Recipes guide you through the code, while playing the game earns progress. You can buy upgrades at the hub; each purchase menu shows the named property and its current and next values. The hub also has a reset choice if you decide you want to start over.

- **A1 — Starter Beds: First Repeats:** [Open R01](#recipe:https://github.com/mrbrackebusch-code/magical-farm/docs/tutorials/r01)
- **A2 — Fence & Trellis: Repeat a Whole Sequence:** [Open R02](#recipe:https://github.com/mrbrackebusch-code/magical-farm/docs/tutorials/r02)
- **A2 — Six-Shooter: Counted Repeat Retrieval:** [Open R03](#recipe:https://github.com/mrbrackebusch-code/magical-farm/docs/tutorials/r03)
- **A3 — Berry Patch: Repeat a Work Cycle:** [Open R04](#recipe:https://github.com/mrbrackebusch-code/magical-farm/docs/tutorials/r04)
- **A4 — Bloom Forge: Change a Value Each Time:** [Open R05](#recipe:https://github.com/mrbrackebusch-code/magical-farm/docs/tutorials/r05)
- **A5 — Overgrown Field: Decide Inside a Repeat:** [Open R06](#recipe:https://github.com/mrbrackebusch-code/magical-farm/docs/tutorials/r06)
- **A5 — Rage Orchid: First While Loop:** [Open R07](#recipe:https://github.com/mrbrackebusch-code/magical-farm/docs/tutorials/r07)
- **A6 — Dry Terrace: Repeat While Resource Remains:** [Open R08](#recipe:https://github.com/mrbrackebusch-code/magical-farm/docs/tutorials/r08)
- **A6 — Prism Bloom: If/Else:** [Open R09](#recipe:https://github.com/mrbrackebusch-code/magical-farm/docs/tutorials/r09)
- **A7 — Orchard Lane: Use the Loop Index:** [Open R10](#recipe:https://github.com/mrbrackebusch-code/magical-farm/docs/tutorials/r10)
- **A8 — Animal Meadow: Inspect, Decide, and Reuse:** [Open R11](#recipe:https://github.com/mrbrackebusch-code/magical-farm/docs/tutorials/r11)
- **A9 — Greenhouse Grid: Loops Inside Loops:** [Open R12](#recipe:https://github.com/mrbrackebusch-code/magical-farm/docs/tutorials/r12)
- **A10 — Wash House: While + If/Else Synthesis:** [Open R13](#recipe:https://github.com/mrbrackebusch-code/magical-farm/docs/tutorials/r13)
- **A11 — Packing Barn: Nested Work and Seal:** [Open R14](#recipe:https://github.com/mrbrackebusch-code/magical-farm/docs/tutorials/r14)
- **A12 — Moon Grove: Full Farm Synthesis:** [Open R15](#recipe:https://github.com/mrbrackebusch-code/magical-farm/docs/tutorials/r15)
- **A12 — Stormbloom Projection: Final Synthesis:** [Open R16](#recipe:https://github.com/mrbrackebusch-code/magical-farm/docs/tutorials/r16)

// Frozen pure purchased-value table, generated from UPGRADE_RULES.json. No learner logic.
namespace farmTuning {
export function value(id: number, level: number): number {
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.Chambers) return (level == 1 ? 8 : 6)
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.TwinCycles) return (level == 1 ? 5 : 4)
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.TrapCount) return (level == 1 ? 6 : 5)
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.StartingDamage) return (level == 1 ? 2 : 1)
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.MarkedTargets) return (level == 1 ? 5 : 4)
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.Sunlight) return (level == 1 ? 8 : 6)
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.PulseLevels) return (level == 1 ? 6 : 5)
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.AllyCount) return (level == 1 ? 5 : 4)
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.Caps) return (level == 1 ? 4 : 3)
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.SporesPerCap) return (level == 1 ? 5 : 4)
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.Charge) return (level == 1 ? 8 : 6)
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.SnareReach) return (level == 1 ? 2 : 1)
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.Bulbs) return (level == 1 ? 4 : 3)
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.SparksPerBulb) return (level == 1 ? 4 : 3)
return 0
}
export function price(id: number): number {
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.Chambers) return 24
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.TwinCycles) return 32
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.TrapCount) return 40
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.StartingDamage) return 48
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.MarkedTargets) return 60
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.Sunlight) return 72
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.PulseLevels) return 88
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.AllyCount) return 104
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.Caps) return 60
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.SporesPerCap) return 60
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.Charge) return 140
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.SnareReach) return 160
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.Bulbs) return 100
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.SparksPerBulb) return 100
return 0
}
export function crop(id: number): number {
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.Chambers) return 1
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.TwinCycles) return 2
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.TrapCount) return 3

if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.SnareReach) return 11
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.Bulbs) return 12

}
export function label(id: number): string {
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.Chambers) return "chamber capacity"
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.TwinCycles) return "paired firing cycles"
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.TrapCount) return "prepared trap patches"

}
export function effect(id: number): string {
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.Chambers) return "More shots in each firing loop."
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.TwinCycles) return "More left/right pairs in each firing loop."
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.TrapCount) return "More move/drop repetitions and visible traps."
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.StartingDamage) return "The learner damage variable starts higher and still increases each strike."
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.MarkedTargets) return "Inspect and branch over more target slots."
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.Sunlight) return "More stored sunlight allows more beam/decrement iterations."
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.PulseLevels) return "One more indexed pulse with a larger final radius."
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.AllyCount) return "Inspect more allies and heal the damaged ones."
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.Caps) return "More outer-loop groups; spores per cap stays unchanged."
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.SporesPerCap) return "More inner-loop repetitions in every cap; cap count stays unchanged."
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.Charge) return "More one-unit transfers before the learner charge variable reaches zero."
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.SnareReach) return "A wider patch keeps valid enemies in the while condition for a longer route segment."
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.Bulbs) return "More outer-loop groups; sparks per bulb stays unchanged."
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.SparksPerBulb) return "More inner-loop repetitions per bulb; bulb count stays unchanged."
return ""
}
}

// frames/series and monster.* keys are cached immutable objects; copy before annotations.
namespace farmArt {
function diagnosticFrame(): Image {
let p = image.create(16, 16)
p.fill(2)
p.fillRect(1, 1, 14, 14, 15)
p.fillRect(2, 2, 12, 12, 1)
p.drawLine(2, 2, 13, 13, 2)
p.drawLine(13, 2, 2, 13, 2)
return p
}

function fresh(source: Image): Image {
let result = image.create(source.width, source.height)
result.drawTransparentImage(source, 0, 0)
return result
}

export function frame(key: string, frame: number): Image {
let monster = farmMonsterArt.series(key)
if (monster && frame >= 0 && frame < monster.length) return monster[frame]
let plant = farmPlantArt.series(key)
if (plant && frame >= 0 && frame < plant.length) return plant[frame]
if (frame < 0 || frame >= frameCount(key)) return diagnosticFrame()
return fresh(raw(key, frame))
}

export function frames(key: string): Image[] {
let monster = farmMonsterArt.series(key)
if (monster) return monster
let plant = farmPlantArt.series(key)
if (plant) return plant
let result: Image[] = []
let count = frameCount(key)
for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) result.push(frame(key, i))
if (count == 0) result.push(diagnosticFrame())
return result
}

export function series(key: string): Image[] {
if (key == "crop.lanternleaf.mature") return lanternleafFrames
if (key == "crop.lanternleaf.rooted") return lanternleafFrames
if (key == "crop.lanternleaf.attack") return lanternleafFrames
if (key == "crop.lanternleaf.seedling") return lanternleafseedlingFrames
if (key == "crop.lanternleaf.growing") return lanternleafgrowingFrames
if (key == "crop.lanternleaf.wilted") return lanternleafwiltedFrames
if (key == "crop.rootsnare.mature") return rootsnareFrames
if (key == "crop.rootsnare.rooted") return rootsnareFrames
if (key == "crop.rootsnare.attack") return rootsnareFrames
if (key == "crop.rootsnare.seedling") return rootsnareseedlingFrames
if (key == "crop.rootsnare.growing") return rootsnaregrowingFrames

export function frame(key: string, index: number): Image {
let list = series(key)
return list ? list[index % list.length] : null
}
export function place(sprite: Sprite, rootX: number, rootY: number): void {
// Ground pixel (32,61) stays at the authored tile center.
let foot = sprite.image.height == 32 ? 30 : sprite.image.height - 3
sprite.setPosition(rootX, rootY - (foot - sprite.image.height / 2))
sprite.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Ghost, true)
sprite.z = rootY
}
export function animate(sprite: Sprite, key: string, elapsed: number): void {
let list = series(key)
if (sprite && list) sprite.setImage(list[Math.idiv(elapsed, 260) % list.length])
}
}

const splitterchildFrames: Image[] = [splitterchildfront, splitterchildback]
export function series(key: string): Image[] {
if (key == "monster.nibbler.move" || key == "monster.nibbler.hit") return nibblerFrames
if (key == "monster.swarmbug.move" || key == "monster.swarmbug.hit") return swarmbugFrames
if (key == "monster.sprinter.move" || key == "monster.sprinter.hit") return sprinterFrames
if (key == "monster.regenslime.move" || key == "monster.regenslime.hit") return regenslimeFrames
if (key == "monster.shellback.move" || key == "monster.shellback.hit") return shellbackFrames
if (key == "monster.shieldling.move" || key == "monster.shieldling.hit") return shieldlingFrames
if (key == "monster.splitter.move" || key == "monster.splitter.hit") return splitterFrames
if (key == "monster.hexmoth.move" || key == "monster.hexmoth.hit") return hexmothFrames

// SUPPLIED SOURCE: world-view.ts
// World presentation only. Conserve usage: reuse cached native art/terrain.
// Layout remains the authority for dimensions, cells, walls and interaction.
namespace farmWorldView {
let terrainKeys: string[] = []
let terrainImages: Image[] = []
let walkingLayout: farmTypes.Layout = null
let walkingMask: Buffer = null
let routeLayout: farmTypes.Layout = null
let routeMask: Buffer = null

function cellMask(count: number, cells: number[]): Buffer {
let result = control.createBuffer(count)
for (let i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) if (cells[i] >= 0 && cells[i] < count) result.setUint8(cells[i], 1)
return result
}

export function enemyPathCells(layout: farmTypes.Layout): number[] {
let result: number[] = []
let excluded = cellMask(layout.ground.length, layout.cropTiles)
for (let i = 0; i < layout.taskTiles.length; i++) excluded.setUint8(layout.taskTiles[i], 1)
for (let i = 0; i < layout.defenderSlots.length; i++) excluded.setUint8(layout.defenderSlots[i].tile, 1)
let seen = control.createBuffer(layout.ground.length)
for (let i = 0; i < layout.routes.length; i++) for (let j = 0; j < layout.routes[i].tiles.length; j++) {
let tile = layout.routes[i].tiles[j]
if (tile < 0 || tile >= layout.ground.length || layout.walls[tile] || seen.getUint8(tile) || excluded.getUint8(tile)) continue
let ground = layout.ground[tile]
if (ground == 9 || ground == 12 || (ground >= 4 && ground <= 7)) continue
seen.setUint8(tile, 1)
result.push(tile)
}
return result
}

export function installPalette(): void {
image.setPalette(hex`000000ffffff ff4055c957ff c98b67ffe64a 50c14064d14c 799aff7ab5ff 88de5f94a2a3 4c3f38ebb97c 21e9ff000000`)
}

function material(layout: farmTypes.Layout, x: number, y: number): string {
if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= layout.width || y >= layout.height) return ""
let cell = y * layout.width + x
let ground = layout.ground[cell]
if (routeLayout != layout) { routeLayout = layout; routeMask = cellMask(layout.ground.length, enemyPathCells(layout)) }
if (routeMask.getUint8(cell) != 0) return "enemy.path"
// Existing source ground codes distinguish water and building floors.
// Every other exterior blocking cell is a boundary wall or inner fence.
if (layout.interior <= 0 && layout.walls[cell] && ground != 9 && ground != 8 && ground != 10 && ground != 11) {
return x == 0 || y == 0 || x == layout.width - 1 || y == layout.height - 1 ? "wall" : "fence"
}
if (ground == 12) return "fence"
if (ground == 2) {
if (walkingLayout != layout) { walkingLayout = layout; walkingMask = cellMask(layout.ground.length, farmLayout.walkingTiles(layout)) }
return walkingMask.getUint8(cell) != 0 ? "stone.path" : "path"
}
if (ground == 3) {
if (layout.interior > 0) return x == 0 || y == 0 || x == layout.width - 1 || y == layout.height - 1 ? "room.wall" : "room.counter"
return x == 0 || y == 0 || x == layout.width - 1 || y == layout.height - 1 ? "wall" : "fence"
}
if (ground == 4) return "soil"
if (ground == 5) return "soil.dry"
if (ground == 6) return "soil.wet"
if (ground == 7) return "soil.inactive"
if (ground == 8 || ground == 10 || ground == 11) return "floor"
if (ground == 9) return "water"
if (layout.walls[cell]) return x == 0 || y == 0 || x == layout.width - 1 || y == layout.height - 1 ? "wall" : "fence"
return "grass"
}

// Use the complete material centre. Atlas edge/corner pieces contain
// broad grass margins; composing them into one-cell paths/plots erases
// the visible material. Centre fills keep every authored cell readable.
function terrain(family: string, variant: number): Image {
let key = family + "." + variant
for (let i = 0; i < terrainKeys.length; i++) if (terrainKeys[i] == key) return terrainImages[i]
let result: Image = null
let floorBackground = variant >= 20
if (floorBackground) variant -= 20
if (family == "stone.path" || family == "enemy.path") {
result = farmWorldArt.tile(family, variant)
} else if ((family == "soil" || family.substr(0, 5) == "soil.") && variant == 9) {
// A single logical plot needs the whole rounded source bed, rather
// than the rectangular atlas centre. Sample its32px inner patch at
// exact2:1 scale, keeping one16px simulation cell and its foot centre.
result = image.create(16, 16)
for (let y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (let x = 0; x < 16; x++) {
let sx = 8 + x * 2
let sy = 8 + y * 2
let part = Math.floor(sy / 16) * 3 + Math.floor(sx / 16)
result.setPixel(x, y, farmWorldArt.tile(family, part).getPixel(sx % 16, sy % 16))
}
} else if (family == "room.wall") {
// Exact bare white/tan wall pane from the approved source house.
result = image.create(16, 16)
result.drawImage(farmWorldArt.object("house"), -8, -61)
} else if (family == "room.counter") {
// Source floor planks with a thin black/brown furniture rim only
// on the platform's outside edges. This cache is shared immutable.
result = farmWorldArt.tile("floor", 4).clone()
let row = Math.floor(variant / 3)
let col = variant % 3
if (row == 0) { result.fillRect(0, 0, 16, 1, 15); result.fillRect(1, 1, 14, 1, 12) }
if (row == 2) { result.fillRect(0, 15, 16, 1, 15); result.fillRect(1, 14, 14, 1, 12) }
if (col == 0) { result.fillRect(0, 0, 1, 16, 15); result.fillRect(1, 1, 1, 14, 12) }
if (col == 2) { result.fillRect(15, 0, 1, 16, 15); result.fillRect(14, 1, 1, 14, 12) }
} else if (family == "fence") {
result = farmWorldArt.object("fence." + variant)
} else result = farmWorldArt.tile(family, variant)
if (floorBackground) {
result = result.clone()
let floor = farmWorldArt.tile("floor", 4)
for (let y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (let x = 0; x < 16; x++) {
let c = result.getPixel(x, y)
if (c == 6 || c == 7 || c == 10) result.setPixel(x, y, floor.getPixel(x, y))
}
}
terrainKeys.push(key)
terrainImages.push(result)
return result
}

function soilFamily(family: string): boolean {
return family == "soil" || family.substr(0, 5) == "soil."
}

function sameBed(layout: farmTypes.Layout, family: string, x: number, y: number): boolean {
let neighbor = material(layout, x, y)
return soilFamily(family) ? soilFamily(neighbor) : neighbor == family
}

function variant(layout: farmTypes.Layout, family: string, x: number, y: number): number {
if (family == "grass" || family == "floor" || family == "cliff" || family == "wall" || family == "room.wall" || (family == "soil" && layout.area == 0)) return 4
let north = sameBed(layout, family, x, y - 1)
let south = sameBed(layout, family, x, y + 1)
let west = sameBed(layout, family, x - 1, y)
let east = sameBed(layout, family, x + 1, y)
if (family == "fence") return (north ? 1 : 0) + (east ? 2 : 0) + (south ? 4 : 0) + (west ? 8 : 0)
if (soilFamily(family) && !north && !south && !west && !east) return 9
// Soil states share one boundary. Dry/wet/inactive transitions never
// introduce false green edges in the middle of the same authored bed.
if ((!north && !south) || (!west && !east)) return 4
let row = !north ? 0 : (!south ? 2 : 1)
let col = !west ? 0 : (!east ? 2 : 1)
return row * 3 + col
}

export function blockedExitCells(layout: farmTypes.Layout, progress: farmTypes.Progress): number[] {
let result: number[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < layout.objects.length; i++) {
let o = layout.objects[i]
if (o.kind != farmTypes.ObjectKind.Exit || o.arg == 0 || progress.unlocked[o.arg]) continue
let corridor = farmLayout.exitCells(layout, o)
for (let j = 0; j < corridor.length; j++) if (result.indexOf(corridor[j]) < 0) result.push(corridor[j])
}
return result
}

export function render(layout: farmTypes.Layout, progress: farmTypes.Progress): void {
let count = layout.width * layout.height
let blocked = cellMask(count, blockedExitCells(layout, progress))
let data = control.createBuffer(4 + count)
data.setNumber(NumberFormat.UInt16LE, 0, layout.width)
data.setNumber(NumberFormat.UInt16LE, 2, layout.height)
let keys: string[] = []
let bank: Image[] = []
// Retain the dedicated physical barrier index; no legacy tile APIs.
for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
keys.push("")
bank.push(image.create(16, 16))
}
bank[14].drawTransparentImage(farmArt.frame("object.barrier.closed", 0), -8, -8)
for (let y = 0; y < layout.height; y++) {
for (let x = 0; x < layout.width; x++) {
let closed = blocked.getUint8(y * layout.width + x) != 0
let family = closed ? "wall" : material(layout, x, y)
let selected = closed ? 4 : variant(layout, family, x, y)
// Barn-floor defender beds inherit the surrounding source wood
// instead of stamping source grass into an indoor floor.
if (soilFamily(family) && (material(layout, x - 1, y) == "floor" || material(layout, x + 1, y) == "floor" ||
material(layout, x, y - 1) == "floor" || material(layout, x, y + 1) == "floor")) selected += 20
let key = family + "." + selected
let index = -1
for (let i = 16; i < keys.length; i++) if (keys[i] == key) index = i
if (index < 0) {
index = bank.length
keys.push(key)
bank.push(terrain(family, selected))
}
data.setUint8(4 + y * layout.width + x, index)
}
}
for (let i = 0; i < layout.objects.length; i++) {
let object = layout.objects[i]
if (object.kind != farmTypes.ObjectKind.Barrier || progress.unlocked[object.arg]) continue
let cell = Math.floor(object.y / 16) * layout.width + Math.floor(object.x / 16)
if (blocked.getUint8(cell) == 0) data.setUint8(4 + cell, 14)
}
tiles.setCurrentTilemap(tiles.createTilemap(data, image.create(layout.width, layout.height), bank, TileScale.Sixteen))
// Exact existing wall geometry, plus the same locked barrier cells.
for (let y = 0; y < layout.height; y++) {
for (let x = 0; x < layout.width; x++) if (layout.walls[y * layout.width + x] || blocked.getUint8(y * layout.width + x) != 0) tiles.setWallAt(tiles.getTileLocation(x, y), true)
}
for (let i = 0; i < layout.objects.length; i++) {
let object = layout.objects[i]
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Barrier && !progress.unlocked[object.arg]) tiles.setWallAt(tiles.getTileLocation(Math.floor(object.x / 16), Math.floor(object.y / 16)), true)
}
}

function clearDecoration(layout: farmTypes.Layout, x: number, y: number): boolean {
// Source decoration is noninteractive. Keep its silhouette away from
// authoritative routes, crops, controls and the player entry point.
for (let dy = -2; dy <= 1; dy++) {
for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
let xx = x + dx
let yy = y + dy
if (xx < 1 || yy < 1 || xx >= layout.width - 1 || yy >= layout.height - 1) return false
if (layout.ground[yy * layout.width + xx] != 1 || layout.walls[yy * layout.width + xx]) return false
}
}
if (Math.abs(layout.entry.x / 16 - x) < 4 && Math.abs(layout.entry.y / 16 - y) < 4) return false
for (let i = 0; i < layout.objects.length; i++) {
let object = layout.objects[i]
if (Math.abs(object.x / 16 - x) < 4 && Math.abs(object.y / 16 - y) < 4) return false
}
for (let i = 0; i < layout.routes.length; i++) {
let route = layout.routes[i]
for (let j = 0; j < route.tiles.length; j++) {
let tile = route.tiles[j]
if (Math.abs(tile % layout.width - x) < 4 && Math.abs(Math.idiv(tile, layout.width) - y) < 4) return false
}
}
return true
}

let padImages: Image[] = []
let guidance: Sprite = null
let guidanceImage: Image = null
let guidanceReadyImage: Image = null
let guidanceEdgeImages: Image[] = []
let guidanceReady = false
let guidanceLayout: farmTypes.Layout = null
let guidanceId = -1
let guidanceElapsed = 0
let guidanceActive = false
let guidanceTarget: farmTypes.WorldObject = null
let guidanceOffscreen = false
let guidanceDirection = 0

// Code-native symbols, cached once: sprout, water drop, raid shield,
// harvest fruit and work tool. No words or gameplay hitboxes in these pads.
export function actionPad(object: farmTypes.WorldObject): Image {
let type = object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.PracticePad ? 5 : object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Ready ? 2 : (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Harvest ? 3 :
(object.arg == farmTypes.Task.Plant ? 0 : (object.arg == farmTypes.Task.Water ? 1 : 4)))
if (padImages[type]) return padImages[type]
let pad = image.create(24, 24)
for (let y = 1; y < 23; y++) for (let x = 1; x < 23; x++) {
let dx = x - 12
let dy = y - 12
if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= 121) pad.setPixel(x, y, 15)
if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= 81) pad.setPixel(x, y, 11)
}
if (type == 0) {
pad.fillRect(11, 9, 2, 10, 12)
pad.fillRect(5, 7, 6, 4, 7)
pad.fillRect(13, 5, 6, 4, 10)
pad.drawLine(6, 8, 12, 13, 6)
pad.drawLine(17, 6, 12, 11, 6)
} else if (type == 1) {
for (let y = 5; y <= 18; y++) {
let radius = y < 12 ? Math.floor((y - 4) / 2) : (y < 17 ? 5 : 3)
pad.fillRect(12 - radius, y, radius * 2 + 1, 1, 9)
}
pad.fillRect(9, 12, 2, 4, 1)
} else if (type == 2) {
pad.fillRect(6, 5, 13, 9, 8)
for (let y = 14; y <= 19; y++) pad.fillRect(6 + y - 14, y, 13 - 2 * (y - 14), 1, 8)
pad.drawLine(8, 11, 11, 14, 1)
pad.drawLine(11, 14, 16, 8, 1)
} else if (type == 3) {
pad.fillRect(6, 9, 13, 8, 2)
pad.fillRect(8, 7, 9, 12, 2)
pad.fillRect(12, 4, 2, 4, 12)
pad.fillRect(14, 5, 5, 3, 7)
pad.fillRect(8, 10, 2, 4, 1)
} else if (type == 5) {
pad.drawLine(12, 4, 12, 20, 5)
pad.drawLine(4, 12, 20, 12, 5)
pad.drawLine(6, 6, 18, 18, 3)
pad.drawLine(6, 18, 18, 6, 3)
pad.fillRect(10, 10, 5, 5, 1)
} else {
pad.drawLine(7, 18, 16, 7, 12)
pad.drawLine(8, 18, 17, 7, 12)
pad.fillRect(11, 5, 9, 4, 1)
pad.fillRect(11, 8, 9, 2, 12)
}
padImages[type] = pad
return pad
}

export function soilPlot(): Image {
return terrain("soil.dry", 9)
}

export function nextAction(layout: farmTypes.Layout, kind: number, targetObjectId: number): void {
if (guidanceLayout == layout && guidanceId == targetObjectId) return
guidanceLayout = layout
guidanceId = targetObjectId
guidanceActive = false
guidanceReady = false
guidanceElapsed = 0
let target: farmTypes.WorldObject = null
if (layout && targetObjectId > 0) for (let i = 0; i < layout.objects.length; i++) {
if (layout.objects[i].id == targetObjectId) target = layout.objects[i]
}
if (!target) {
guidanceTarget = null
if (guidance) guidance.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Invisible, true)
return
}
if (!guidanceImage) {
guidanceImage = image.create(20, 14)
guidanceImage.fillRect(7, 0, 6, 7, 15)
guidanceImage.fillRect(8, 0, 4, 7, 5)
for (let y = 5; y < 14; y++) {
let width = (14 - y) * 2
guidanceImage.fillRect(10 - width / 2, y, width, 1, 15)
if (width > 4) guidanceImage.fillRect(12 - width / 2, y, width - 4, 1, 5)
}
}
if (!guidanceReadyImage) {
guidanceReadyImage = image.create(20, 24)
guidanceReadyImage.drawTransparentImage(guidanceImage, 0, 0)
for (let y = 0; y < 14; y++) for (let x = 0; x < 20; x++) {
if (guidanceReadyImage.getPixel(x, y) == 5) guidanceReadyImage.setPixel(x, y, 14)
}
guidanceReadyImage.fillRect(4, 13, 12, 11, 15)
guidanceReadyImage.fillRect(5, 14, 10, 9, 14)
guidanceReadyImage.print("A", 7, 14, 15, image.font8)
}
if (!guidance) {
// Bake the eight bearings once; movement allocates no images.
for (let direction = 0; direction < 8; direction++) edgeArrow(direction)
guidance = sprites.create(guidanceImage, kind)
guidance.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Ghost, true)
guidance.setFlag(SpriteFlag.RelativeToCamera, true)
guidance.z = 19000
}
guidanceTarget = target
guidance.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Invisible, false)
guidanceActive = true
positionGuidance()
}

function edgeArrow(direction: number): Image {
if (guidanceEdgeImages[direction]) return guidanceEdgeImages[direction]
let arrow = image.create(24, 24)
let angle = direction * Math.PI / 4
let cos = Math.cos(angle)
let sin = Math.sin(angle)
for (let y = 0; y < 14; y++) for (let x = 0; x < 20; x++) {
let color = guidanceImage.getPixel(x, y)
if (!color) continue
let dx = x - 9.5
let dy = y - 6.5
arrow.setPixel(Math.round(11.5 + dx * cos + dy * sin), Math.round(11.5 + dy * cos - dx * sin), color)
}
guidanceEdgeImages[direction] = arrow
return arrow
}

function positionGuidance(): void {
if (!guidance || !guidanceActive || !guidanceTarget) return
// Native camera limits at map edges mean player-centered estimates drift.
// Project the actual authored target through the current Arcade camera.
let x = guidanceTarget.x - scene.cameraProperty(CameraProperty.Left)
let y = guidanceTarget.y - scene.cameraProperty(CameraProperty.Top)
let left = 14
let right = screen.width - 14
let top = farmHud.topInset() + 16
let bottom = screen.height - 16
guidanceOffscreen = x < left || x > right || y < top || y > bottom
if (!guidanceOffscreen) {
guidance.setImage(guidanceReady ? guidanceReadyImage : guidanceImage)
guidance.setPosition(Math.max(left, Math.min(right, x)), Math.max(top, y - 26))
return
}
let centerX = (left + right) / 2
let centerY = (top + bottom) / 2
let dx = x - centerX
let dy = y - centerY
let scaleX = dx == 0 ? 10000 : (right - left) / 2 / Math.abs(dx)
let scaleY = dy == 0 ? 10000 : (bottom - top) / 2 / Math.abs(dy)
let scale = Math.min(scaleX, scaleY)
if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy) * 2) guidanceDirection = dx > 0 ? 2 : 6
else if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) * 2) guidanceDirection = dy > 0 ? 0 : 4
else guidanceDirection = dy > 0 ? (dx > 0 ? 1 : 7) : (dx > 0 ? 3 : 5)
guidance.setImage(edgeArrow(guidanceDirection))
guidance.setPosition(centerX + dx * scale, centerY + dy * scale)
}

// Root supplies the actual nearest-facing interaction eligibility. Color
// never substitutes for its range/facing/handler guards.
export function nextActionReady(ready: boolean): void {
if (!guidance || !guidanceActive || guidanceReady == ready) return
guidanceReady = ready
guidanceElapsed = 0
positionGuidance()
guidance.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Invisible, false)
}

// Parent invokes this from its one existing update path. dt only; no new
// timers, controller callbacks, images or sprites are allocated here.
export function pulse(dtMs: number): void {
if (!guidance || !guidanceActive) return
positionGuidance()
if (guidanceReady || guidanceOffscreen) {
guidance.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Invisible, false)
return
}
guidanceElapsed = (guidanceElapsed + dtMs) % 800
guidance.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Invisible, guidanceElapsed >= 560)
}

function labelSprite(label: string, x: number, y: number, kind: number): Sprite {
let sign = image.create(label.length * 6 + 4, 12)
sign.fill(1)
sign.print(label, 2, 2, 15, image.font8)
let sprite = sprites.create(sign, kind)
sprite.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Ghost, true)
sprite.setPosition(x, y)
sprite.z = 6
return sprite
}

export function decorations(layout: farmTypes.Layout, kind: number, progress: farmTypes.Progress = null): Sprite[] {
let result: Sprite[] = []
if (layout.interior > 0) {
let title = layout.interior == 1 ? "FARM SHOP" : "ARMORY"
result.push(labelSprite(title, 328, 64, kind))
for (let i = 0; i < layout.objects.length; i++) {
let o = layout.objects[i]
if (o.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Exit) continue
let cx = o.x
// The native source-plank platform is the shop counter.
// Armory racks retain the approved source mesh above the wood.
if (layout.interior == 2) {
let furniture = sprites.create(farmWorldArt.object("window.mesh"), kind)
furniture.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Ghost, true)
furniture.setPosition(cx, 168)
furniture.z = 3
result.push(furniture)
}
let label = ""
if (layout.interior == 1) {
label = o.arg == 0 ? "EXPAND PLOTS" : (o.arg == 1 ? "PLANT UPGRADES" : "APPEARANCE")
} else {
let key = o.arg == 0 ? "weapon.gardenblade" : (o.arg == 1 ? "weapon.longheavy" : "weapon.shortquick")
let weapon = sprites.create(farmArt.frame(key, 0), kind)
weapon.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Ghost, true)
weapon.setPosition(cx, 168)
weapon.z = 5
result.push(weapon)
label = o.arg == 0 ? "GARDEN BLADE" : (o.arg == 1 ? "LONG HEAVY" : "SHORT QUICK")
}
result.push(labelSprite(label, cx, 240, kind))
}
let glass = sprites.create(farmWorldArt.object("window.glass"), kind)
glass.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Ghost, true)
glass.setPosition(328, 104)
glass.z = 3
result.push(glass)
result.push(labelSprite("EXIT", 328, 424, kind))
return result
}
for (let i = 0; i < layout.objects.length; i++) {
let o = layout.objects[i]
let harvest = o.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Harvest
&& progress && progress.phase[layout.area] == farmTypes.Phase.Production
&& o.arg <= farmWorld.plotCapacity(layout.area)
if (o.kind != farmTypes.ObjectKind.TaskStation && o.kind != farmTypes.ObjectKind.Ready && o.kind != farmTypes.ObjectKind.PracticePad && !harvest) continue
let pad = sprites.create(actionPad(o), kind)
pad.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Ghost, true)
pad.setPosition(o.x, o.y)
pad.z = 7
result.push(pad)
}
// Direction signs identify only usable authored perimeter exits.
for (let i = 0; i < layout.objects.length; i++) {
let o = layout.objects[i]
if (o.kind != farmTypes.ObjectKind.Exit || (o.arg > 0 && (!progress || !progress.unlocked[o.arg]))) continue
let cx = Math.floor(o.x / 16)
let cy = Math.floor(o.y / 16)
let label = cx == 0 ? "< EXIT" : (cx == layout.width - 1 ? "EXIT >" : (cy == 0 ? "^ EXIT" : "EXIT v"))
let px = o.x + (cx == 0 ? 56 : (cx == layout.width - 1 ? -56 : 0))
let py = o.y + (cy == 0 ? 56 : (cy == layout.height - 1 ? -56 : 0))
result.push(labelSprite(label, px, py, kind))
}
// Text signs are presentation only, tied to the unchanged interaction
// IDs. Their Ghost sprites do not supply any wall or gameplay behavior.
if (layout.area == 0) {
for (let i = 0; i < layout.objects.length; i++) {
let object = layout.objects[i]
let label = ""
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Travel) label = "" + object.arg
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Shop) label = "SHOP / UPGRADES"
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Armory) label = "ARMORY"
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.SellBox) label = "SELL HARVEST"
if (!label) continue
let sign = image.create(label.length * 6 + 4, 12)
sign.fill(1)
sign.print(label, 2, 2, 15, image.font8)
let sprite = sprites.create(sign, kind)
sprite.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Ghost, true)
sprite.setPosition(object.x, object.y + (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Travel ? 0 : 20))
sprite.z = 6
result.push(sprite)
}

}
for (let y = 3; y < layout.height - 3; y += 5) {
for (let x = 3; x < layout.width - 3; x += 6) {
if (!clearDecoration(layout, x, y) || result.length >= (layout.area == 0 ? 34 : 18)) continue
let key = (x + y + layout.area) % 3 == 0 ? "rock1" : "tree"
let art = farmWorldArt.object(key)
let sprite = sprites.create(art, kind)
sprite.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Ghost, true)
sprite.setPosition(x * 16 + 8, (y + 1) * 16 - art.height / 2)
sprite.z = 0
result.push(sprite)
}
}
return result
}
}

namespace farmUiTheme {

004444444444444444444400
`
export const font = image.scaledFont(image.font8, 2)
export const maxWidth = 440
// Frame inset16 + menu padding8 + item padding12 + native scrollbar8.
export const textColumns = Math.floor((maxWidth - 44) / font.charWidth)

export function applyFont(item: miniMenu.MenuItem, small: boolean = false): void {
item._font = small ? image.font8 : font
item._isDirty = true
}

export function create(inert: boolean = false): miniMenu.MenuSprite {
let surface = new miniMenu.MenuSprite()
surface.setButtonEventsEnabled(false)
surface.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Ghost, true)
surface.setFlag(SpriteFlag.RelativeToCamera, true)
surface.menuStyle.columns = 1
surface.menuStyle.rows = 0
surface.menuStyle.disabledItemsSelectable = false
surface.menuStyle.backgroundColor = 12
surface.menuStyle.borderColor = 0
surface.menuStyle.border = 0
surface.menuStyle.padding = miniMenu.createBorderBox(4, 4, 4, 4)
surface.menuStyle.scrollColor = inert ? 0 : 13
surface.setFrame(FRAME)
surface.setStyleProperty(miniMenu.StyleKind.All, miniMenu.StyleProperty.Foreground, 1)
surface.setStyleProperty(miniMenu.StyleKind.All, miniMenu.StyleProperty.Background, 12)
surface.setStyleProperty(miniMenu.StyleKind.All, miniMenu.StyleProperty.Border, 0)
surface.setStyleProperty(miniMenu.StyleKind.All, miniMenu.StyleProperty.Margin, 0)
surface.setStyleProperty(miniMenu.StyleKind.All, miniMenu.StyleProperty.Padding, miniMenu.createBorderBox(6, 2, 6, 2))
surface.setStyleProperty(miniMenu.StyleKind.All, miniMenu.StyleProperty.IconTextSpacing, 8)
surface.setStyleProperty(miniMenu.StyleKind.Selected, miniMenu.StyleProperty.Background, inert ? 12 : 13)
surface.setStyleProperty(miniMenu.StyleKind.Selected, miniMenu.StyleProperty.Foreground, inert ? 1 : 12)
surface.setStyleProperty(miniMenu.StyleKind.Title, miniMenu.StyleProperty.Foreground, 13)
surface.setStyleProperty(miniMenu.StyleKind.Title, miniMenu.StyleProperty.Alignment, miniMenu.Alignment.Center)
surface.setStyleProperty(miniMenu.StyleKind.Title, miniMenu.StyleProperty.Padding, miniMenu.createBorderBox(6, 2, 6, 6))
return surface
}

// Readable single-column contents. Native getHeight/getWidth omit the title;
// include it explicitly before imposing viewport limits and centering.
export function naturalHeight(surface: miniMenu.MenuSprite): number {
let height = 24
if (surface.title) height += surface.title.getHeight(surface.titleStyle)
for (let i = 0; i < surface.items.length; i++) {
let style = surface.items[i].isDisabled() ? surface.disabledStyle : surface.defaultStyle
height += surface.items[i].getHeight(style)
}
return height
}

export function fit(surface: miniMenu.MenuSprite, limitHeight: number = 336): void {
let width = surface.title ? surface.title.getWidth(surface.titleStyle) : 0
for (let i = 0; i < surface.items.length; i++) {
let style = surface.items[i].isDisabled() ? surface.disabledStyle : surface.defaultStyle
width = Math.max(width, surface.items[i].getWidth(style))
}
width += 24 + (surface.menuStyle.scrollColor ? 8 : 0)
surface.setDimensions(Math.min(maxWidth, width), Math.min(limitHeight, naturalHeight(surface)))
surface.setPosition(screen.width / 2, screen.height / 2)
}

export function wrap(text: string, columns: number): string[] {
let lines: string[] = []
if (!text) return lines
let rest = text
while (rest.length > columns) {
let cut = columns
while (cut > 0 && rest.charAt(cut) != " ") cut--
if (cut == 0) cut = columns
lines.push(rest.substr(0, cut))
rest = rest.substr(cut)
while (rest.length && rest.charAt(0) == " ") rest = rest.substr(1)
}
if (rest.length) lines.push(rest)
return lines
}
}

// SUPPLIED SOURCE: hud.ts
// Conserve usage: reuse the shared stock frame, text and measured layout.
// Presentation only: World owns gold, controller events, timers and saves.
namespace farmHud {
let surface: miniMenu.MenuSprite = null
let rows: miniMenu.MenuItem[] = []
let lastGold = -1
let lastNext = ""
let noticeSurface: miniMenu.MenuSprite = null
let lastNotice = ""

export function start(): void {
if (surface) return
surface = farmUiTheme.create(true)
surface.z = 20000
// Top-edge text uses the native8px font and compact vertical padding.
surface.setStyleProperty(miniMenu.StyleKind.All, miniMenu.StyleProperty.Padding, miniMenu.createBorderBox(6, 1, 6, 1))
rows.push(miniMenu.createMenuItem(" ", null, true))
farmUiTheme.applyFont(rows[0], true)
surface.setMenuItems(rows)
positionHud()
surface.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Invisible, true)
}

function positionHud(): void {
// Include all wrapped guidance; stable values do not resize each frame.
let height = farmUiTheme.naturalHeight(surface)
surface.setDimensions(screen.width, height)
surface.setPosition(screen.width / 2, height / 2)
}

// Keep map guidance below the actual wrapped stock HUD, not a guessed box.
export function topInset(): number {
return surface ? surface.height : 0
}

function text(row: number, value: string): void {
rows[row].setText(value.length ? value : " ")
farmUiTheme.applyFont(rows[row], true)
}

export function update(gold: number, next: string, visible: boolean): void {
if (!surface) start()
surface.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Invisible, !visible)
if (lastGold != gold) {
lastGold = gold
text(0, "GOLD " + gold)
}
if (lastNext != next) {
lastNext = next
// Only changed guidance rebuilds these cached rows. No truncation.
let lines = farmUiTheme.wrap(next.length ? "Next: " + next : "", Math.floor((screen.width - 36) / image.font8.charWidth))
let updated: miniMenu.MenuItem[] = [rows[0]]
for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
let row = miniMenu.createMenuItem(lines[i], null, true)
farmUiTheme.applyFont(row, true)
updated.push(row)
}
rows = updated
surface.setMenuItems(rows)
positionHud()
}
}

// World supplies visibility/expiry. Cached notice rows and frame are reused
// while the message is unchanged, including every ordinary update frame.
export function notice(message: string, visible: boolean): void {
if (!noticeSurface && !message) return
if (!noticeSurface) {
noticeSurface = farmUiTheme.create(true)
noticeSurface.z = 20001
}
if (message && message != lastNotice) {
lastNotice = message
let lines = farmUiTheme.wrap(message, Math.floor((farmUiTheme.maxWidth - 36) / image.font8.charWidth))
let items: miniMenu.MenuItem[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
let row = miniMenu.createMenuItem(lines[i], null, true)
farmUiTheme.applyFont(row, true)
items.push(row)
}
noticeSurface.setMenuItems(items)
farmUiTheme.fit(noticeSurface)
noticeSurface.setPosition(screen.width / 2, screen.height - noticeSurface.height / 2 - 12)
}
noticeSurface.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Invisible, !visible)
}
}

let loaded = false
let hasSaved = false
let chosenCharacter = 0
let chosenTone = 0
let portraits: Image[] = []
let frames: Image[] = []
let logicalSprite: Sprite = null
let visualSprite: Sprite = null
let shownImage: Image = null
let direction = 0
let elapsed = 0
const visualKind = SpriteKind.create()

export function characterCount(): number { return names.length }
export function characterName(id: number): string {
return validCharacter(id) ? names[id] : ""
}
export function toneCount(): number { return 3 }
export function toneName(id: number): string {
if (id == 0) return "Warm tan"
if (id == 1) return "Warm brown"
if (id == 2) return "Deep brown"
return ""
}
function integer(value: number): boolean {
return value == value && value == Math.floor(value) && Math.abs(value) <= 9007199254740991
}
function validCharacter(id: number): boolean { return integer(id) && id >= 0 && id < names.length }
function validTone(id: number): boolean { return integer(id) && id >= 0 && id < 3 }
function ensureLoaded(): void {
if (loaded) return
loaded = true
if (!settings.exists(KEY)) return
const stored = settings.readNumberArray(KEY)
if (!stored || stored.length != 3 || !integer(stored[0]) || stored[0] != 1 || !validCharacter(stored[1]) || !validTone(stored[2])) return
chosenCharacter = stored[1]
chosenTone = stored[2]
hasSaved = true
}
export function saved(): boolean { ensureLoaded(); return hasSaved }
export function character(): number { ensureLoaded(); return chosenCharacter }
export function tone(): number { ensureLoaded(); return chosenTone }
function skinColor(toneId: number, role: number): number {
if (toneId == 0) return role == 3 ? 4 : 13
if (toneId == 1) return role == 1 ? 13 : (role == 2 ? 4 : 12)
return role == 1 ? 4 : 12
}
function createFrame(characterId: number, toneId: number, index: number): Image {
const result = image.create(32, 40)
const sheet = sheets[characterId]
const mask = masks[characterId]
const sx = (index % 4) * 16
const sy = Math.idiv(index, 4) * 20
for (let y = 0; y < 20; y++) {
for (let x = 0; x < 16; x++) {
const role = mask.getPixel(sx + x, sy + y)
const color = role == 0 ? sheet.getPixel(sx + x, sy + y) : skinColor(toneId, role)
result.fillRect(x * 2, y * 2, 2, 2, color)
}
}
return result
}
export function portrait(characterId: number, toneId: number): Image {
if (!validCharacter(characterId) || !validTone(toneId)) return null
const slot = characterId * 3 + toneId
while (portraits.length <= slot) portraits.push(null)
if (!portraits[slot]) portraits[slot] = createFrame(characterId, toneId, 0)
return portraits[slot]
}
function frame(index: number): Image {
while (frames.length <= index) frames.push(null)
if (!frames[index]) frames[index] = createFrame(chosenCharacter, chosenTone, index)
return frames[index]
}
function clearFrames(): void {
frames = []
shownImage = null
direction = 0
elapsed = 0
}
export function select(characterId: number, toneId: number): void {
if (!validCharacter(characterId) || !validTone(toneId)) return
ensureLoaded()
if (chosenCharacter != characterId || chosenTone != toneId) {
chosenCharacter = characterId
chosenTone = toneId
clearFrames()
}
settings.writeNumberArray(KEY, [1, characterId, toneId])
hasSaved = true
if (logicalSprite) update(0)
}
export function reset(): void {
settings.remove(KEY)
loaded = true
hasSaved = false
chosenCharacter = 0
chosenTone = 0
clearFrames()
if (logicalSprite) update(0)
}
let attackCueMs = 0
let attackCueX = 0
let attackCueY = 0
export function attackCue(facingX: number, facingY: number): void {
attackCueMs = 120
attackCueX = facingX
attackCueY = facingY
}
export function face(x: number, y: number): void {
direction = x < 0 ? 2 : x > 0 ? 3 : y < 0 ? 1 : 0
elapsed = 0
}
export function attach(logical: Sprite): void {
if (!logical) return
ensureLoaded()
logicalSprite = logical
logical.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Invisible, true)
if (!visualSprite) {
shownImage = frame(0)
visualSprite = sprites.create(shownImage, visualKind)
visualSprite.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Ghost, true)
visualSprite.setFlag(SpriteFlag.AutoDestroy, false)
visualSprite.z = 10000
}
update(0)
}
export function update(dtMs: number): void {
if (!logicalSprite || !visualSprite) return
const vx = logicalSprite.vx
const vy = logicalSprite.vy
const moving = vx != 0 || vy != 0
let nextDirection = direction
if (moving) {
if (Math.abs(vx) >= Math.abs(vy)) nextDirection = vx < 0 ? 2 : 3
else nextDirection = vy < 0 ? 1 : 0
if (nextDirection != direction) elapsed = 0
direction = nextDirection
if (dtMs == dtMs && dtMs > 0) elapsed = (elapsed + Math.min(dtMs, 1000)) % 640
} else elapsed = 0
const next = frame(direction * 4 + (moving ? Math.idiv(elapsed, 160) : 0))
if (next != shownImage) {
visualSprite.setImage(next)
shownImage = next
}
attackCueMs = Math.max(0, attackCueMs - Math.max(0, dtMs))
const twitch = attackCueMs > 60 ? 4 : attackCueMs > 0 ? -1 : 0
visualSprite.x = logicalSprite.x + attackCueX * twitch
visualSprite.bottom = logicalSprite.y + 12 + attackCueY * twitch
visualSprite.z = 10000
}
}

namespace farmLayout {
function point(x: number, y: number): farmTypes.Point {
let p = new farmTypes.Point()
p.x = x; p.y = y
return p
}

function worldObject(id: number, kind: number, x: number, y: number, arg: number, arg2: number): farmTypes.WorldObject {
let o = new farmTypes.WorldObject()
o.id = id; o.kind = kind; o.x = x; o.y = y; o.arg = arg; o.arg2 = arg2
return o
}

function slot(id: number, tile: number, rangeTiles: number[], neighbors: number[]): farmTypes.Slot {
let s = new farmTypes.Slot()
s.id = id; s.tile = tile; s.rangeTiles = rangeTiles; s.neighbors = neighbors
return s
}

function route(id: number, tiles: number[], cropPriority: number[]): farmTypes.Route {
let r = new farmTypes.Route()
r.id = id; r.tiles = tiles; r.cropPriority = cropPriority
return r
}

function mask(slotId: number, kind: number, radius: number, tiles: number[]): farmTypes.Mask {
let m = new farmTypes.Mask()
m.slot = slotId; m.kind = kind; m.radius = radius; m.tiles = tiles
return m
}

function diagnosticLayout(area: number): farmTypes.Layout {
let l = new farmTypes.Layout()
l.area = area; l.width = 1; l.height = 1; l.entry = point(8, 8)
l.ground = [3]; l.walls = [1]; l.objects = []; l.cropTiles = []; l.defenderSlots = []; l.routes = []; l.masks = []
return l
}

function authored(area: number): farmTypes.Layout {
if (area == 0) return area0()
if (area == 1) return area1()
if (area == 2) return area2()
if (area == 3) return area3()
if (area == 4) return area4()
if (area == 5) return area5()
if (area == 6) return area6()
if (area == 7) return area7()
if (area == 8) return area8()
if (area == 9) return area9()
if (area == 10) return area10()
if (area == 11) return area11()
if (area == 12) return area12()
return diagnosticLayout(area)
}

// Owner-authorized world revision. Keep generated IDs, crop slots, routes,
// masks and object contracts; apply the landscape to each fresh layout.
// Conserve usage: this runs once per region load, never per update.
function protect(layout: farmTypes.Layout, safe: number[], x: number, y: number, radius: number): void {
for (let dy = -radius; dy <= radius; dy++) {
for (let dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++) {
let xx = x + dx
let yy = y + dy
if (xx >= 0 && yy >= 0 && xx < layout.width && yy < layout.height) safe[yy * layout.width + xx] = 1
}
}
}

function connect(layout: farmTypes.Layout, safe: number[], target: number): void {
let start = Math.floor(layout.entry.y / 16) * layout.width + Math.floor(layout.entry.x / 16)
let previous: number[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < layout.ground.length; i++) previous.push(-1)
let queue = [start]
previous[start] = start
let head = 0
while (head < queue.length && previous[target] < 0) {
let cell = queue[head++]
let x = cell % layout.width
let y = Math.floor(cell / layout.width)
let neighbors = [x > 0 ? cell - 1 : -1, x < layout.width - 1 ? cell + 1 : -1,
y > 0 ? cell - layout.width : -1, y < layout.height - 1 ? cell + layout.width : -1]
for (let i = 0; i < neighbors.length; i++) {
let next = neighbors[i]
if (next < 0 || previous[next] >= 0 || layout.walls[next]) continue
previous[next] = cell
queue.push(next)
}
}
if (previous[target] < 0) return
let cell = target
while (true) {
let x = cell % layout.width
let y = Math.floor(cell / layout.width)
protect(layout, safe, x, y, 1)
for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
let xx = x + dx
let yy = y + dy
if (xx < 0 || yy < 0 || xx >= layout.width || yy >= layout.height) continue
let at = yy * layout.width + xx
if (!layout.walls[at] && (layout.ground[at] == 1 || layout.area == 0)) layout.ground[at] = 2
}
}
if (cell == start) break
cell = previous[cell]
}
}

// The Hub is a junction: each physical branch leaves on the opposite edge
// of the destination's authored return gate. Farm geometry is never rotated,
// so crop order, route sequences and directional masks retain their meaning.
function arrangeHubConnections(layout: farmTypes.Layout): void {
if (layout.area != 0) return
for (let i = 0; i < layout.objects.length; i++) {
let o = layout.objects[i]
if (o.kind != farmTypes.ObjectKind.Exit && o.kind != farmTypes.ObjectKind.Barrier) continue
let area = o.arg
let edge = 0
let along = 0
if (area == 2) { edge = 1; along = 10 }
if (area == 10) { edge = 1; along = 22 }
if (area == 11) { edge = 1; along = 34 }
if (area == 3) { edge = 2; along = 7 }
if (area == 4) { edge = 2; along = 14 }
if (area == 5) { edge = 2; along = 21 }
if (area == 8) { edge = 2; along = 28 }
if (area == 9) { edge = 2; along = 35 }
if (area == 12) { edge = 2; along = 42 }
if (area == 1) { edge = 3; along = 10 }
if (area == 6) { edge = 3; along = 22 }
if (area == 7) { edge = 3; along = 34 }
if (!edge) continue
let inward = o.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Barrier ? 3 : 0
if (edge == 1) { o.x = inward * 16 + 8; o.y = along * 16 + 8 }
if (edge == 2) { o.x = along * 16 + 8; o.y = inward * 16 + 8 }
if (edge == 3) { o.x = (layout.width - 1 - inward) * 16 + 8; o.y = along * 16 + 8 }
}
}

function landscape(layout: farmTypes.Layout): farmTypes.Layout {
if (layout.area < 0 || layout.area > 12) return layout
arrangeHubConnections(layout)
let safe: number[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < layout.ground.length; i++) safe.push(0)
if (layout.area == 0) {
// Separate the armory frontage from the house/shop silhouette.
for (let i = 0; i < layout.objects.length; i++) {
if (layout.objects[i].kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Armory) layout.objects[i].x = 38 * 16 + 8
if (layout.objects[i].kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.SellBox) layout.objects[i].x = 15 * 16 + 8
}
// Replace the former vast blank floor plaza with a path network.
for (let i = 0; i < layout.ground.length; i++) if (!layout.walls[i]) layout.ground[i] = 1
}
protect(layout, safe, Math.floor(layout.entry.x / 16), Math.floor(layout.entry.y / 16), 2)
for (let i = 0; i < layout.cropTiles.length; i++) {
let tile = layout.cropTiles[i]
protect(layout, safe, tile % layout.width, Math.floor(tile / layout.width), 2)
}
for (let i = 0; i < layout.defenderSlots.length; i++) {
let tile = layout.defenderSlots[i].tile
protect(layout, safe, tile % layout.width, Math.floor(tile / layout.width), 2)
}
for (let i = 0; i < layout.routes.length; i++) {
for (let j = 0; j < layout.routes[i].tiles.length; j++) {
let tile = layout.routes[i].tiles[j]
protect(layout, safe, tile % layout.width, Math.floor(tile / layout.width), 1)
}
}
for (let i = 0; i < layout.objects.length; i++) {
let o = layout.objects[i]
let x = Math.floor(o.x / 16)
let y = Math.floor(o.y / 16)
protect(layout, safe, x, y, o.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Exit ? 2 : 1)
connect(layout, safe, y * layout.width + x)
}
// Build gate membership once; do not allocate/re-search every Exit's
// corridor for every perimeter tile during a restart.
let gateCells: number[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < layout.ground.length; i++) gateCells.push(0)
for (let i = 0; i < layout.objects.length; i++) {
if (layout.objects[i].kind != farmTypes.ObjectKind.Exit) continue
let corridor = exitCells(layout, layout.objects[i])
for (let j = 0; j < corridor.length; j++) gateCells[corridor[j]] = 1
}
for (let y = 0; y < layout.height; y++) {
for (let x = 0; x < layout.width; x++) {
let cell = y * layout.width + x
// Only authored Exit corridors may interrupt the outer stone wall.
if (x == 0 || y == 0 || x == layout.width - 1 || y == layout.height - 1) {
let gate = gateCells[cell] == 1
layout.walls[cell] = gate ? 0 : 1
layout.ground[cell] = gate ? 2 : 3
}
// Existing water becomes a real wall only away from all active
// crop/task/defender/route access. Protected water is a crossing.
if (layout.ground[cell] == 9) {
if (!safe[cell]) layout.walls[cell] = 1
else { layout.ground[cell] = 2; layout.walls[cell] = 0 }
}
}
}
if (layout.area == 0) {
// Source soil beds remain flat and traversable; paths between beds
// retain one-cell gaps and the original travel interaction anchors.
for (let i = 0; i < layout.objects.length; i++) {
let o = layout.objects[i]
if (o.kind != farmTypes.ObjectKind.Travel) continue
let cx = Math.floor(o.x / 16)
let cy = Math.floor(o.y / 16)
for (let y = cy - 1; y <= cy; y++) for (let x = cx - 1; x <= cx + 1; x++) {
layout.ground[y * layout.width + x] = 4
}
}
// Native footprints beneath each building; front interaction cells
// remain walkable. Sprites are visual only, never collision owners.
for (let i = 0; i < layout.objects.length; i++) {
let o = layout.objects[i]
if (o.kind != farmTypes.ObjectKind.Shop && o.kind != farmTypes.ObjectKind.Armory) continue
let cx = Math.floor(o.x / 16)
let cy = Math.floor(o.y / 16)
for (let y = cy - 4; y < cy; y++) {
for (let x = cx - 4; x <= cx + 4; x++) {
layout.ground[y * layout.width + x] = 8
layout.walls[y * layout.width + x] = 1
}
}
}
for (let y = 17; y <= 21; y++) {
for (let x = 8; x <= 13; x++) {
let cell = y * layout.width + x
if (!safe[cell]) { layout.ground[cell] = 9; layout.walls[cell] = 1 }
}
}
// Garden fence with naturally open gates wherever a protected path
// reaches the travel garden. Ground12 is a native fence wall.
for (let y = 21; y <= 31; y++) {
for (let x = 17; x <= 35; x++) {
if (x != 17 && x != 35 && y != 21 && y != 31) continue
let cell = y * layout.width + x
if (!safe[cell] && !layout.walls[cell]) { layout.ground[cell] = 12; layout.walls[cell] = 1 }
}
}
}
// Defender beds use the same single-cell convention as crop/task
// anchors. These are terrain only; IDs, ranges, masks and walls stay put.
for (let i = 0; i < layout.defenderSlots.length; i++) {
let tile = layout.defenderSlots[i].tile
if (!layout.walls[tile]) layout.ground[tile] = 5
}
return layout
}

// Five-cell gates support the existing player body. Shared by presentation
// and host geometry so locked corridor appearance and collision agree.
export function exitCells(layout: farmTypes.Layout, exit: farmTypes.WorldObject): number[] {
let cx = Math.floor(exit.x / 16)
let cy = Math.floor(exit.y / 16)
let distances = [cx, layout.width - 1 - cx, cy, layout.height - 1 - cy]
let side = 0
for (let i = 1; i < 4; i++) if (distances[i] < distances[side]) side = i
let cells: number[] = []
for (let depth = 0; depth < 4; depth++) for (let across = -2; across <= 2; across++) {
let x = side == 0 ? depth : (side == 1 ? layout.width - 1 - depth : cx + across)
let y = side == 2 ? depth : (side == 3 ? layout.height - 1 - depth : cy + across)
if (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < layout.width && y < layout.height) cells.push(y * layout.width + x)
}
return cells
}

// Source-authored Hub branches are the intentional noncombat walking
// corridors. Ground IDs and physics are unchanged; this is a display mask.
export function walkingTiles(layout: farmTypes.Layout): number[] {
let result: number[] = []
if (layout.interior > 0) return result
if (layout.area == 0) {
for (let i = 0; i < layout.ground.length; i++) if (layout.ground[i] == 2) result.push(i)
return result
}
let branch: number[] = []
if (layout.area == 1) branch = [1488, 1489, 1490, 1491, 1492, 1493, 1494, 1495, 1496, 1497, 1498, 1499, 1500, 1452, 1404, 1356, 1357, 1358, 1359, 1360, 1361, 1362]
if (layout.area == 2) branch = [363, 362, 361, 360, 359, 358, 357, 356, 355, 354, 406, 458, 510]
if (layout.area == 3) branch = [2054, 2002, 1950, 1898, 1846, 1794, 1742, 1690, 1691, 1692, 1693, 1694, 1695, 1696, 1697, 1698, 1699]
if (layout.area == 4) branch = [2324, 2268, 2212, 2156, 2157, 2158, 2159, 2160, 2161, 2162, 2163, 2164]
if (layout.area == 5) branch = [2323, 2267, 2211, 2155, 2099, 2100, 2101, 2102, 2103]
if (layout.area == 6) branch = [2240, 2241, 2242, 2243, 2244, 2245, 2246, 2247, 2248, 2249, 2250, 2251, 2252, 2196, 2140]
if (layout.area == 7) branch = [2320, 2321, 2322, 2323, 2324, 2325, 2326, 2327, 2328, 2270, 2212, 2154, 2096, 2097, 2098, 2099, 2100, 2101]
if (layout.area == 8) branch = [2490, 2430, 2370, 2310, 2250, 2251, 2252, 2253, 2254]
if (layout.area == 9) branch = [2730, 2670, 2610, 2550, 2490, 2430, 2370]
if (layout.area == 10) branch = [2459, 2458, 2457, 2456, 2455, 2454, 2394, 2334, 2274]
if (layout.area == 11) branch = [2541, 2540, 2539, 2538, 2537, 2536, 2474, 2412, 2350]
if (layout.area == 12) branch = [3016, 2952, 2888, 2824, 2760, 2696, 2697, 2698, 2699, 2700]
for (let i = 0; i < branch.length; i++) {
let cx = branch[i] % layout.width
let cy = Math.floor(branch[i] / layout.width)
for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
let x = cx + dx
let y = cy + dy
if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= layout.width || y >= layout.height) continue
let tile = y * layout.width + x
if (layout.walls[tile] || layout.ground[tile] != 2 || result.indexOf(tile) >= 0) continue
let combatRoute = false
for (let j = 0; j < layout.routes.length; j++) if (layout.routes[j].tiles.indexOf(tile) >= 0) combatRoute = true
if (!combatRoute) result.push(tile)
}
}
return result
}

export function interior(room: number): farmTypes.Layout {
let l = new farmTypes.Layout()
l.area = 0
l.interior = room == 2 ? 2 : 1
l.width = 40
l.height = 30
l.entry = point(328, 392)
for (let y = 0; y < l.height; y++) for (let x = 0; x < l.width; x++) {
let wall = x == 0 || x == 39 || y == 0 || y == 29
// The five-cell bottom doorway is the only perimeter opening.
if (y == 29 && x >= 18 && x <= 22) wall = false
l.ground.push(wall ? 3 : 8)
l.walls.push(wall ? 1 : 0)
}
l.objects.push(worldObject(501, farmTypes.ObjectKind.Exit, 328, 440, 0, 0))
for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
let cx = 8 + i * 12
l.objects.push(worldObject((l.interior == 1 ? 510 : 520) + i,
l.interior == 1 ? farmTypes.ObjectKind.Shop : farmTypes.ObjectKind.Armory,
cx * 16 + 8, 216, i, 0))
// Solid source-floor counters/platforms behind each interaction.
for (let y = 9; y <= 11; y++) for (let x = cx - 2; x <= cx + 2; x++) {
l.walls[y * l.width + x] = 1
l.ground[y * l.width + x] = 3
}
}
return l
}

export function get(area: number): farmTypes.Layout {
return landscape(authored(area))
}
}

// SUPPLIED SOURCE: program.ts
// Magical Farm — learner-program execution core.
// Owns only callback registration, invocation slots, opaque job-token routing,
// cooperative cancellation/budget enforcement, and farm/combat dispatch.
// Learner algorithms remain in learner-authored code; domain consequences live
// in farmTasks/farmCombat.
namespace farmProgram {
const MAX_OPS_PER_JOB = 256
const NO_TERMINAL_CODE = -1

// Handler registry is indexed by the compact task index returned by taskIndex().
// Registration replaces the previous callback for future invocations only.
let handlers: ((job: number) => void)[] = []

// Execution slots are stable array positions. A slot is not made reusable until
// the learner callback actually returns, even after cancellation.
let slotActive: boolean[] = []
let slotContexts: farmTypes.Context[] = []
let slotDone: ((result: farmTypes.RunResult) => void)[] = []
let slotTerminalCode: number[] = []
let slotNoticed: boolean[] = []

// Monotonic for the lifetime of this runtime. Tokens are opaque learner values.
let nextToken = 1

function taskIndex(task: number): number {
if (task >= farmTypes.Task.Plant && task <= farmTypes.Task.Grove)
return task - farmTypes.Task.Plant
if (task >= farmTypes.Task.SixShooter && task <= farmTypes.Task.Stormbloom)
return 13 + task - farmTypes.Task.SixShooter
return -1
}

function isFarmTask(task: number): boolean {
return task >= farmTypes.Task.Plant && task <= farmTypes.Task.Grove
}

function isDefenderTask(task: number): boolean {
return task >= farmTypes.Task.SixShooter && task <= farmTypes.Task.Stormbloom
}

function farmAreaForTask(task: number): number {
if (task == farmTypes.Task.Plant || task == farmTypes.Task.Water) return 1
if (task >= farmTypes.Task.Trellis && task <= farmTypes.Task.Grove) return task - 1
return 0
}

function validModeForTask(task: number, mode: number): boolean {
if (isFarmTask(task))
return mode == farmTypes.Mode.Farm || mode == farmTypes.Mode.Regrow
if (isDefenderTask(task))
return mode == farmTypes.Mode.Preview || mode == farmTypes.Mode.Raid
return false
}

function validContext(context: farmTypes.Context): boolean {
if (!context) return false
if (taskIndex(context.task) < 0) return false
if (context.area < 1 || context.area > 12) return false
if (!validModeForTask(context.task, context.mode)) return false
if (isFarmTask(context.task) && farmAreaForTask(context.task) != context.area) return false
return true
}

function findActiveSlotByTask(task: number): number {
for (let i = 0; i < slotActive.length; i++) {
if (slotActive[i] && slotContexts[i] && slotContexts[i].task == task) return i
}
return -1
}

function findActiveSlotByToken(token: number): number {
if (token <= 0) return -1
for (let i = 0; i < slotActive.length; i++) {
if (slotActive[i] && slotContexts[i] && slotContexts[i].token == token) return i
}
return -1
}

function anyFarmActive(): boolean {
for (let i = 0; i < slotActive.length; i++) {
if (slotActive[i] && slotContexts[i] && isFarmTask(slotContexts[i].task)) return true
}
return false
}

function anyDefenderActive(): boolean {
for (let i = 0; i < slotActive.length; i++) {
if (slotActive[i] && slotContexts[i] && isDefenderTask(slotContexts[i].task)) return true
}
return false
}

function allocateSlot(context: farmTypes.Context, done: (result: farmTypes.RunResult) => void): number {
for (let i = 0; i < slotActive.length; i++) {
if (!slotActive[i]) {
slotActive[i] = true
slotContexts[i] = context
slotDone[i] = done
slotTerminalCode[i] = NO_TERMINAL_CODE
slotNoticed[i] = false
return i
}
}
slotActive.push(true)
slotContexts.push(context)
slotDone.push(done)
slotTerminalCode.push(NO_TERMINAL_CODE)
slotNoticed.push(false)
return slotActive.length - 1
}

function copyNumbers(source: number[]): number[] {
let result: number[] = []
if (!source) return result
for (let i = 0; i < source.length; i++) result.push(source[i])
return result
}

function makeResult(context: farmTypes.Context, code: number, message: string): farmTypes.RunResult {
let result = new farmTypes.RunResult()
result.task = context.task
result.area = context.area
result.actorId = context.actorId
result.mode = context.mode
result.token = context.token
result.code = code
result.message = message
result.trace = copyNumbers(context.trace)
return result
}

function normalizeResult(context: farmTypes.Context, result: farmTypes.RunResult): farmTypes.RunResult {
if (!result) result = makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "No domain result.")
result.task = context.task
result.area = context.area
result.actorId = context.actorId
result.mode = context.mode
result.token = context.token
result.trace = copyNumbers(context.trace)
return result
}

function noticeSlotOnce(slot: number, message: string): void {
if (slot < 0 || slot >= slotNoticed.length) return
if (slotNoticed[slot]) return
slotNoticed[slot] = true
farmWorld.notice(message)
}

function invalidJobNotice(): void {
farmWorld.notice("That learner job is no longer active.")
}

function invalidOperationNotice(slot: number): void {
noticeSlotOnce(slot, "That block does not belong in this learner job.")
}

function markSafetyStop(slot: number): void {
if (slot < 0 || slot >= slotActive.length || !slotActive[slot]) return
let context = slotContexts[slot]
if (!context) return
if (slotTerminalCode[slot] == NO_TERMINAL_CODE)
slotTerminalCode[slot] = farmTypes.ResultCode.SafetyStop
context.cancelled = true
noticeSlotOnce(slot, "Loop safety stop: edit the code and try again.")
}

// Returns the active slot after charging one API operation to the cooperative
// budget. The domain operation itself is still responsible for checking
// context.cancelled around any yields before it mutates world state.
function claimOperation(job: number): number {
let slot = findActiveSlotByToken(job)
if (slot < 0) {
invalidJobNotice()
return -1
}
let context = slotContexts[slot]
if (!context || context.cancelled) return -1

context.ops += 1
if (context.ops > MAX_OPS_PER_JOB) {
markSafetyStop(slot)
return -1
}
return slot
}

function allowedAction(task: number, action: number): boolean {
switch (action) {
case farmTypes.Action.PlantNext: return task == farmTypes.Task.Plant || task == farmTypes.Task.Greenhouse
case farmTypes.Action.WaterNext: return task == farmTypes.Task.Water || task == farmTypes.Task.Irrigate
case farmTypes.Action.PlacePost:
case farmTypes.Action.HammerPost:
case farmTypes.Action.OpenGate: return task == farmTypes.Task.Trellis
case farmTypes.Action.PickClump:
case farmTypes.Action.CarryBasket:
case farmTypes.Action.DepositBasket: return task == farmTypes.Task.Baskets
case farmTypes.Action.GrowBloom: return task == farmTypes.Task.Blooms
case farmTypes.Action.ClearWeeds:
case farmTypes.Action.PlantCurrent:
case farmTypes.Action.WaterCurrent: return task == farmTypes.Task.Weeds
case farmTypes.Action.FertilizeTree: return task == farmTypes.Task.Fertilize
case farmTypes.Action.InspectAnimal:

case farmTypes.Action.NextBed: return task == farmTypes.Task.Greenhouse || task == farmTypes.Task.Grove
case farmTypes.Action.LoadPod:

case farmTypes.Action.OpenCrate:
case farmTypes.Action.InspectFruit:
case farmTypes.Action.CompostFruit:
case farmTypes.Action.PackFruit:
case farmTypes.Action.SealCrate: return task == farmTypes.Task.Pack
case farmTypes.Action.Protect:
case farmTypes.Action.Tend:

case farmTypes.Action.FireChamber: return task == farmTypes.Task.SixShooter
case farmTypes.Action.FireLeft:
case farmTypes.Action.FireRight: return task == farmTypes.Task.Twinbud
case farmTypes.Action.NextTrap:
case farmTypes.Action.DropMine: return task == farmTypes.Task.Mineberry

case farmTypes.Action.InspectEnemy:
case farmTypes.Action.Pierce:
case farmTypes.Action.Splash: return task == farmTypes.Task.Prism
case farmTypes.Action.Beam: return task == farmTypes.Task.Sunbeam
case farmTypes.Action.Pulse: return task == farmTypes.Task.Echo
case farmTypes.Action.InspectAlly:

case farmTypes.Action.OpenCap:

case farmTypes.Action.Tighten:

switch (reader) {

case farmTypes.Read.MarkedCount: return task == farmTypes.Task.Prism
case farmTypes.Read.Sunlight: return task == farmTypes.Task.Sunbeam
case farmTypes.Read.Charge: return task == farmTypes.Task.Lanternleaf
case farmTypes.Read.PlantCount: return task == farmTypes.Task.Plant
case farmTypes.Read.WaterCount: return task == farmTypes.Task.Water
case farmTypes.Read.PostCount: return task == farmTypes.Task.Trellis
case farmTypes.Read.BasketCount: return task == farmTypes.Task.Baskets
case farmTypes.Read.BloomCount: return task == farmTypes.Task.Blooms
case farmTypes.Read.WeedPlotCount: return task == farmTypes.Task.Weeds

case farmTypes.Read.AnimalCount: return task == farmTypes.Task.Feed

case farmTypes.Predicate.WeedsHere: return task == farmTypes.Task.Weeds
case farmTypes.Predicate.Hungry: return task == farmTypes.Task.Feed
case farmTypes.Predicate.DirtyPods:
case farmTypes.Predicate.Muddy: return task == farmTypes.Task.Wash
case farmTypes.Predicate.DamagedFruit: return task == farmTypes.Task.Pack
case farmTypes.Predicate.Pests:
case farmTypes.Predicate.Threatened: return task == farmTypes.Task.Grove
case farmTypes.Predicate.EnemyNearby: return task == farmTypes.Task.Rage
case farmTypes.Predicate.Armored: return task == farmTypes.Task.Prism
case farmTypes.Predicate.DamagedAlly: return task == farmTypes.Task.Healroot
case farmTypes.Predicate.Trapped: return task == farmTypes.Task.Rootsnare
case farmTypes.Predicate.Conductive: return task == farmTypes.Task.Stormbloom
}

}

function finishDomain(context: farmTypes.Context): farmTypes.RunResult {
if (isFarmTask(context.task)) return farmTasks.finish(context)
return farmCombat.finish(context)
}

function settle(token: number, missing: boolean): void {
let slot = findActiveSlotByToken(token)
if (slot < 0) return

let context = slotContexts[slot]
let done = slotDone[slot]
let terminal = slotTerminalCode[slot]
let result: farmTypes.RunResult = null

if (missing) {
result = makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Missing, "No current learner code is registered for this job.")
} else if (terminal == farmTypes.ResultCode.SafetyStop) {
result = makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.SafetyStop, "Learner job stopped after too many API operations.")
} else if (context.cancelled || terminal == farmTypes.ResultCode.Cancelled) {
result = makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Cancelled, "Learner job was cancelled.")
} else {
result = normalizeResult(context, finishDomain(context))
}

// Callback has returned (or was missing), so this execution slot may now be
// released. Release before done so the done handler may deliberately start
// the next queued run of the same task.
slotActive[slot] = false
slotContexts[slot] = null
slotDone[slot] = null
slotTerminalCode[slot] = NO_TERMINAL_CODE
slotNoticed[slot] = false

if (done) done(result)
}

export function register(task: number, handler: (job: number) => void): void {
let index = taskIndex(task)
if (index < 0) {
farmWorld.notice("Unknown learner task registration ignored.")
return
}
handlers[index] = handler
}

export function has(task: number): boolean {
let index = taskIndex(task)
return index >= 0 && !!handlers[index]
}

export function start(context: farmTypes.Context, done: (result: farmTypes.RunResult) => void): boolean {
if (!validContext(context) || !done) return false
if (findActiveSlotByTask(context.task) >= 0) return false

// Farm jobs never overlap other farm work or raid/preview power work.
// Distinct defender task/species slots may overlap each other.
if (isFarmTask(context.task)) {
if (anyFarmActive() || anyDefenderActive()) return false
} else if (isDefenderTask(context.task)) {
if (anyFarmActive()) return false
} else {
return false
}

let index = taskIndex(context.task)
let handler = handlers[index]
let token = nextToken
nextToken += 1

context.token = token
context.cancelled = false
context.ops = 0
context.trace = []
allocateSlot(context, done)

if (!handler) {
control.runInParallel(function () {
settle(token, true)
})
return true
}

// Snapshot the currently registered handler. A registration that occurs
// while this callback is running affects only later invocations.
control.runInParallel(function () {
handler(token)
settle(token, false)
})
return true
}

export function cancelAll(): void {
let cancelledAny = false
for (let i = 0; i < slotActive.length; i++) {
if (!slotActive[i] || !slotContexts[i]) continue
let context = slotContexts[i]
context.cancelled = true
if (slotTerminalCode[i] == NO_TERMINAL_CODE)
slotTerminalCode[i] = farmTypes.ResultCode.Cancelled
cancelledAny = true
}
if (cancelledAny) farmWorld.notice("Current learner work cancelled. Waiting for running code to return.")
}

export function busy(task: number): boolean {
return taskIndex(task) >= 0 && findActiveSlotByTask(task) >= 0
}

export function action(job: number, action: number, value: number): void {
let slot = claimOperation(job)
if (slot < 0) return
let context = slotContexts[slot]
if (!allowedAction(context.task, action)) {
invalidOperationNotice(slot)
return
}
if (isFarmTask(context.task)) farmTasks.action(context, action, value)
else farmCombat.action(context, action, value)
}

export function read(job: number, reader: number): number {
let slot = claimOperation(job)
if (slot < 0) return 0
let context = slotContexts[slot]
if (!allowedRead(context.task, reader)) {
invalidOperationNotice(slot)
return 0
}
if (isFarmTask(context.task)) return farmTasks.read(context, reader)
return farmCombat.read(context, reader)
}

export function test(job: number, predicate: number, value: number): boolean {
let slot = claimOperation(job)
if (slot < 0) return false
let context = slotContexts[slot]
if (!allowedPredicate(context.task, predicate)) {
invalidOperationNotice(slot)
return false
}
if (isFarmTask(context.task)) return farmTasks.test(context, predicate, value)
return farmCombat.test(context, predicate, value)
}
}

// SUPPLIED SOURCE: save.ts
// Package-private persistence implementation for 01-world (MF-CONTRACT-1.0).
// Only this package writes Magical Farm settings keys. The envelope
// deliberately stores numeric arrays so the same project/save remains native
// MakeCode Arcade data rather than browser/localStorage state.
namespace farmSave {
export const SCHEMA_VERSION = 1
export const KEY_SLOT_A = "mf.v1.a"
export const KEY_SLOT_B = "mf.v1.b"
export const KEY_HEAD = "mf.v1.head"
export const KEY_RESUME = "mf.v1.resume"

// Static residence is small enough to commit after each visible movement
// without repeatedly copying/encoding every crop and earned capability.
// Existing v1 full saves remain byte/schema compatible. Raids freeze this
// record at their stable pre-raid position; no live battle is serialized.
export class Resume {
constructor() {}
area: number = 0
interior: number = 0
door: number = -1
x: number = 0 // native Fx8 coordinates
y: number = 0
facingX: number = 0
facingY: number = 1
playedMs: number = 0
}

// Envelope layout (all integral numbers):
// [0] schema version
// [1] monotonically increasing revision
// [2] total array length
// [3] checksum over every element except this field
// [4] current snapshot length
// [5] recovery snapshot length (0 when no pre-raid recovery snapshot)
// [6..] current snapshot, then optional recovery snapshot
//
// Snapshot layout:
// [0] encoded Progress length
// [1] opaque farm payload length
// [2..] encoded Progress, then farmTasks.exportState() payload
//
// The farm payload is opaque here. Package 02 owns its schema and performs
// full semantic validation in farmTasks.importState before world commits a
// loaded Progress authority.
const HEADER_LENGTH = 6
const SNAPSHOT_HEADER_LENGTH = 2
const CHECKSUM_INDEX = 3
const MAX_FARM_PAYLOAD = 8192
const MAX_PLACEMENTS = 256
const MAX_SLOT_ID = 65535
const CHECK_MOD = 2147483629

export enum LoadStatus {
Empty = 0,
Loaded = 1,
Recovered = 2,
Corrupt = 3,
Future = 4
}

export class Snapshot {
constructor() {}
progress: farmTypes.Progress = null
farm: number[] = []
}

export class Candidate {
constructor() {}
slot: number = -1
revision: number = 0
current: Snapshot = null
recovery: Snapshot = null
}

export class LoadResult {
constructor() {}
status: number = LoadStatus.Empty
primary: Candidate = null
alternate: Candidate = null
}

let lastRevision = 0
let lastSlot = -1
let writesBlocked = false

function integer(value: number): boolean {
return value == value && value == Math.floor(value) && Math.abs(value) <= 9007199254740991
}

function flag(value: number): boolean {
return value == 0 || value == 1
}

function copyNumbers(source: number[]): number[] {
let result: number[] = []
if (!source) return result
for (let i = 0; i < source.length; i++) result.push(source[i])
return result
}

function copyPlacement(source: farmTypes.Placement): farmTypes.Placement {
let p = new farmTypes.Placement()
p.area = source.area
p.slot = source.slot
p.crop = source.crop
p.rooted = source.rooted
return p
}

function copyProgress(source: farmTypes.Progress): farmTypes.Progress {
if (!source) return null
let p = new farmTypes.Progress()
p.gold = source.gold
p.area = source.area
p.weapon = source.weapon
p.weapons = copyNumbers(source.weapons)
p.playedMs = source.playedMs
p.complete = source.complete
p.unlocked = copyNumbers(source.unlocked)
p.cleared = copyNumbers(source.cleared)
p.phase = copyNumbers(source.phase)
p.inventory = copyNumbers(source.inventory)
p.expansion = copyNumbers(source.expansion)
p.farmEarned = copyNumbers(source.farmEarned)
p.upgrades = copyNumbers(source.upgrades)
p.powerEarned = copyNumbers(source.powerEarned)
p.placements = []
if (source.placements) {
for (let i = 0; i < source.placements.length; i++) p.placements.push(copyPlacement(source.placements[i]))
}
return p
}

function checksum(data: number[]): number {
// Small integer recurrence: deterministic in JS/PXT number arithmetic,
// catches truncation/order/value corruption, and stays far below 2^53.
let h = 104729
for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
let value = i == CHECKSUM_INDEX ? 0 : data[i]
if (!integer(value)) return -1
let folded = value % CHECK_MOD
if (folded < 0) folded += CHECK_MOD
h = (h * 131 + folded + i + 1) % CHECK_MOD
}
return h
}

function validNumberArray(data: number[]): boolean {
if (!data) return false
for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) if (!integer(data[i])) return false
return true
}

function validFlagArray(data: number[], expected: number): boolean {
if (!data || data.length != expected) return false
for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) if (!flag(data[i])) return false
return true
}

function validNonnegativeArray(data: number[], expected: number): boolean {
if (!data || data.length != expected) return false
for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) if (!integer(data[i]) || data[i] < 0) return false
return true
}

function validProgress(p: farmTypes.Progress): boolean {
if (!p) return false
if (!integer(p.gold) || p.gold < 0) return false
if (!integer(p.area) || p.area < 0 || p.area > 12) return false
if (!integer(p.weapon) || p.weapon < farmTypes.Weapon.GardenBlade || p.weapon > farmTypes.Weapon.ShortQuick) return false
if (!integer(p.playedMs) || p.playedMs < 0) return false
if (!validFlagArray(p.weapons, 3) || p.weapons[0] != 1 || p.weapons[p.weapon] != 1) return false
if (!validFlagArray(p.unlocked, 13)) return false
if (!validFlagArray(p.cleared, 13)) return false
if (!validNonnegativeArray(p.inventory, 13)) return false
if (!validNonnegativeArray(p.expansion, 13)) return false
if (!validFlagArray(p.farmEarned, 14)) return false
if (!validFlagArray(p.upgrades, 15)) return false
if (!validFlagArray(p.powerEarned, 13)) return false
if (!p.phase || p.phase.length != 13) return false
if (!p.placements || p.placements.length > MAX_PLACEMENTS) return false
if (p.unlocked[0] != 0 || p.cleared[0] != 0 || p.inventory[0] != 0 || p.expansion[0] != 0) return false
if (p.farmEarned[0] != 0 || p.upgrades[0] != 0 || p.powerEarned[0] != 0) return false
if (p.expansion[1] < 0 || p.expansion[1] > 2) return false
for (let area = 2; area <= 12; area++) if (p.expansion[area] < 0 || p.expansion[area] > 1) return false
for (let area = 0; area <= 12; area++) {
if (!integer(p.phase[area]) || p.phase[area] < farmTypes.Phase.Locked || p.phase[area] > farmTypes.Phase.Production) return false
}
for (let i = 0; i < p.placements.length; i++) {
let a = p.placements[i]
if (!a || !integer(a.area) || a.area < 1 || a.area > 12) return false
if (!integer(a.slot) || a.slot < 0 || a.slot > MAX_SLOT_ID) return false
