let index = selectA5Current(context)
answer = index >= 0 && context.data[4 + index] == 1
} else if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Feed && predicate == farmTypes.Predicate.Hungry) {
let current = context.data[16]
answer = current >= 0 && current < 6 && context.data[10 + current] == 1 && context.data[4 + current] == 1
} else if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Wash && predicate == farmTypes.Predicate.DirtyPods) {
answer = firstDirtyPod(context) >= 0
} else if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Wash && predicate == farmTypes.Predicate.Muddy) {
let currentPod = context.data[11]
answer = currentPod >= 0 && currentPod < 7 && context.data[4 + currentPod] == 2
} else if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Pack && predicate == farmTypes.Predicate.DamagedFruit) {
let fruit = context.data[7]
let crate = context.data[6]
answer = crate >= 0 && crate < 3 && fruit >= crate * 6 && fruit < crate * 6 + 6 && context.data[fruitResolutionIndex(fruit)] == 0 && context.data[11 + fruit] == 1
} else if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Grove && predicate == farmTypes.Predicate.Pests) {
answer = grovePestsRemain(context, context.data[6])
} else if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Grove && predicate == farmTypes.Predicate.Threatened) {
let bed = context.data[6]
let herb = context.data[7]
answer = bed >= 0 && bed < 3 && herb >= 0 && herb < 5 && context.data[11 + bed * 5 + herb] != 0
}
trace(context, answer ? TRACE_TEST_TRUE : TRACE_TEST_FALSE, predicate, value)
return answer
}

function taskComplete(context: farmTypes.Context): boolean {
if (context.data[DATA_WRONGS] != 0) return false
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Plant)
return context.data[4] == context.data[3] && allA1AtLeast(context.data[3], 1)
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Water)
return context.data[4] == context.data[3] && allA1AtLeast(context.data[3], 2)
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Trellis)
return context.data[4] == 5 && context.data[5] == 5 && context.data[6] == 1 && context.cursor < 0
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Baskets)
return context.data[4] == 4 && context.data[5] == 0 && context.cursor < 0
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Blooms) {
if (context.data[4] != 5) return false
for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) if (context.data[5 + i] != i + 1) return false
return true
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Weeds) {
for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) if (context.data[12 + i] != 2) return false
return true
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Fertilize) {
if (context.data[4] != 4) return false
for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) if (context.data[5 + i] != i + 1) return false
return true
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Feed) {
if (context.data[17] != 6) return false
for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
if (context.data[10 + i] == 0) return false
if (context.data[4 + i] != 0) return false
}
return true
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Greenhouse) {
if (context.data[5] != 3) return false
for (let bed = 0; bed < 3; bed++) {
if (context.data[7 + bed] != 4) return false
for (let plot = 0; plot < 4; plot++) {
if (context.data[10 + bed * 4 + plot] != 1) return false
}
}
return true
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Wash) {
if (firstDirtyPod(context) >= 0) return false
for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) if (context.data[4 + i] != 0) return false
return true
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Pack) {
if (context.data[5] != 3) return false
for (let crate = 0; crate < 3; crate++) {
if (context.data[8 + crate] != 1) return false
if (!crateAllResolved(context, crate)) return false
}
return true
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Grove) {
if (context.data[5] != 3) return false
for (let bed = 0; bed < 3; bed++) {
if (context.data[8 + bed] != 1) return false
if (grovePestsRemain(context, bed)) return false
}
return true
}
return false
}

function evaluateIrrigation(context: farmTypes.Context): boolean {
if (context.data[DATA_WRONGS] != 0) return false
let startSupply = context.data[5]
let startWatered = context.data[6]
let startStage = context.data[7]
let calls = context.data[4]

if (startStage == 0 && startSupply == 3 && startWatered == 0 && calls == 3 && context.resource == 0 && irrigationWatered == 3) {
irrigationStage = 1
return true
}
if (startStage == 1 && startSupply == 0 && startWatered == 3 && calls == 0 && context.resource == 0 && irrigationWatered == 3) {
irrigationStage = 2
return true
}
if (startStage == 3 && startSupply == 4 && startWatered == 3 && calls == 4 && context.resource == 0 && irrigationWatered == 7) {
irrigationStage = 4
return true
}
return false
}

export function finish(context: farmTypes.Context): farmTypes.RunResult {
let result = new farmTypes.RunResult()
if (!context) {
result.code = farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong
result.message = "Missing farm context."
return result
}
result.task = context.task
result.area = context.area
result.actorId = context.actorId
result.mode = context.mode
result.token = context.token
result.trace = copyNumbers(context.trace)

farewellHelper(context)

let complete = context.task == farmTypes.Task.Irrigate ? evaluateIrrigation(context) : taskComplete(context)
if (context.cancelled) {
result.code = farmTypes.ResultCode.Cancelled
result.message = "Farm work was cancelled."
} else if (complete) {
noteSuccess(context)
result.code = farmTypes.ResultCode.Success
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Irrigate && irrigationStage < 4)
result.message = "Irrigation stage complete."
else
result.message = taskMessage(context.task) + " Complete."
} else {
if (context.data[DATA_STATUS] != STATUS_WRONG) context.data[DATA_STATUS] = STATUS_WRONG
result.code = farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong
result.message = taskMessage(context.task) + " The visible farm state is not complete yet."
}
result.trace = copyNumbers(context.trace)
if (helper && helperToken == context.token) hideHelperTeam()
farmWorld.dirtyWork()
return result
}

export function guidanceTask(area: number): number {
if (area < 1 || area > 12) return 0
if (area == 1) {
let count = farmWorld.plotCapacity(1)
for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) if (i >= a1PlotState.length || a1PlotState[i] < 1) return farmTypes.Task.Plant
if (!farmWorld.farmTaskEarned(farmTypes.Task.Plant)) return farmTypes.Task.Plant
for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) if (a1PlotState[i] < 2) return farmTypes.Task.Water
if (!farmWorld.farmTaskEarned(farmTypes.Task.Water)) return farmTypes.Task.Water
} else {
if (area == 6 && irrigationStage == 2) return -1
let task = area + 1
if (task < workContexts.length && workContexts[task] && workContexts[task].data[DATA_STATUS] != STATUS_SUCCESS) return task
if (!farmWorld.farmTaskEarned(task)) return task
}
for (let local = 1; local <= BASE_CROP_COUNT[area]; local++) {
let slot = SLOT_START[area] + local - 1
if (slot >= cropState.length || cropState[slot] == CROP_EMPTY || cropState[slot] == CROP_WILTED) return area == 1 ? farmTypes.Task.Water : area + 1
}
return 0
}

// Read-only guidance selects a genuinely ripe crop, including saved growth.
export function harvestReady(localSlot: number): boolean {
if (activeArea < 1 || activeArea > 12 || localSlot < 1 || localSlot > activeCountForArea(activeArea)) return false
syncProductionState()
let slot = globalSlot(activeArea, localSlot)
return slot > 0 && cropState[slot] == CROP_MATURE
}

export function ready(area: number): boolean {
if (area < 1 || area > 12) return false
syncProductionState()
let progress = farmWorld.progress()
if (!progress || !progress.farmEarned || progress.farmEarned.length < 14) {
farmWorld.notice("Farm progress is not available yet.")
return false
}
if (area == 1) {
if (!progress.farmEarned[farmTypes.Task.Plant] || !progress.farmEarned[farmTypes.Task.Water]) {
farmWorld.notice("Plant and water all starter beds before Begin Growing.")
return false
}
} else {
let task = area + 1
if (!progress.farmEarned[task]) {
farmWorld.notice("Finish this area's farm work before Begin Growing.")
return false
}
}
if (!baseCropsPrepared(area)) {
farmWorld.notice("The base crop region is not physically ready for the growth raid.")
return false
}
return true
}

export function exportState(): number[] {
ensureProductionArrays()
syncExpansionSlots()
advanceDueCrops()
let data: number[] = []
data.push(SAVE_VERSION)
data.push(MAX_CROP_SLOTS)
data.push(SAVE_SLOT_RECORD_WIDTH)
data.push(SAVE_A1_PLOT_COUNT)
data.push(irrigationSupply)
data.push(irrigationRefilled ? 1 : 0)
data.push(irrigationWatered)
data.push(irrigationStage)
while (a1PlotState.length < SAVE_A1_PLOT_COUNT) a1PlotState.push(0)
for (let i = 0; i < SAVE_A1_PLOT_COUNT; i++) data.push(a1PlotState[i])
for (let slot = 1; slot <= MAX_CROP_SLOTS; slot++) {
data.push(cropState[slot])
data.push(cropHp[slot])
data.push(cropDue[slot])
data.push(cropMeta[slot])
}
let count = 0
for (let task = 1; task < workContexts.length; task++) if (workContexts[task]) count += 1
data.push(count)
for (let area = 0; area <= 12; area++) data.push(area < lastWorkTask.length ? lastWorkTask[area] : 0)
for (let task = 1; task < workContexts.length; task++) {
let context = workContexts[task]
if (!context) continue
data.push(task); data.push(context.area); data.push(context.resource)
data.push(context.cursor); data.push(context.group); data.push(context.data.length)
for (let i = 0; i < context.data.length; i++) data.push(context.data[i])
}
return data
}

export function importState(data: number[]): boolean {
if (!data || data.length < SAVE_LENGTH) return false
if ((data[0] != 1 && data[0] != SAVE_VERSION) || data[1] != MAX_CROP_SLOTS || data[2] != SAVE_SLOT_RECORD_WIDTH || data[3] != SAVE_A1_PLOT_COUNT) return false
if (!intInRange(data[4], 0, 4)) return false
if (!intInRange(data[5], 0, 1)) return false
if (!intInRange(data[6], 0, 7)) return false
if (!intInRange(data[7], 0, 4)) return false

let nextA1: number[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < SAVE_A1_PLOT_COUNT; i++) {
let value = data[8 + i]
if (!intInRange(value, 0, 2)) return false
nextA1.push(value)
}

let nextState: number[] = [CROP_EMPTY]
let nextHp: number[] = [0]
let nextDue: number[] = [0]
let nextMeta: number[] = [0]
let offset = SAVE_FIXED_FIELDS
for (let slot = 1; slot <= MAX_CROP_SLOTS; slot++) {
let state = data[offset]
let hp = data[offset + 1]
let due = data[offset + 2]
let meta = data[offset + 3]
if (!intInRange(state, CROP_EMPTY, CROP_WILTED)) return false
if (!intInRange(hp, 0, 1000)) return false
if (!intInRange(due, 0, MAX_SAVE_CLOCK)) return false
if (!intInRange(meta, 0, 255)) return false
nextState.push(state)
nextHp.push(hp)
nextDue.push(due)
nextMeta.push(meta)
offset += SAVE_SLOT_RECORD_WIDTH
}

let nextWork: farmTypes.Context[] = []
let nextLast: number[] = []
if (data[0] == 1) {
if (data.length != SAVE_LENGTH) return false
} else {
if (data.length < SAVE_LENGTH + 14) return false
let count = data[offset++]
if (!intInRange(count, 0, 13)) return false
for (let area = 0; area <= 12; area++) {
let task = data[offset++]
if (!intInRange(task, 0, 13) || (task > 0 && taskArea(task) != area)) return false
nextLast.push(task)
}
for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
if (offset + 6 > data.length) return false
let task = data[offset++]; let area = data[offset++]
let resource = data[offset++]; let cursor = data[offset++]; let group = data[offset++]
let length = data[offset++]
if (!intInRange(task, 1, 13) || taskArea(task) != area || (task < nextWork.length && nextWork[task])) return false
if (!intInRange(resource, 0, 1000) || !intInRange(cursor, -1, 1000) || !intInRange(group, -1, 1000) || !intInRange(length, 3, 128) || offset + length > data.length) return false
let context = new farmTypes.Context()
context.task = task; context.area = area; context.mode = farmTypes.Mode.Farm
context.resource = resource; context.cursor = cursor; context.group = group
for (let j = 0; j < length; j++) {
let value = data[offset++]
if (!intInRange(value, -1000000, 1000000)) return false
context.data.push(value)
}
while (nextWork.length <= task) nextWork.push(null)
nextWork[task] = context
}
if (offset != data.length) return false
for (let area = 1; area <= 12; area++) if (nextLast[area] > 0 && !nextWork[nextLast[area]]) return false
}
// Transactional commit only after the entire candidate validates.
irrigationSupply = data[4]
irrigationRefilled = data[5] == 1
irrigationWatered = data[6]
irrigationStage = data[7]
a1PlotState = nextA1
cropState = nextState
cropHp = nextHp
cropDue = nextDue
cropMeta = nextMeta
workContexts = nextWork
lastWorkTask = nextLast
a1RegrowAttempted = false
a1RegrowPhase = 0
syncExpansionSlots()
advanceDueCrops()
refreshActiveCrops()
restoreWorkView()
return true
}

export function productionTick(elapsedMs: number): void {
if (elapsedMs <= 0) return
// elapsedMs is a signal that the world active-play clock advanced; due
// records themselves remain absolute world.clock() values so inactive
// areas can mature without hidden AI or wall-clock assumptions.
let changed = syncExpansionSlots()
if (advanceDueCrops()) changed = true
if (changed) {
refreshActiveCrops()
farmWorld.checkpoint("farm-production")
}
maybeStartA1Regrow()
if (activeLayout) {
let elapsed = game.runtime()
for (let i = 0; i < cropSprites.length; i++) {
let slot = cropSpriteSlots[i]
let key = "crop." + cropName(cropForArea(activeArea)) + "." + cropArtState(cropState[slot])
farmPlantArt.animate(cropSprites[i], key, elapsed)
}
}
}

export function cropDamage(localSlot: number, damage: number): void {
ensureProductionArrays()
syncRaidLifecycle()
if (activeArea < 1 || activeArea > 12 || damage <= 0) return
if (!intInRange(localSlot, 1, baseCountForArea(activeArea))) return
let slot = globalSlot(activeArea, localSlot)
if (slot <= 0 || cropState[slot] != CROP_GROWING || cropHp[slot] <= 0) return
cropHp[slot] -= damage
if (cropHp[slot] <= 0) {
cropHp[slot] = 0
cropState[slot] = CROP_WILTED
refreshActiveCrops()
} else {
// Surviving damage changes the existing bar in place; no new
// images or sprites are allocated per hit or animation frame.
for (let i = 0; i < cropSpriteSlots.length; i++) {
if (cropSpriteSlots[i] == slot && cropHealthBars[i]) {
cropHealthBars[i].value = cropHp[slot]
break
}
}
}
}

// Read-only active raid-objective observation. Combat calls livingCropCount()
// once at raid startup to synchronize objective arming, then reads per-slot
// liveness without rebuilding crops or exposing the private save arrays.
export function cropAlive(localSlot: number): boolean {
if (activeArea < 1 || activeArea > 12) return false
if (!intInRange(localSlot, 1, baseCountForArea(activeArea))) return false
let progress = farmWorld.progress()
if (!progress || progress.phase[activeArea] != farmTypes.Phase.Raid) return false
let slot = globalSlot(activeArea, localSlot)
return slot > 0 && cropState[slot] == CROP_GROWING && cropHp[slot] > 0
}

export function livingCropCount(): number {
ensureProductionArrays()
syncRaidLifecycle()
if (activeArea < 1 || activeArea > 12) return 0
let count = 0
let base = baseCountForArea(activeArea)
for (let local = 1; local <= base; local++) {
let slot = globalSlot(activeArea, local)
if (cropState[slot] == CROP_GROWING && cropHp[slot] > 0) count += 1
}
return count
}
}

let raidCountdownRemainingMs = 0
let raidCountdownShown = -1
let raidPhaseIndex = 0
let raidPhaseElapsedMs = 0
let raidScheduledSpawns: SpawnRequest[] = []
let raidSetupWaitingActorIds: number[] = []
let raidInitialCropCount = 0
let starterGuardCooldowns: number[] = []

let enemies: EnemyRuntime[] = []
let defenders: DefenderRuntime[] = []
let effects: EffectRuntime[] = []
let pendingEnemyHits: PendingEnemyHit[] = []
let mines: MineRuntime[] = []
let blockedSpawns: SpawnRequest[] = []
let pendingChildren: ChildRequest[] = []

// Fair waiting requests. The active runner itself is owned by farmProgram;
// combat never fabricates callback completion. Step 8 bounds each task by
// counting only requests with the same task before enqueueing.
let runnerQueue: RunnerRequest[] = []
let activeRunners: ActiveRunner[] = []

let activeLayout: farmTypes.Layout = null
let activeRoutes: RouteRuntime[] = []
let occupancy: OccupancyBucket[] = []
let enemyReachLookups: EnemyReachLookup[] = []

// One deterministic power preview may exist at a time. These IDs refer only to
// transient projected actors created by Combat; durable world placements and
// crop unlock/inventory state are never mutated here.
let previewActive = false
let previewCrop = 0
let previewActorId = -1
let previewEnemyIds: number[] = []
let previewDefenderIds: number[] = []
let previewStormTargetIds: number[] = []
let previewElapsedMs = 0
let previewCleanupMs = -1
let previewExitEnemyId = -1
let previewExitAtMs = -1
let previewExitTile = -1

// Deferred destruction prevents array mutation while an update/damage pass is
// walking the same records. IDs are resolved during flushDeferred().
let enemyDestroyIds: number[] = []
let defenderDestroyIds: number[] = []
let effectDestroyIds: number[] = []

function validArea(area: number): boolean {
return area >= MIN_AREA && area <= MAX_AREA
}

function validCrop(crop: number): boolean {
return crop >= MIN_CROP && crop <= MAX_CROP
}

function taskForCrop(crop: number): number {
if (!validCrop(crop)) return 0
return 100 + crop
}

function clampDt(dtMs: number): number {
if (dtMs < 0) return 0
if (dtMs > 100) return 100
return dtMs
}

function containsNumber(values: number[], value: number): boolean {
for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
if (values[i] == value) return true
}
return false
}

// Accepted64px view is separate from the retained original logical sprite.
// The proxy stays invisible; pixel collision/range/routes are unchanged.
function ensureMonsterViews(): void {
if (monsterViews.length > 0) return
for (let species = 1; species <= 13; species++) for (let pose = 0; pose < 2; pose++) {
let source = farmMonsterArt.frame(species, pose == 1)
let reduced = image.create(32, 32)
let foot = 16
for (let y = 0; y < 32; y++) for (let x = 0; x < 32; x++) {
let color = source.getPixel(x * 2, y * 2)
reduced.setPixel(x, y, color)
if (color > 0 && y > foot) foot = y
}
monsterViews.push(reduced)
monsterFeet.push(foot)
}
}

function presentMonster(enemy: EnemyRuntime, back: boolean): void {
let index = (enemy.species - 1) * 2 + (back ? 1 : 0)
enemy.visual.setImage(monsterViews[index])
let moving = !enemy.movementPaused && !enemy.reachedObjective
let bob = moving && Math.idiv(elapsedMs, 180) % 2 == 1 ? 1 : 0
let lunge = enemy.attackViewUntil > elapsedMs ? 2 : enemy.hitFlashMs > 0 ? -2 : 0
enemy.visual.setPosition(enemy.visualX + lunge, enemy.visualY - (monsterFeet[index] - 16) - bob)
enemy.visual.z = Math.min(9000, enemy.visualY)
enemy.visual.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Ghost, true)
enemy.visual.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Invisible, (enemy.hitFlashMs > 0 || enemy.phased) && Math.idiv(elapsedMs, 40) % 2 == 0)
}

function createEnemyVisual(enemy: EnemyRuntime): void {
ensureMonsterViews()
enemy.sprite.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Invisible, true)
enemy.visual = sprites.create(monsterViews[(enemy.species - 1) * 2], EnemyKind)
enemy.lastVisualY = enemy.visualY
presentMonster(enemy, false)
enemy.healthBar = statusbars.create(24, 4, EnemyHealthKind)
enemy.healthBar.setColor(7, 2)
enemy.healthBar.setBarBorder(1, 15)
enemy.healthBar.attachToSprite(enemy.visual, 2, 0)
enemy.healthBar.positionDirection(CollisionDirection.Top)
syncEnemyHealthBar(enemy)
}

function syncEnemyHealthBar(enemy: EnemyRuntime): void {
if (!enemy || !enemy.healthBar) return
if (enemy.healthBar.max != enemy.maxHp) enemy.healthBar.max = enemy.maxHp
if (enemy.healthBar.value != enemy.hp) enemy.healthBar.value = enemy.hp
enemy.healthBar.z = enemy.visual.z + 1
}

function destroyEnemySprites(enemy: EnemyRuntime): void {
destroyOwnedSprite(enemy.healthBar)
enemy.healthBar = null
destroyOwnedSprite(enemy.sprite)
destroyOwnedSprite(enemy.visual)
}

function updateEnemyVisuals(): void {
for (let i = 0; i < enemies.length; i++) {
let enemy = enemies[i]
if (!enemy.visual || enemy.pendingDestroy || !enemy.alive) continue
let back = enemy.visualY < enemy.lastVisualY
presentMonster(enemy, back)
syncEnemyHealthBar(enemy)
enemy.lastVisualY = enemy.visualY
}
}

function destroyOwnedSprite(sprite: Sprite): void {
if (sprite) sprite.destroy()
}

function resetRunnerQueue(): void {
runnerQueue = []
activeRunners = []
}

function clearTransientSprites(): void {
destroyOwnedSprite(weaponView)
weaponView = null
for (let i = 0; i < effects.length; i++) destroyOwnedSprite(effects[i].sprite)
for (let i = 0; i < enemies.length; i++) destroyEnemySprites(enemies[i])
for (let i = 0; i < defenders.length; i++) destroyDefenderSprites(defenders[i])
}

function clearRuntimeCollections(): void {
enemies = []
defenders = []
effects = []
pendingEnemyHits = []
mines = []
blockedSpawns = []
pendingChildren = []
enemyDestroyIds = []
defenderDestroyIds = []
effectDestroyIds = []
resetRunnerQueue()
occupancy = []
previewActive = false
previewCrop = 0
previewActorId = -1
previewEnemyIds = []
previewDefenderIds = []
previewStormTargetIds = []
previewElapsedMs = 0
previewCleanupMs = -1
previewExitEnemyId = -1
previewExitAtMs = -1
previewExitTile = -1
}

function clearGeometry(): void {
activeLayout = null
activeRoutes = []
occupancy = []
enemyReachLookups = []
}

function clearRaidState(): void {
raidActive = false
raidSettled = false
raidResultSent = false
raidArea = 0
raidElapsedMs = 0
raidStage = RAID_STAGE_NONE
raidCountdownRemainingMs = 0
raidCountdownShown = -1
raidPhaseIndex = 0
raidPhaseElapsedMs = 0
raidScheduledSpawns = []
raidSetupWaitingActorIds = []
raidInitialCropCount = 0
starterGuardCooldowns = []
}

function hardCleanup(): void {
// Invalidate all domain records before destruction. farmProgram owns the
// executing fibers/tokens, so request cooperative cancellation first. A
// callback that does not actually return keeps farmProgram.busy(task)=true;
// future Combat starts therefore cannot reuse that same task/species slot.
farmProgram.cancelAll()
epoch += 1
clearTransientSprites()
clearRuntimeCollections()
clearGeometry()
clearRaidState()
nextActorId = 1
nextEffectId = 1
// Runner serials stay monotonic across area cleanup so an actually-late
// callback can never collide with a later active runner in a new epoch.
elapsedMs = 0
playerAttackCooldownMs = 0
playerFacingX = 0
playerFacingY = 1
}

function aliveEnemyCount(): number {
let count = 0
for (let i = 0; i < enemies.length; i++) {
if (enemies[i].alive && !enemies[i].pendingDestroy && enemies[i].epoch == epoch) count += 1
}
return count
}

function liveEffectCount(): number {
let count = 0
for (let i = 0; i < effects.length; i++) {
if (!effects[i].pendingDestroy && effects[i].epoch == epoch) count += 1
}
return count
}

function enemyById(id: number): EnemyRuntime {
for (let i = 0; i < enemies.length; i++) {
if (enemies[i].id == id && enemies[i].epoch == epoch) return enemies[i]
}
return null
}

function defenderById(id: number): DefenderRuntime {
for (let i = 0; i < defenders.length; i++) {
if (defenders[i].id == id && defenders[i].epoch == epoch) return defenders[i]
}
return null
}

function effectById(id: number): EffectRuntime {
for (let i = 0; i < effects.length; i++) {
if (effects[i].id == id && effects[i].epoch == epoch) return effects[i]
}
return null
}

function markEnemyForDestroy(id: number): void {
let enemy = enemyById(id)
if (!enemy || enemy.pendingDestroy) return
enemy.pendingDestroy = true
if (!containsNumber(enemyDestroyIds, id)) enemyDestroyIds.push(id)
}

function markDefenderForDestroy(id: number): void {
let defender = defenderById(id)
if (!defender || defender.pendingDestroy) return
defender.pendingDestroy = true
if (!containsNumber(defenderDestroyIds, id)) defenderDestroyIds.push(id)
}

function markEffectForDestroy(id: number): void {
let effect = effectById(id)
if (!effect || effect.pendingDestroy) return
effect.pendingDestroy = true
if (!containsNumber(effectDestroyIds, id)) effectDestroyIds.push(id)
}

function flushDeferred(): void {
if (effectDestroyIds.length > 0) {
for (let i = effects.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
if (containsNumber(effectDestroyIds, effects[i].id)) {
destroyOwnedSprite(effects[i].sprite)
effects.removeAt(i)
}
}
effectDestroyIds = []
}

if (enemyDestroyIds.length > 0) {
for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
if (containsNumber(enemyDestroyIds, enemies[i].id)) {
clearEnemyOccupancy(enemies[i])
destroyEnemySprites(enemies[i])
enemies.removeAt(i)
}
}
enemyDestroyIds = []
}

if (defenderDestroyIds.length > 0) {
for (let i = defenders.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
if (containsNumber(defenderDestroyIds, defenders[i].id)) {
destroyDefenderSprites(defenders[i])
defenders.removeAt(i)
}
}
defenderDestroyIds = []
}
}

function validTile(tile: number): boolean {
return activeLayout != null && tile >= 0 && tile < activeLayout.width * activeLayout.height
}

function tileX(tile: number): number {
if (!activeLayout || activeLayout.width <= 0) return 0
return tile % activeLayout.width
}

function tileY(tile: number): number {
if (!activeLayout || activeLayout.width <= 0) return 0
return Math.idiv(tile, activeLayout.width)
}

function tileCenterX(tile: number): number {
return tileX(tile) * TILE_SIZE + Math.idiv(TILE_SIZE, 2)
}

function tileCenterY(tile: number): number {
return tileY(tile) * TILE_SIZE + Math.idiv(TILE_SIZE, 2)
}

function pixelToTile(x: number, y: number): number {
if (!activeLayout || activeLayout.width <= 0 || activeLayout.height <= 0) return -1
let tx = Math.idiv(Math.max(0, x), TILE_SIZE)
let ty = Math.idiv(Math.max(0, y), TILE_SIZE)
if (tx >= activeLayout.width) tx = activeLayout.width - 1
if (ty >= activeLayout.height) ty = activeLayout.height - 1
return ty * activeLayout.width + tx
}

function distanceSquared(x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number): number {
let dx = x2 - x1
let dy = y2 - y1
return dx * dx + dy * dy
}

function segmentDistance(route: RouteRuntime, index: number): number {
if (!route || index < 0 || index + 1 >= route.tiles.length) return 0
let a = route.tiles[index]
let b = route.tiles[index + 1]
let dx = tileCenterX(b) - tileCenterX(a)
let dy = tileCenterY(b) - tileCenterY(a)
return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
}

function routeById(id: number): RouteRuntime {
for (let i = 0; i < activeRoutes.length; i++) {
if (activeRoutes[i].id == id) return activeRoutes[i]
}
return null
}

function baseRaidCropCount(area: number): number {
// MF-CONTRACT-1.0-COMBAT-SEAMS-01 accepted Farming objective counts.
if (area == 1) return 6
if (area == 2 || area == 3) return 4
if (area == 4) return 5
if (area == 5) return 8
if (area == 6) return 7
if (area == 7) return 4
if (area == 8) return 6
if (area == 9) return 12
if (area == 10) return 7
if (area == 11 || area == 12) return 3
return 0
}

function validAuthoredCropPriority(values: number[], expectedCount: number): boolean {
if (!values || expectedCount <= 0 || values.length != expectedCount) return false
let seen: boolean[] = []
for (let i = 0; i <= expectedCount; i++) seen.push(false)
for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
let localSlot = values[i]
if (localSlot != Math.round(localSlot) || localSlot < 1 || localSlot > expectedCount) return false
if (seen[localSlot]) return false
seen[localSlot] = true
}
return true
}

function allRouteCropPrioritiesValid(): boolean {
let expected = baseRaidCropCount(currentArea)
if (!activeLayout || expected <= 0 || activeLayout.cropTiles.length < expected || activeRoutes.length < 1) return false
for (let i = 0; i < activeRoutes.length; i++) {
if (!activeRoutes[i].cropPriorityValid) return false
}
return true
}

function firstLivingCropForRoute(route: RouteRuntime): number {
if (!route || !route.cropPriorityValid) return -1
for (let i = 0; i < route.cropPriority.length; i++) {
let localSlot = route.cropPriority[i]
if (farmTasks.cropAlive(localSlot)) return localSlot
}
return -1
}

function setEnemyCropObjective(enemy: EnemyRuntime, localSlot: number): boolean {
if (!enemy || !activeLayout || localSlot < 1 || localSlot > activeLayout.cropTiles.length) return false
enemy.objectiveCropSlot = localSlot
let cropTile = activeLayout.cropTiles[localSlot - 1]
enemy.objectiveX = tileCenterX(cropTile)
enemy.objectiveY = tileCenterY(cropTile)
return true
}

function refreshEnemyCropObjective(enemy: EnemyRuntime): boolean {
if (!enemy || enemy.previewOnly) return enemy != null && enemy.objectiveCropSlot > 0
if (enemy.objectiveCropSlot > 0 && farmTasks.cropAlive(enemy.objectiveCropSlot)) return true
let route = routeById(enemy.objectiveRouteId)
let next = firstLivingCropForRoute(route)
if (next < 1) {
enemy.objectiveCropSlot = -1
return false
}
let changed = enemy.objectiveCropSlot != next
if (!setEnemyCropObjective(enemy, next)) return false
// Wisp keeps its current physical position and accumulated journey; changing
// the authored target never teleports/restarts it. If it had arrived at a
// crop that just died, direct flight resumes toward the next living entry.
if (changed && enemy.airborne && enemy.routeId < 0) enemy.reachedObjective = false
return true
}

function buildRouteCache(layout: farmTypes.Layout): void {
activeRoutes = []
if (!layout) return
let expected = baseRaidCropCount(currentArea)
for (let i = 0; i < layout.routes.length; i++) {
let source = layout.routes[i]
let route = new RouteRuntime()
route.id = source.id
for (let j = 0; j < source.tiles.length; j++) route.tiles.push(source.tiles[j])
route.totalLength = 0
for (let j = 0; j + 1 < route.tiles.length; j++) route.totalLength += segmentDistance(route, j)
if (source.cropPriority) {
for (let j = 0; j < source.cropPriority.length; j++) route.cropPriority.push(source.cropPriority[j])
}
route.cropPriorityValid = route.tiles.length > 0 && validAuthoredCropPriority(route.cropPriority, expected)
activeRoutes.push(route)
}
}

function slotById(id: number): farmTypes.Slot {
if (!activeLayout) return null
for (let i = 0; i < activeLayout.defenderSlots.length; i++) {
if (activeLayout.defenderSlots[i].id == id) return activeLayout.defenderSlots[i]
}
return null
}

function reachLookupForTile(tile: number): EnemyReachLookup {
for (let i = 0; i < enemyReachLookups.length; i++) {
if (enemyReachLookups[i].tile == tile) return enemyReachLookups[i]
}
return null
}

function addUniqueSlot(values: number[], slotId: number): void {
if (!containsNumber(values, slotId)) values.push(slotId)
}

function buildEnemyReachLookups(): void {
enemyReachLookups = []
if (!activeLayout) return
// Add one tile only to the precomputed candidate envelope because an enemy
// may be between route-tile centers. Exact world-distance range is checked
// again at acquisition, so this creates no false positive attack.
let hexRangePx = (HEX_MOTH_RANGE_TILES + 1) * TILE_SIZE
let leechRangePx = (MANA_LEECH_RANGE_TILES + 1) * TILE_SIZE
let hexRange2 = hexRangePx * hexRangePx
let leechRange2 = leechRangePx * leechRangePx

for (let r = 0; r < activeRoutes.length; r++) {
let route = activeRoutes[r]
for (let t = 0; t < route.tiles.length; t++) {
let tile = route.tiles[t]
let lookup = reachLookupForTile(tile)
if (!lookup) {
lookup = new EnemyReachLookup()
lookup.tile = tile
enemyReachLookups.push(lookup)
}
let x = tileCenterX(tile)
let y = tileCenterY(tile)
for (let s = 0; s < activeLayout.defenderSlots.length; s++) {
let slot = activeLayout.defenderSlots[s]
let sx = tileCenterX(slot.tile)
let sy = tileCenterY(slot.tile)
let d2 = distanceSquared(x, y, sx, sy)
if (d2 <= hexRange2) addUniqueSlot(lookup.hexSlots, slot.id)
if (d2 <= leechRange2) addUniqueSlot(lookup.leechSlots, slot.id)
}
}
}
}

function enemyRouteLookupTile(enemy: EnemyRuntime): number {
if (!enemy || enemy.routeId < 0) return enemy ? enemy.tile : -1
let route = routeById(enemy.routeId)
if (!route || route.tiles.length < 1) return enemy.tile
let index = enemy.routeIndex
if (index < 0) index = 0
if (index >= route.tiles.length) index = route.tiles.length - 1
return route.tiles[index]
}

function bucketForTile(tile: number, create: boolean): OccupancyBucket {
if (!validTile(tile)) return null
for (let i = 0; i < occupancy.length; i++) {
if (occupancy[i].tile == tile) return occupancy[i]
}
if (!create) return null
let bucket = new OccupancyBucket()
bucket.tile = tile
occupancy.push(bucket)
return bucket
}

function removeEnemyFromBucket(tile: number, id: number): void {
let bucket = bucketForTile(tile, false)
if (!bucket) return
for (let i = bucket.enemyIds.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
if (bucket.enemyIds[i] == id) bucket.enemyIds.removeAt(i)
}
if (bucket.enemyIds.length == 0) {
for (let i = occupancy.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
if (occupancy[i] == bucket) occupancy.removeAt(i)
}
}
}

function addEnemyToBucket(tile: number, id: number): void {
let bucket = bucketForTile(tile, true)
if (!bucket || containsNumber(bucket.enemyIds, id)) return
bucket.enemyIds.push(id)
}

function setEnemyTile(enemy: EnemyRuntime, tile: number): void {
if (!enemy || enemy.tile == tile) return
if (enemy.tile >= 0) removeEnemyFromBucket(enemy.tile, enemy.id)
enemy.tile = tile
if (tile >= 0) addEnemyToBucket(tile, enemy.id)
}

function clearEnemyOccupancy(enemy: EnemyRuntime): void {
if (!enemy) return
if (enemy.tile >= 0) removeEnemyFromBucket(enemy.tile, enemy.id)
enemy.tile = -1
}

function configureGroundRoute(enemy: EnemyRuntime, routeId: number): boolean {
if (!enemy) return false
let route = routeById(routeId)
if (!route || route.tiles.length < 1 || !route.cropPriorityValid) return false
enemy.routeId = routeId
enemy.objectiveRouteId = routeId
enemy.routeIndex = 0
enemy.routeProgress = 0
enemy.initialThreatDistance = 0
enemy.reachedObjective = route.tiles.length == 1
let first = route.tiles[0]
enemy.visualX = tileCenterX(first)
enemy.visualY = tileCenterY(first)
if (enemy.sprite) enemy.sprite.setPosition(enemy.visualX, enemy.visualY)
setEnemyTile(enemy, first)
if (!refreshEnemyCropObjective(enemy)) return false
return true
}

function configureDirectFlight(enemy: EnemyRuntime, startX: number, startY: number, routeId: number, cropSlot: number): boolean {
if (!enemy || !activeLayout || cropSlot < 1 || cropSlot > activeLayout.cropTiles.length) return false
enemy.routeId = -1
enemy.objectiveRouteId = routeId
enemy.routeIndex = -1
enemy.routeProgress = 0
if (!setEnemyCropObjective(enemy, cropSlot)) return false
enemy.visualX = startX
enemy.visualY = startY
let threatDx = enemy.objectiveX - startX
let threatDy = enemy.objectiveY - startY
enemy.initialThreatDistance = Math.sqrt(threatDx * threatDx + threatDy * threatDy)
enemy.directThreatProgressFloor = 0
enemy.reachedObjective = false
if (enemy.sprite) enemy.sprite.setPosition(startX, startY)
setEnemyTile(enemy, pixelToTile(startX, startY))
return true
}

function logicalRoutePosition(enemy: EnemyRuntime): farmTypes.Point {
let point = new farmTypes.Point()
point.x = enemy ? enemy.visualX : 0
point.y = enemy ? enemy.visualY : 0
if (!enemy || enemy.routeId < 0) return point
let route = routeById(enemy.routeId)
if (!route || enemy.routeIndex < 0 || route.tiles.length < 1) return point
if (enemy.routeIndex >= route.tiles.length - 1) {
let terminal = route.tiles[route.tiles.length - 1]
point.x = tileCenterX(terminal)
point.y = tileCenterY(terminal)
return point
}
let length = segmentDistance(route, enemy.routeIndex)
if (length <= 0) {
let tile = route.tiles[enemy.routeIndex]
point.x = tileCenterX(tile)
point.y = tileCenterY(tile)
return point
}
let fromTile = route.tiles[enemy.routeIndex]
let toTile = route.tiles[enemy.routeIndex + 1]
let t = enemy.routeProgress / length
point.x = tileCenterX(fromTile) + (tileCenterX(toTile) - tileCenterX(fromTile)) * t
point.y = tileCenterY(fromTile) + (tileCenterY(toTile) - tileCenterY(fromTile)) * t
return point
}

function updateKnockbackRecovery(enemy: EnemyRuntime, dtMs: number): boolean {
if (!enemy || !enemy.recoveringFromKnockback) return false
let dx = enemy.recoveryX - enemy.visualX
let dy = enemy.recoveryY - enemy.visualY
let distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
let step = enemy.recoverySpeedPxPerSec * dtMs / 1000
if (distance <= 0.5 || step >= distance) {
enemy.visualX = enemy.recoveryX
enemy.visualY = enemy.recoveryY
enemy.recoveringFromKnockback = false
} else if (distance > 0) {
enemy.visualX += dx / distance * step
enemy.visualY += dy / distance * step
}
if (enemy.sprite) enemy.sprite.setPosition(enemy.visualX, enemy.visualY)
setEnemyTile(enemy, pixelToTile(enemy.visualX, enemy.visualY))
return true
}

function moveGroundEnemy(enemy: EnemyRuntime, dtMs: number): void {
if (!enemy || !enemy.alive || enemy.pendingDestroy || enemy.reachedObjective) return
if (enemy.controlHoldMs > 0) return
if (updateKnockbackRecovery(enemy, dtMs)) return
let route = routeById(enemy.routeId)
if (!route || route.tiles.length < 1 || enemy.routeIndex < 0) return

let slow = enemy.controlSlowMs > 0 ? enemy.controlSlowMultiplier : 1
let remaining = enemy.speedPxPerSec * slow * dtMs / 1000
while (remaining > 0 && !enemy.reachedObjective) {
if (enemy.routeIndex >= route.tiles.length - 1) {
enemy.routeIndex = route.tiles.length - 1
enemy.routeProgress = 0
enemy.reachedObjective = true
let terminal = route.tiles[enemy.routeIndex]
enemy.visualX = tileCenterX(terminal)
enemy.visualY = tileCenterY(terminal)
setEnemyTile(enemy, terminal)
break
}

let length = segmentDistance(route, enemy.routeIndex)
if (length <= 0) {
enemy.routeIndex += 1
enemy.routeProgress = 0
continue
}

let available = length - enemy.routeProgress
if (remaining >= available) {
remaining -= available
enemy.routeIndex += 1
enemy.routeProgress = 0
let crossedTile = route.tiles[enemy.routeIndex]
enemy.visualX = tileCenterX(crossedTile)
enemy.visualY = tileCenterY(crossedTile)
setEnemyTile(enemy, crossedTile)
if (enemy.routeIndex >= route.tiles.length - 1) enemy.reachedObjective = true
} else {
enemy.routeProgress += remaining
remaining = 0
let fromTile = route.tiles[enemy.routeIndex]
let toTile = route.tiles[enemy.routeIndex + 1]
let t = enemy.routeProgress / length
enemy.visualX = tileCenterX(fromTile) + (tileCenterX(toTile) - tileCenterX(fromTile)) * t
enemy.visualY = tileCenterY(fromTile) + (tileCenterY(toTile) - tileCenterY(fromTile)) * t
}
}
if (enemy.sprite) enemy.sprite.setPosition(enemy.visualX, enemy.visualY)
}

function moveDirectFlightEnemy(enemy: EnemyRuntime, dtMs: number): void {
if (!enemy || !enemy.alive || enemy.pendingDestroy) return
// Direct-flight enemies reselect immediately when their committed crop dies.
// Their current position and initial journey metric are preserved.
if (!refreshEnemyCropObjective(enemy) || enemy.reachedObjective) return
let dx = enemy.objectiveX - enemy.visualX
let dy = enemy.objectiveY - enemy.visualY
let distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
if (distance <= 0.5) {
enemy.visualX = enemy.objectiveX
enemy.visualY = enemy.objectiveY
enemy.reachedObjective = true
} else {
let slow = enemy.controlSlowMs > 0 ? enemy.controlSlowMultiplier : 1
let step = enemy.speedPxPerSec * slow * dtMs / 1000
if (step >= distance) {
enemy.visualX = enemy.objectiveX
enemy.visualY = enemy.objectiveY
enemy.reachedObjective = true
} else {
enemy.visualX += dx / distance * step
enemy.visualY += dy / distance * step
}
}
if (enemy.sprite) enemy.sprite.setPosition(enemy.visualX, enemy.visualY)
setEnemyTile(enemy, pixelToTile(enemy.visualX, enemy.visualY))
}

function updateEnemyMovement(dtMs: number): void {
for (let i = 0; i < enemies.length; i++) {
let enemy = enemies[i]
if (enemy.epoch != epoch || !enemy.alive || enemy.pendingDestroy) continue
if (enemy.previewOnly) continue
if (enemy.movementPaused) continue
if (enemy.airborne && enemy.routeId < 0) moveDirectFlightEnemy(enemy, dtMs)
else moveGroundEnemy(enemy, dtMs)
}
}

function routeThreatProgress(enemy: EnemyRuntime): number {
if (!enemy || !enemy.alive || enemy.pendingDestroy) return -1
if (enemy.previewOnly && enemy.previewThreat >= 0) return enemy.previewThreat
if (enemy.airborne && enemy.routeId < 0) {
// Sky Wisp uses the same normalized 0..1 vocabulary as route-bound
// enemies: 0 at entry, 1 at the crop objective. This is required so
// target priority remains meaningful in mixed ground/air encounters.
if (enemy.reachedObjective) {
enemy.directThreatProgressFloor = 1
return 1
}
let dx = enemy.objectiveX - enemy.visualX
let dy = enemy.objectiveY - enemy.visualY
let remaining = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
if (enemy.initialThreatDistance <= 0.01) return 1
let candidate = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - remaining / enemy.initialThreatDistance))
if (candidate > enemy.directThreatProgressFloor) enemy.directThreatProgressFloor = candidate
return enemy.directThreatProgressFloor
}
let route = routeById(enemy.routeId)
if (!route || enemy.routeIndex < 0) return -1
if (enemy.reachedObjective || enemy.routeIndex >= route.tiles.length - 1) return 1
if (route.totalLength <= 0.01) return 0
let travelled = 0
for (let i = 0; i < enemy.routeIndex && i + 1 < route.tiles.length; i++) travelled += segmentDistance(route, i)
travelled += Math.max(0, enemy.routeProgress)
return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, travelled / route.totalLength))
}

function enemiesOnTile(tile: number): number[] {
let result: number[] = []
let bucket = bucketForTile(tile, false)
if (!bucket) return result
for (let i = 0; i < bucket.enemyIds.length; i++) {
let enemy = enemyById(bucket.enemyIds[i])
if (enemy && enemy.alive && !enemy.pendingDestroy) result.push(enemy.id)
}
return result
}

function recoverEnemyToForwardRoute(enemy: EnemyRuntime): void {
if (!enemy || enemy.routeId < 0) return
let route = routeById(enemy.routeId)
if (!route || route.tiles.length < 1) return
let start = Math.max(0, enemy.routeIndex)
let bestIndex = start
let bestDistance = 1000000000
for (let i = start; i < route.tiles.length; i++) {
let tile = route.tiles[i]
let d = distanceSquared(enemy.visualX, enemy.visualY, tileCenterX(tile), tileCenterY(tile))
if (d < bestDistance) {
bestDistance = d
bestIndex = i
}
}
enemy.routeIndex = bestIndex
enemy.routeProgress = 0
enemy.reachedObjective = bestIndex >= route.tiles.length - 1
let tile = route.tiles[bestIndex]
enemy.visualX = tileCenterX(tile)
enemy.visualY = tileCenterY(tile)
if (enemy.sprite) enemy.sprite.setPosition(enemy.visualX, enemy.visualY)
setEnemyTile(enemy, tile)
}

function speciesSpeedMultiplier(species: number): number {
if (species == 3) return 1.60
if (species == 4) return 0.80
if (species == 5) return 0.75
if (species == 6) return 0.90
if (species == 7) return 0.90
if (species == 8) return 0.90
if (species == 9) return 1.05
if (species == 10) return 0.85
if (species == 12) return 0.55
if (species == 13) return 1.10
return 1.00
}

function speciesMoveArtKey(species: number): string {
if (species == 1) return "enemy.nibbler.move"
if (species == 2) return "enemy.swarmbug.move"
if (species == 3) return "enemy.sprinter.move"
if (species == 4) return "enemy.regenslime.move"
if (species == 5) return "enemy.shellback.move"
if (species == 6) return "enemy.shieldling.move"
if (species == 7) return "enemy.splitter.move"
if (species == 8) return "enemy.hexmoth.move"
if (species == 9) return "enemy.skywisp.move"
if (species == 10) return "enemy.manaleech.move"
if (species == 11) return "enemy.phasemite.move"
if (species == 12) return "enemy.colossus.move"
if (species == 13) return "enemy.splitterchild.move"
return "enemy.nibbler.move"
}

function speciesHitArtKey(species: number): string {
if (species == 1) return "enemy.nibbler.hit"
if (species == 2) return "enemy.swarmbug.hit"
if (species == 3) return "enemy.sprinter.hit"
if (species == 4) return "enemy.regenslime.hit"
if (species == 5) return "enemy.shellback.hit"
if (species == 6) return "enemy.shieldling.hit"
if (species == 7) return "enemy.splitter.hit"
if (species == 8) return "enemy.hexmoth.hit"
if (species == 9) return "enemy.skywisp.hit"
if (species == 10) return "enemy.manaleech.hit"
if (species == 11) return "enemy.phasemite.hit"
if (species == 12) return "enemy.colossus.hit"
if (species == 13) return "enemy.splitterchild.hit"
return "enemy.nibbler.hit"
}

function speciesCropBiteDamage(species: number): number {
if (species == 4 || species == 5 || species == 6 || species == 7 || species == 11) return 2
if (species == 12) return 4
return 1
}

function speciesCropBiteIntervalMs(species: number): number {
return DEFAULT_CROP_BITE_INTERVAL_MS
}

function configureEnemyMovement(enemy: EnemyRuntime, species: number): void {
if (!enemy) return
enemy.speedPxPerSec = BASE_GROUND_SPEED_PX_PER_SEC * speciesSpeedMultiplier(species)
enemy.airborne = species == 9
enemy.groundContact = !enemy.airborne
}

function speciesMaxHp(species: number): number {
if (species == 1) return 6
if (species == 2) return 3
if (species == 3) return 4
if (species == 4) return 10
if (species == 5) return 12
if (species == 6) return 8
if (species == 7) return 8
if (species == 8) return 7
if (species == 9) return 6
if (species == 10) return 9
if (species == 11) return 8
if (species == 12) return 40
if (species == 13) return 3
return 1
}

function speciesArmor(species: number): number {
if (species == 5) return 2
return 0
}

function speciesMinPositiveDamage(species: number): number {
if (species == 5) return 1
return 0
}

function speciesShieldCharges(species: number): number {
if (species == 6) return 2
return 0
}

function speciesKnockbackMultiplier(species: number): number {
if (species == 12) return 0.20
return 1
}

// Step 5's spawner calls this single initializer so damage state cannot drift
// away from combat.json. It is harmless before enemy creation exists.
function configureEnemyCombat(enemy: EnemyRuntime, species: number): void {
if (!enemy) return
enemy.maxHp = speciesMaxHp(species)
enemy.hp = enemy.maxHp
enemy.armor = speciesArmor(species)
enemy.minPositiveDamage = speciesMinPositiveDamage(species)
enemy.shield = speciesShieldCharges(species)
enemy.knockbackMultiplier = speciesKnockbackMultiplier(species)
enemy.targetable = true
enemy.phased = false
enemy.alive = true
enemy.pendingDestroy = false
enemy.lastDamagedMs = elapsedMs
enemy.actionMs = speciesCropBiteIntervalMs(species)
enemy.biteArmed = false
enemy.regenAccumMs = 0
enemy.moveAnimMs = 0
enemy.hitFlashMs = 0
enemy.moveFrame = 0
enemy.moveImages = [enemy.sprite.image]
enemy.movementPaused = false
enemy.specialActive = false
enemy.specialMs = 0
enemy.reacquireMs = 0
enemy.phaseMs = species == 11 ? PHASE_MITE_SOLID_MS : 0
}

function queueDeathHooks(enemy: EnemyRuntime): void {
if (!enemy) return
// Splitter children are queued only after the killing event reaches the
// death-hook stage. The child species (13) and generation>0 never split.
if (enemy.species == 7 && enemy.generation == 0) {
let request = new ChildRequest()
request.parentId = enemy.id
request.routeId = enemy.routeId
request.tile = enemy.tile
request.routeIndex = enemy.routeIndex
request.routeProgress = enemy.routeProgress
let logical = logicalRoutePosition(enemy)
request.spawnX = logical.x
request.spawnY = logical.y
request.count = 2
request.spawned = 0
request.generation = 1
// With MAX_LIVE_ENEMIES=16 and one two-child split per parent, the
// pending-child unit bound is at most 32 before backpressure drains it.
// Never discard the split consequence merely because creation is delayed.
pendingChildren.push(request)
}
}

function applyEnemyKnockback(enemy: EnemyRuntime, sourceX: number, sourceY: number, knockbackPx: number): boolean {
if (!enemy || knockbackPx <= 0 || enemy.knockbackMultiplier <= 0) return false
let amount = knockbackPx * enemy.knockbackMultiplier
if (amount <= 0) return false

let dx = enemy.visualX - sourceX
let dy = enemy.visualY - sourceY
let length = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
if (length <= 0.01) {
// Deterministic fallback for exact center overlap.
dx = playerFacingX
dy = playerFacingY
length = 1
}
let logical = logicalRoutePosition(enemy)
enemy.visualX += dx / length * amount
enemy.visualY += dy / length * amount
if (enemy.sprite) enemy.sprite.setPosition(enemy.visualX, enemy.visualY)
setEnemyTile(enemy, pixelToTile(enemy.visualX, enemy.visualY))

// Logical route segment/progress remains unchanged. A ground enemy must spend
// time interpolating back to its known route position before forward travel
// resumes. Greater knockback therefore creates a longer delay without pathfinding.
if (enemy.routeId >= 0) {
enemy.recoveringFromKnockback = true
enemy.recoveryX = logical.x
enemy.recoveryY = logical.y
}
return true
}

// One authoritative enemy event pipeline. Later defender primitives/projectiles
// call this same function so shield/armor/phase ordering cannot diverge.
function applyEnemyEffect(enemy: EnemyRuntime, rawDamage: number, damageType: number, requiresGroundContact: boolean, knockbackPx: number, sourceX: number, sourceY: number): DamageResult {
let result = new DamageResult()

// 1. validity
if (!enemy || enemy.epoch != epoch || !enemy.alive || enemy.pendingDestroy) {
result.outcome = OUT_STALE_TARGET
return result
}

// 2. targetability / phase
if (!enemy.targetable || enemy.phased) {
result.outcome = OUT_PHASE_IGNORED
return result
}

// 3. ground-contact compatibility
if (requiresGroundContact && !enemy.groundContact) {
result.outcome = OUT_GROUND_INCOMPATIBLE
return result
}

let hpDamage = Math.max(0, rawDamage)

// 4. hit shield: only a positive damage event consumes one charge. Shield
// blocks HP damage, but ordinary knockback/control still reaches its stage.
if (hpDamage > 0 && enemy.shield > 0) {
enemy.shield -= 1
hpDamage = 0
result.shieldConsumed = true
result.outcome = OUT_SHIELD_ABSORBED
createEffect("effect.shield", 0, SHIELD_EFFECT_MS, enemy.visualX, enemy.visualY, 0)
}

// 5. armor. Piercing alone bypasses flat armor; lightning is ordinary with
// respect to armor. Minimum-positive behavior belongs to armored species.
if (hpDamage > 0 && damageType != DAMAGE_PIERCING && enemy.armor > 0) {
let before = hpDamage
hpDamage = Math.max(enemy.minPositiveDamage, hpDamage - enemy.armor)
if (hpDamage < before) {
result.armorReduced = true
result.outcome = OUT_ARMOR_REDUCED
}
}

// 6. HP
if (hpDamage > 0) {
enemy.hp = Math.max(0, enemy.hp - hpDamage)
enemy.lastDamagedMs = elapsedMs
enemy.regenAccumMs = 0
enemy.hitFlashMs = ENEMY_HIT_FLASH_MS
// Hit art replaces movement art; expiry must restore even the same index.
enemy.moveFrame = -1
if (enemy.sprite) enemy.sprite.setImage(farmArt.frame(speciesHitArtKey(enemy.species), 0))
result.hpDamage = hpDamage
if (enemy.hp <= 0) {
enemy.alive = false
result.killed = true
} else if (!result.shieldConsumed && !result.armorReduced) {
result.outcome = OUT_APPLIED
}
}

// 7. knockback/control. A shield does not suppress normal knockback. A dead
// target may receive this event's final displacement before deferred removal.
if (knockbackPx > 0) {
result.knockbackApplied = applyEnemyKnockback(enemy, sourceX, sourceY, knockbackPx)
if (rawDamage <= 0 && result.knockbackApplied) result.outcome = OUT_CONTROL_APPLIED
}

// 8. death hooks
syncEnemyHealthBar(enemy)
if (result.killed) {
queueDeathHooks(enemy)
markEnemyForDestroy(enemy.id)
result.outcome = OUT_TARGET_DIED
}
return result
}

function routeForSpawn(routeId: number): RouteRuntime {
let route = routeById(routeId)
if (route) return route
if (activeRoutes.length > 0) return activeRoutes[0]
return null
}

function spawnEnemy(species: number, routeId: number, generation: number): EnemyRuntime {
if (!entered || species < 1 || species > 13 || aliveEnemyCount() >= MAX_LIVE_ENEMIES) return null
let route = routeForSpawn(routeId)
if (!route || route.tiles.length < 1) return null

let sprite = sprites.create(farmArt.frame(speciesMoveArtKey(species), 0), EnemyKind)
sprite.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Ghost, true)

let enemy = new EnemyRuntime()
enemy.id = nextActorId
nextActorId += 1
enemy.species = species
enemy.sprite = sprite
enemy.epoch = epoch
enemy.generation = generation
configureEnemyMovement(enemy, species)
configureEnemyCombat(enemy, species)
enemy.controlHoldMs = 0
enemy.controlSlowMs = 0
enemy.controlSlowMultiplier = 1

if (species == 9) {
// Wisp uses the authored route for entry + terminal cropPriority, then
// flies directly in world space. A later destroyed crop reselects from
// this same route order without pathfinding or restarting travel.
let startTile = route.tiles[0]
let cropSlot = firstLivingCropForRoute(route)
if (!configureDirectFlight(enemy, tileCenterX(startTile), tileCenterY(startTile), route.id, cropSlot)) {
destroyOwnedSprite(sprite)
return null
}
} else if (!configureGroundRoute(enemy, route.id)) {
destroyOwnedSprite(sprite)
return null
}
createEnemyVisual(enemy)
enemies.push(enemy)
return enemy
}

function spawnFoundationalEnemy(species: number, routeId: number): EnemyRuntime {
if (species < 1 || species > 6) return null
return spawnEnemy(species, routeId, 0)
}

function splitterNormal(request: ChildRequest): farmTypes.Point {
let result = new farmTypes.Point()
let route = routeById(request.routeId)
if (!route || route.tiles.length < 2) {
result.x = 0
result.y = 1
return result
}
let index = request.routeIndex
if (index < 0) index = 0
if (index >= route.tiles.length - 1) index = route.tiles.length - 2
let a = route.tiles[index]
let b = route.tiles[index + 1]
let dx = tileCenterX(b) - tileCenterX(a)
let dy = tileCenterY(b) - tileCenterY(a)
let length = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
if (length <= 0.01) {
result.x = 0
result.y = 1
} else {
result.x = -dy / length
result.y = dx / length
}
return result
}

function spawnPendingSplitterChild(request: ChildRequest): boolean {
if (!request || request.count <= 0 || aliveEnemyCount() >= MAX_LIVE_ENEMIES) return false
let child = spawnEnemy(13, request.routeId, request.generation)
if (!child) return false
let route = routeById(request.routeId)
if (!route) {
markEnemyForDestroy(child.id)
return false
}

child.routeIndex = request.routeIndex
if (child.routeIndex < 0) child.routeIndex = 0
if (child.routeIndex >= route.tiles.length) child.routeIndex = route.tiles.length - 1
child.routeProgress = request.routeProgress
child.reachedObjective = child.routeIndex >= route.tiles.length - 1
let normal = splitterNormal(request)
let sign = request.spawned % 2 == 0 ? -1 : 1
child.visualX = request.spawnX + normal.x * SPLITTER_CHILD_OFFSET_PX * sign
child.visualY = request.spawnY + normal.y * SPLITTER_CHILD_OFFSET_PX * sign
if (child.sprite) child.sprite.setPosition(child.visualX, child.visualY)
setEnemyTile(child, pixelToTile(child.visualX, child.visualY))
request.spawned += 1
request.count -= 1
return true
}

function processPendingChildren(): void {
for (let i = 0; i < pendingChildren.length;) {
let request = pendingChildren[i]
while (request.count > 0 && aliveEnemyCount() < MAX_LIVE_ENEMIES) {
if (!spawnPendingSplitterChild(request)) break
}
if (request.count <= 0) pendingChildren.removeAt(i)
else i += 1
if (aliveEnemyCount() >= MAX_LIVE_ENEMIES) break
}
}

function animateEnemy(enemy: EnemyRuntime, dtMs: number): void {
if (!enemy || !enemy.sprite || !enemy.alive || enemy.pendingDestroy) return
if (enemy.hitFlashMs > 0) {
enemy.hitFlashMs = Math.max(0, enemy.hitFlashMs - dtMs)
if (enemy.hitFlashMs > 0) return
}
let key = speciesMoveArtKey(enemy.species)
let count = Math.max(1, farmArt.frameCount(key))
let frameMs = farmArt.frameMs(key)
if (frameMs <= 0) frameMs = 120
enemy.moveAnimMs += dtMs
let frame = Math.idiv(enemy.moveAnimMs, frameMs)
if (count > 0) frame = frame % count
if (frame != enemy.moveFrame) {
if (!enemy.moveImages[frame]) enemy.moveImages[frame] = farmArt.frame(key, frame)
enemy.sprite.setImage(enemy.moveImages[frame])
enemy.moveFrame = frame
}
}

function updateRegenSlime(enemy: EnemyRuntime, dtMs: number): void {
if (!enemy || enemy.species != 4 || !enemy.alive || enemy.pendingDestroy) return
if (enemy.hp >= enemy.maxHp) {
enemy.regenAccumMs = 0
return
}
if (elapsedMs - enemy.lastDamagedMs < REGEN_BLOCK_AFTER_DAMAGE_MS) {
enemy.regenAccumMs = 0
return
}
enemy.regenAccumMs += dtMs
while (enemy.regenAccumMs >= REGEN_TICK_MS && enemy.hp < enemy.maxHp) {
enemy.regenAccumMs -= REGEN_TICK_MS
enemy.hp = Math.min(enemy.maxHp, enemy.hp + REGEN_HEAL_PER_TICK)
syncEnemyHealthBar(enemy)
createEffect("effect.regen", 0, REGEN_EFFECT_MS, enemy.visualX, enemy.visualY, 0)
}
}

function updateEnemyCropBite(enemy: EnemyRuntime, dtMs: number): void {
if (!enemy || !enemy.alive || enemy.pendingDestroy || !enemy.reachedObjective) return
if (farmTasks.livingCropCount() <= 0) return
// cropAlive is authoritative and uses the same 1-based local slot IDs as
// cropDamage. Never bite a destroyed/stale objective.
if (!refreshEnemyCropObjective(enemy)) return

if (!enemy.biteArmed) {
enemy.biteArmed = true
enemy.actionMs = speciesCropBiteIntervalMs(enemy.species)
return
}

enemy.actionMs -= dtMs
if (enemy.actionMs > 0) return
if (!farmTasks.cropAlive(enemy.objectiveCropSlot) && !refreshEnemyCropObjective(enemy)) return
enemy.attackViewUntil = elapsedMs + 90
farmTasks.cropDamage(enemy.objectiveCropSlot, speciesCropBiteDamage(enemy.species))
createEffect("effect.shrug", 0, 180, enemy.objectiveX, enemy.objectiveY, 0)
// Damage may have destroyed this crop synchronously. Select the next living
// authored priority immediately, without changing route/travel progress.
if (!farmTasks.cropAlive(enemy.objectiveCropSlot)) refreshEnemyCropObjective(enemy)
enemy.actionMs += speciesCropBiteIntervalMs(enemy.species)
if (enemy.actionMs <= 0) enemy.actionMs = speciesCropBiteIntervalMs(enemy.species)
}

function cropArtStem(crop: number): string {
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.SixShooter) return "sixshooter"
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Twinbud) return "twinbud"
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Mineberry) return "mineberry"
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Rage) return "rage"
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Prism) return "prism"
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sunbeam) return "sunbeam"
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Echo) return "echo"
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Healroot) return "healroot"
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) return "sporecap"
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Lanternleaf) return "lanternleaf"
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Rootsnare) return "rootsnare"
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Stormbloom) return "stormbloom"
return "sixshooter"
}

if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.SixShooter) return "Six-Shooter"
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Twinbud) return "Twinbud"
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Mineberry) return "Mineberry"
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Rage) return "Rage Orchid"
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Prism) return "Prism Bloom"
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sunbeam) return "Sunbeam Lily"
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Echo) return "Echo Mushroom"
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Healroot) return "Healroot"
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) return "Sporecap"
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Lanternleaf) return "Lanternleaf"
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Rootsnare) return "Rootsnare"

return "Defender"
}

function defenderMaxHp(crop: number): number {
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.SixShooter) return 12
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Twinbud) return 12
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Mineberry) return 12
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Rage) return 12
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Prism) return 12
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sunbeam) return 10
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Echo) return 12
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Healroot) return 10
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) return 10
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Lanternleaf) return 11
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Rootsnare) return 14
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Stormbloom) return 14
return 10
}

function progressValue(values: number[], index: number): number {
if (!values || index < 0 || index >= values.length) return 0
return values[index]
}

function upgradeLevel(progress: farmTypes.Progress, upgrade: number): number {
if (!progress || !progress.upgrades || upgrade <= 0 || upgrade >= progress.upgrades.length) return 0
return progress.upgrades[upgrade] == 1 ? 1 : 0
}

function defenderResourceCapacity(crop: number, progress: farmTypes.Progress): number {
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sunbeam) {
return farmTuning.value(farmTypes.Upgrade.Sunlight, upgradeLevel(progress, farmTypes.Upgrade.Sunlight))
}
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) {
let caps = farmTuning.value(farmTypes.Upgrade.Caps, upgradeLevel(progress, farmTypes.Upgrade.Caps))
let spores = farmTuning.value(farmTypes.Upgrade.SporesPerCap, upgradeLevel(progress, farmTypes.Upgrade.SporesPerCap))
return caps * spores
}
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Lanternleaf) {
return farmTuning.value(farmTypes.Upgrade.Charge, upgradeLevel(progress, farmTypes.Upgrade.Charge))
}
return 0
}

function placementAt(progress: farmTypes.Progress, area: number, slotId: number): farmTypes.Placement {
if (!progress || !progress.placements) return null
for (let i = 0; i < progress.placements.length; i++) {
let placement = progress.placements[i]
if (placement && placement.area == area && placement.slot == slotId) return placement
}
return null
}

function placementCount(progress: farmTypes.Progress, area: number): number {
if (!progress || !progress.placements) return 0
let count = 0
for (let i = 0; i < progress.placements.length; i++) {
let placement = progress.placements[i]
if (placement && placement.area == area && validCrop(placement.crop) && slotById(placement.slot)) count += 1
}
return count
}

function placementCropCount(progress: farmTypes.Progress, area: number, crop: number): number {
if (!progress || !progress.placements || !validCrop(crop)) return 0
let count = 0
for (let i = 0; i < progress.placements.length; i++) {
let placement = progress.placements[i]
if (placement && placement.area == area && placement.crop == crop && slotById(placement.slot)) count += 1
}
return count
}

function defenderCapForArea(area: number): number {
if (area <= 1) return 0
if (area == 2) return 2
if (area == 3 || area == 4) return 3
if (area == 5 || area == 6 || area == 7) return 4
if (area == 8 || area == 9 || area == 10) return 5
if (area == 11 || area == 12) return 6
return 0
}

function requiredDefenderCrop(area: number): number {
if (area < 2 || area > 12) return 0
return area - 1
}

function isPrepPhase(progress: farmTypes.Progress, area: number): boolean {
if (!progress || !progress.phase || area < 0 || area >= progress.phase.length) return false
return progress.phase[area] == farmTypes.Phase.Prep
}

function powerEarned(progress: farmTypes.Progress, crop: number): boolean {
return validCrop(crop) && progressValue(progress ? progress.powerEarned : null, crop) != 0
}

function compatibleEnergyCompanionPresent(progress: farmTypes.Progress, area: number): boolean {
return placementCropCount(progress, area, farmTypes.Crop.Sunbeam) > 0 || placementCropCount(progress, area, farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) > 0
}

function clearDefenderSpritesOnly(): void {
for (let i = 0; i < defenders.length; i++) destroyDefenderSprites(defenders[i])
defenders = []
defenderDestroyIds = []
}

function createDefenderFromPlacement(placement: farmTypes.Placement, progress: farmTypes.Progress): DefenderRuntime {
if (!placement || placement.area != currentArea || !validCrop(placement.crop)) return null
let slot = slotById(placement.slot)
if (!slot) return null

let defender = new DefenderRuntime()
defender.id = nextActorId++
defender.crop = placement.crop
defender.slot = placement.slot
defender.epoch = epoch
defender.maxHp = defenderMaxHp(placement.crop)
defender.hp = defender.maxHp
// Battle immobilization is transient. World roots durable placements only
// after victory; its pre-raid snapshot retains adjustable staged records.
defender.rooted = placement.rooted || raidWorldCommitted(progress, placement.area)
defender.wilted = false
defender.pendingDestroy = false
defender.resourceCap = defenderResourceCapacity(placement.crop, progress)
defender.resource = defender.resourceCap
defender.resourceMs = 0
defender.actionMs = 0
defender.engagedEnemyId = -1
defender.sporeLoaded = []
defender.sporeActive = false
defender.sporeNextIndex = 0
if (placement.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) {
for (let i = 0; i < defender.resourceCap; i++) defender.sporeLoaded.push(1)
}

// Art has rooted/attack/wilted states, not a separate staged sprite. The
// same healthy plant image is used while staged; rooted controls gameplay.
defender.sprite = sprites.create(image.create(16, 16), DefenderKind)
defender.visual = sprites.create(farmArt.frame("crop." + cropArtStem(placement.crop) + ".rooted", 0), DefenderKind)
defender.sprite.setPosition(tileCenterX(slot.tile), tileCenterY(slot.tile))
farmPlantArt.place(defender.visual, defender.sprite.x, defender.sprite.y)
return defender
}

function rebuildDefendersFromWorld(): void {
clearDefenderSpritesOnly()
if (!entered || !activeLayout) return
let progress = farmWorld.progress()
if (!progress || !progress.placements) return
let usedSlots: number[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < progress.placements.length; i++) {
let placement = progress.placements[i]
if (!placement || placement.area != currentArea || !validCrop(placement.crop)) continue
if (!slotById(placement.slot) || containsNumber(usedSlots, placement.slot)) continue
let defender = createDefenderFromPlacement(placement, progress)
if (!defender) continue
defenders.push(defender)
usedSlots.push(placement.slot)
}
}

function availableDefenderCrops(progress: farmTypes.Progress): number[] {
let crops: number[] = []
if (!progress || !progress.inventory) return crops
for (let crop = MIN_CROP; crop <= MAX_CROP; crop++) {
if (progressValue(progress.inventory, crop) > 0) crops.push(crop)
}
return crops
}

function defenderOptionLabel(crop: number, count: number): string {
return cropDisplayName(crop) + " x" + count
}

function stageDefenderAtSlot(slotId: number): boolean {
let progress = farmWorld.progress()
if (!isPrepPhase(progress, currentArea)) {
farmWorld.notice("Defender setup is only available before Ready.")
return true
}
if (placementAt(progress, currentArea, slotId)) return true
let cap = defenderCapForArea(currentArea)
if (cap <= 0) {
farmWorld.notice("Starter plants guard these beds. No power defender is needed yet.")
return true
}
if (placementCount(progress, currentArea) >= cap) {
farmWorld.notice("Defender limit reached: " + cap)
return true
}

let crops = availableDefenderCrops(progress)
if (crops.length == 0) {
farmWorld.notice("NO DEFENDERS READY")
return true
}
let options: string[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < crops.length; i++) {
options.push(defenderOptionLabel(crops[i], progressValue(progress.inventory, crops[i])))
}

let openEpoch = epoch
let openArea = currentArea
let opened = farmWorld.choose("DEFENDER TRAY", options, function(choice: number) {
if (!entered || epoch != openEpoch || currentArea != openArea) return
if (choice < 0 || choice >= crops.length) return
let latest = farmWorld.progress()
if (!isPrepPhase(latest, openArea)) {
farmWorld.notice("Defender setup is closed.")
return
}
if (placementAt(latest, openArea, slotId)) {
farmWorld.notice("That defender slot is already occupied.")
rebuildDefendersFromWorld()
return
}
let currentCap = defenderCapForArea(openArea)
if (placementCount(latest, openArea) >= currentCap) {
farmWorld.notice("Defender limit reached: " + currentCap)
rebuildDefendersFromWorld()
return
}
let crop = crops[choice]
if (progressValue(latest.inventory, crop) <= 0) {
farmWorld.notice("That defender is no longer available.")
rebuildDefendersFromWorld()
return
}
let placement = new farmTypes.Placement()
placement.area = openArea
placement.slot = slotId
placement.crop = crop
placement.rooted = false
if (!farmWorld.putPlacement(placement)) {
farmWorld.notice("Could not stage that defender.")
rebuildDefendersFromWorld()
return
}
rebuildDefendersFromWorld()
})
return opened
}

function interactDefenderSlot(slotId: number): boolean {
if (!slotById(slotId)) return false
let progress = farmWorld.progress()
let placement = placementAt(progress, currentArea, slotId)
if (placement) {
if (placement.rooted) {
farmWorld.notice(cropDisplayName(placement.crop) + " is rooted here.")
return true
}
if (!isPrepPhase(progress, currentArea)) {
farmWorld.notice("Defender setup is closed.")
return true
}
if (farmWorld.removePlacement(currentArea, slotId)) {
rebuildDefendersFromWorld()
} else {
farmWorld.notice("Could not pick up that defender.")
rebuildDefendersFromWorld()
}
return true
}
return stageDefenderAtSlot(slotId)
}

function destroyDefenderSprites(defender: DefenderRuntime): void {
destroyOwnedSprite(defender.sprite)
destroyOwnedSprite(defender.visual)
destroyOwnedSprite(defender.cueSprite)
}

function defenderAnchorX(defender: DefenderRuntime): number {
if (defender && defender.sprite) return defender.sprite.x
let slot = defender ? slotById(defender.slot) : null
return slot ? tileCenterX(slot.tile) : 0
}

function defenderAnchorY(defender: DefenderRuntime): number {
if (defender && defender.sprite) return defender.sprite.y
let slot = defender ? slotById(defender.slot) : null
return slot ? tileCenterY(slot.tile) : 0
}

function activeRootedDefender(defender: DefenderRuntime): boolean {
return defender != null && defender.epoch == epoch && defender.rooted && !defender.wilted && !defender.pendingDestroy && defender.hp > 0
}

function maskForSlotKindRadius(slotId: number, kind: number, radius: number): farmTypes.Mask {
if (!activeLayout) return null
for (let i = 0; i < activeLayout.masks.length; i++) {
let mask = activeLayout.masks[i]
if (mask.slot == slotId && mask.kind == kind && mask.radius == radius) return mask
}
return null
}

function maskCenter(mask: farmTypes.Mask): farmTypes.Point {
let point = new farmTypes.Point()
if (!mask || mask.tiles.length == 0) return point
let x = 0
let y = 0
for (let i = 0; i < mask.tiles.length; i++) {
x += tileCenterX(mask.tiles[i])
y += tileCenterY(mask.tiles[i])
}
point.x = Math.idiv(x, mask.tiles.length)
point.y = Math.idiv(y, mask.tiles.length)
return point
}

function validDefenderEnemyTarget(enemy: EnemyRuntime, requiresGroundContact: boolean): boolean {
if (!enemy || enemy.epoch != epoch || !enemy.alive || enemy.pendingDestroy) return false
if (!enemy.targetable || enemy.phased) return false
if (requiresGroundContact && !enemy.groundContact) return false
return true
}

function rangeTilesForSlot(slot: farmTypes.Slot, radiusTiles: number): number[] {
let empty: number[] = []
if (!slot) return empty
let mask = maskForSlotKindRadius(slot.id, 1, radiusTiles)
if (mask && mask.tiles.length > 0) return mask.tiles
return slot.rangeTiles
}

function enemyInDefenderRange(defender: DefenderRuntime, enemy: EnemyRuntime, radiusTiles: number, requiresGroundContact: boolean): boolean {
if (!activeRootedDefender(defender) || !validDefenderEnemyTarget(enemy, requiresGroundContact)) return false
// Direct-flight Wisps leave authored ground-route cells. Ordinary ranged
// attacks still reach them inside the actual tuned world-space radius.
if (enemy.airborne) return airborneInDefenderRadius(defender, enemy, radiusTiles)
let slot = slotById(defender.slot)
if (!slot) return false
let tiles = rangeTilesForSlot(slot, radiusTiles)
return containsNumber(tiles, enemy.tile)
}

function airborneInDefenderRadius(defender: DefenderRuntime, enemy: EnemyRuntime, radiusTiles: number): boolean {
if (!defender || !enemy || !enemy.airborne || radiusTiles <= 0) return false
let radiusPx = radiusTiles * TILE_SIZE
return distanceSquared(defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender), enemy.visualX, enemy.visualY) <= radiusPx * radiusPx
}

function candidateEnemiesForDefender(defender: DefenderRuntime, requiresGroundContact: boolean, radiusTiles: number): EnemyRuntime[] {
let result: EnemyRuntime[] = []
if (!activeRootedDefender(defender)) return result
let slot = slotById(defender.slot)
if (!slot) return result
let tiles = rangeTilesForSlot(slot, radiusTiles)
let seen: number[] = []
for (let t = 0; t < tiles.length; t++) {
let ids = enemiesOnTile(tiles[t])
for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
if (containsNumber(seen, ids[i])) continue
let enemy = enemyById(ids[i])
if (!validDefenderEnemyTarget(enemy, requiresGroundContact)) continue
if (defender.previewOnly != enemy.previewOnly) continue
if (enemy.airborne && !airborneInDefenderRadius(defender, enemy, radiusTiles)) continue
result.push(enemy)
seen.push(ids[i])
}
}
// The existing enemy cap bounds this additional pass. Ground acquisition
// keeps its authored masks; only airborne candidates use physical radius.
for (let i = 0; i < enemies.length; i++) {
let enemy = enemies[i]
if (containsNumber(seen, enemy.id) || !enemy.airborne) continue
if (!validDefenderEnemyTarget(enemy, requiresGroundContact)) continue
if (defender.previewOnly != enemy.previewOnly) continue
if (!airborneInDefenderRadius(defender, enemy, radiusTiles)) continue
result.push(enemy)
seen.push(enemy.id)
}
return result
}

function chooseNearestEnemyForDefender(defender: DefenderRuntime, radiusTiles: number): EnemyRuntime {
let candidates = candidateEnemiesForDefender(defender, false, radiusTiles)
let best: EnemyRuntime = null
let bestDistance = 1000000000
for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
let enemy = candidates[i]
let d2 = distanceSquared(defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender), enemy.visualX, enemy.visualY)
if (d2 < bestDistance || (d2 == bestDistance && (!best || enemy.id < best.id))) {
best = enemy
bestDistance = d2
}
}
return best
}

function chooseThreatEnemyForDefender(defender: DefenderRuntime, greatest: boolean, avoidId: number, radiusTiles: number): EnemyRuntime {
let candidates = candidateEnemiesForDefender(defender, false, radiusTiles)
let best: EnemyRuntime = null
let bestProgress = greatest ? -1000000000 : 1000000000
let hasAlternative = false
if (avoidId >= 0) {
for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
if (candidates[i].id != avoidId) {
hasAlternative = true
break
}
}
}
for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
let enemy = candidates[i]
if (hasAlternative && enemy.id == avoidId) continue
let progress = routeThreatProgress(enemy)
let better = greatest ? progress > bestProgress : progress < bestProgress
if (better || (progress == bestProgress && (!best || enemy.id < best.id))) {
best = enemy
bestProgress = progress
}
}
return best
}

function chooseSporecapTarget(defender: DefenderRuntime): EnemyRuntime {
let candidates = candidateEnemiesForDefender(defender, false, SPORECAP_RANGE_TILES)
let bestAir: EnemyRuntime = null
let bestAirProgress = -1000000000
let bestAny: EnemyRuntime = null
let bestAnyProgress = -1000000000
for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
let enemy = candidates[i]
let progress = routeThreatProgress(enemy)
if (progress > bestAnyProgress || (progress == bestAnyProgress && (!bestAny || enemy.id < bestAny.id))) {
bestAny = enemy
bestAnyProgress = progress
}
if (enemy.airborne && (progress > bestAirProgress || (progress == bestAirProgress && (!bestAir || enemy.id < bestAir.id)))) {
bestAir = enemy
bestAirProgress = progress
}
}
return bestAir ? bestAir : bestAny
}

function chooseRootsnareTarget(defender: DefenderRuntime): EnemyRuntime {
let candidates = candidateEnemiesForDefender(defender, true, ROOTSNARE_RANGE_TILES)
let reach = capturedUpgradeValue(farmWorld.progress(), farmTypes.Upgrade.SnareReach)
let contact = rootsnareMask(defender, reach)
if (!contact) return null
let best: EnemyRuntime = null
let bestProgress = -1000000000
for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
let enemy = candidates[i]
if (!containsNumber(contact.tiles, enemy.tile)) continue
let progress = routeThreatProgress(enemy)
if (progress > bestProgress || (progress == bestProgress && (!best || enemy.id < best.id))) {
best = enemy
bestProgress = progress
}
}
return best
}

function chooseStormbloomTarget(defender: DefenderRuntime): EnemyRuntime {
return chooseThreatEnemyForDefender(defender, true, -1, STORMBLOOM_RANGE_TILES)
}

function enemyConductive(enemy: EnemyRuntime): boolean {
if (!validDefenderEnemyTarget(enemy, false)) return false
if (enemy.species == 9) return true
if (enemy.species == 6) return enemy.shield > 0
if (enemy.species == 10) return enemy.specialActive && enemy.targetId >= 0
return false
}

function defenderHasPowerTarget(defender: DefenderRuntime): boolean {
if (!activeRootedDefender(defender)) return false
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.SixShooter) return chooseNearestEnemyForDefender(defender, SIX_SHOOTER_RANGE_TILES) != null
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Twinbud) return chooseThreatEnemyForDefender(defender, true, -1, TWINBUD_RANGE_TILES) != null
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Rage) {
return chooseThreatEnemyForDefender(defender, true, -1, RAGE_RANGE_TILES) != null
}
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Prism) return chooseThreatEnemyForDefender(defender, true, -1, PRISM_RANGE_TILES) != null
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sunbeam) {
return defender.resource > 0 && chooseThreatEnemyForDefender(defender, true, -1, SUNBEAM_RANGE_TILES) != null
}
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Echo) return echoHasGroundTarget(defender)
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Healroot) return healrootHasDamagedAlly(defender)
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) {
return defender.resourceCap > 0 && defender.resource >= defender.resourceCap && chooseSporecapTarget(defender) != null
}
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Lanternleaf) {
return defender.resource > 0 && totalCompatibleMissingEnergy(defender) > 0
}
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Rootsnare) return chooseRootsnareTarget(defender) != null
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Stormbloom) return chooseStormbloomTarget(defender) != null
return false
}

function defenderAtSlot(slotId: number): DefenderRuntime {
for (let i = 0; i < defenders.length; i++) {
let defender = defenders[i]
if (defender.slot == slotId && activeRootedDefender(defender)) return defender
}
return null
}

function damageDefender(defender: DefenderRuntime, damage: number): boolean {
if (!activeRootedDefender(defender) || damage <= 0) return false
defender.hp = Math.max(0, defender.hp - damage)
if (defender.hp <= 0) {
defender.wilted = true
defender.engagedEnemyId = -1
defender.resource = Math.max(0, defender.resource)
if (defender.visual) {
defender.visual.setImage(farmArt.frame("crop." + cropArtStem(defender.crop) + ".wilted", 0))
farmPlantArt.place(defender.visual, defender.sprite.x, defender.sprite.y)
}
}
return true
}

function candidateSlotsForEnemy(enemy: EnemyRuntime, leech: boolean): number[] {
let empty: number[] = []
if (!enemy) return empty
let lookup = reachLookupForTile(enemyRouteLookupTile(enemy))
if (!lookup) return empty
return leech ? lookup.leechSlots : lookup.hexSlots
}

function targetInRange(enemy: EnemyRuntime, defender: DefenderRuntime, rangeTiles: number): boolean {
if (!enemy || !activeRootedDefender(defender)) return false
let range = rangeTiles * TILE_SIZE
return distanceSquared(enemy.visualX, enemy.visualY, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender)) <= range * range
}

function chooseDefenderTarget(enemy: EnemyRuntime, leech: boolean): DefenderRuntime {
let candidates = candidateSlotsForEnemy(enemy, leech)
let best: DefenderRuntime = null
let bestDistance = 1000000000
let bestSlot = 1000000
for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
let defender = defenderAtSlot(candidates[i])
if (!defender) continue
if (leech && (defender.resourceCap <= 0 || defender.resource <= 0)) continue
let rangeTiles = leech ? MANA_LEECH_RANGE_TILES : HEX_MOTH_RANGE_TILES
if (!targetInRange(enemy, defender, rangeTiles)) continue
let d2 = distanceSquared(enemy.visualX, enemy.visualY, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender))
if (d2 < bestDistance || (d2 == bestDistance && defender.slot < bestSlot)) {
best = defender
bestDistance = d2
bestSlot = defender.slot
}
}
return best
}

function clearEnemySpecialTarget(enemy: EnemyRuntime): void {
if (!enemy) return
enemy.targetId = -1
enemy.specialActive = false
enemy.movementPaused = false
enemy.specialMs = 0
}

function enemyTargetDefender(enemy: EnemyRuntime): DefenderRuntime {
if (!enemy || enemy.targetId < 0) return null
return defenderById(enemy.targetId)
}

function showEnemyToDefenderEffect(enemy: EnemyRuntime, defender: DefenderRuntime, key: string, ttlMs: number, kind: number): void {
if (!enemy || !defender) return
let x = Math.idiv(enemy.visualX + defenderAnchorX(defender), 2)
let y = Math.idiv(enemy.visualY + defenderAnchorY(defender), 2)
let effect = createEffect(key, 0, ttlMs, x, y, kind)
if (effect) {
effect.sourceActorId = enemy.id
effect.targetActorId = defender.id
}
}

function updateHexMoth(enemy: EnemyRuntime, dtMs: number): void {
if (!enemy || enemy.species != 8 || !enemy.alive || enemy.pendingDestroy) return
