if (!context || context.cursor <= 0) return null
let index = context.cursor - 1
if (index < 0 || index >= context.data[TD_SNAPSHOT_COUNT]) return null
return enemyById(snapshotId(context, index))
}

function prismCurrentAimX(context: farmTypes.Context): number {
if (!context || context.cursor <= 0) return 0
return snapshotX(context, context.cursor - 1)
}

function prismCurrentAimY(context: farmTypes.Context): number {
if (!context || context.cursor <= 0) return 0
return snapshotY(context, context.cursor - 1)
}

function prismFinalizePrevious(context: farmTypes.Context): void {
if (!context) return
if (context.data[TD_EXPECTED_BRANCH] >= 0 && context.data[TD_BRANCH_HANDLED] == 0) {
context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] += 1
}
context.data[TD_EXPECTED_BRANCH] = -1
context.data[TD_BRANCH_HANDLED] = 1
}

function prismInspect(context: farmTypes.Context): number {
let defender = defenderById(context.actorId)
if (!defender) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
prismFinalizePrevious(context)
let count = context.data[TD_SNAPSHOT_COUNT]
if (context.cursor >= count) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
createEffect("effect.shrug", 0, 180, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender), 0)
return OUT_EXHAUSTED_ANATOMY
}
let index = context.cursor
context.cursor += 1
context.data[TD_COUNT_A] += 1
context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] = farmTypes.Action.InspectEnemy
showPreviewProgress(context, farmTypes.Action.InspectEnemy, 0)
let target = enemyById(snapshotId(context, index))
context.data[TD_TARGET_ID] = target ? target.id : -1
context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_X] = snapshotX(context, index)
context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_Y] = snapshotY(context, index)
if (target) {
context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_X] = target.visualX
context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_Y] = target.visualY
createEffect("effect.threat", 0, 180, target.visualX, target.visualY - 6, 0)
} else {
createEffect("effect.threat", 0, 180, context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_X], context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_Y], 0)
}
context.data[TD_EXPECTED_BRANCH] = -1
context.data[TD_BRANCH_HANDLED] = 0
return target ? OUT_APPLIED : OUT_STALE_TARGET
}

function prismArmored(context: farmTypes.Context): boolean {
if (!context || context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] != farmTypes.Action.InspectEnemy || context.cursor <= 0) return false
let target = prismCurrentTarget(context)
let armored = target != null && target.armor > 0
context.data[TD_EXPECTED_BRANCH] = armored ? farmTypes.Action.Pierce : farmTypes.Action.Splash
return armored
}

function createMovingEffect(key: string, sourceX: number, sourceY: number, aimX: number, aimY: number, speed: number, ttlExtra: number): number {
let dx = aimX - sourceX
let dy = aimY - sourceY
let distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
if (distance < 1) distance = TILE_SIZE
let actualSpeed = Math.max(1, speed)
let travelMs = Math.max(1, Math.round(distance * 1000 / actualSpeed))
let effect = createEffect(key, 0, travelMs + ttlExtra, sourceX, sourceY, 0)
if (effect && effect.sprite) {
let length = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
if (length <= 0.01) {
effect.sprite.vx = actualSpeed
effect.sprite.vy = 0
} else {
effect.sprite.vx = dx / length * actualSpeed
effect.sprite.vy = dy / length * actualSpeed
}
effect.capturedX = aimX
effect.capturedY = aimY
}
return travelMs
}

function prismPierce(context: farmTypes.Context): number {
let defender = defenderById(context.actorId)
if (!defender) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
if (context.cursor <= 0 || context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] == farmTypes.Action.Pierce || context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] == farmTypes.Action.Splash) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
return OUT_NO_CURRENT_TARGET
}
if (context.data[TD_EXPECTED_BRANCH] >= 0 && context.data[TD_EXPECTED_BRANCH] != farmTypes.Action.Pierce) {
context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] += 1
}
context.data[TD_BRANCH_HANDLED] = 1
context.data[TD_COUNT_B] += 1
context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] = farmTypes.Action.Pierce
showPreviewProgress(context, farmTypes.Action.Pierce, 0)
let target = prismCurrentTarget(context)
let aimX = target ? target.visualX : prismCurrentAimX(context)
let aimY = target ? target.visualY : prismCurrentAimY(context)
if (aimX == 0 && aimY == 0) {
aimX = defaultAimX(defender)
aimY = defaultAimY(defender)
}
setDefenderAttackImage(defender)
let travelMs = createMovingEffect("effect.pollen.pierce", defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender), aimX, aimY, PRISM_PROJECTILE_SPEED, 80)
pause(travelMs)
restoreDefenderImage(defender)
if (!target) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
let live = enemyById(target.id)
if (!live) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
return applyEnemyEffect(live, PRISM_PIERCE_DAMAGE, DAMAGE_PIERCING, false, PRISM_KNOCKBACK_PX, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender)).outcome
}

function prismSplash(context: farmTypes.Context): number {
let defender = defenderById(context.actorId)
if (!defender) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
if (context.cursor <= 0 || context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] == farmTypes.Action.Pierce || context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] == farmTypes.Action.Splash) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
return OUT_NO_CURRENT_TARGET
}
if (context.data[TD_EXPECTED_BRANCH] >= 0 && context.data[TD_EXPECTED_BRANCH] != farmTypes.Action.Splash) {
context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] += 1
}
context.data[TD_BRANCH_HANDLED] = 1
context.data[TD_COUNT_B] += 1
context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] = farmTypes.Action.Splash
showPreviewProgress(context, farmTypes.Action.Splash, 0)
let target = prismCurrentTarget(context)
let aimX = target ? target.visualX : prismCurrentAimX(context)
let aimY = target ? target.visualY : prismCurrentAimY(context)
if (aimX == 0 && aimY == 0) {
aimX = defaultAimX(defender)
aimY = defaultAimY(defender)
}
setDefenderAttackImage(defender)
let travelMs = createMovingEffect("effect.pollen.splash", defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender), aimX, aimY, PRISM_PROJECTILE_SPEED, 80)
pause(travelMs)
restoreDefenderImage(defender)
if (!target) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
let live = enemyById(target.id)
if (!live) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
let originTile = live.tile
let directId = live.id
let direct = applyEnemyEffect(live, PRISM_SPLASH_DIRECT_DAMAGE, DAMAGE_ORDINARY, false, PRISM_KNOCKBACK_PX, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender))
// The projectile's captured target is the splash anchor. If that target
// became phased/invalid before arrival, the projectile passes through or
// bursts harmlessly; it must not manufacture an AoE around an untargetable
// anchor. Shield/armor/death still allow this same landed event's AoE.
if (direct.outcome == OUT_PHASE_IGNORED || direct.outcome == OUT_STALE_TARGET) return direct.outcome
let mask = maskForOriginTile(3, originTile)
if (!mask) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
return direct.outcome
}
let hitIds: number[] = []
for (let t = 0; t < mask.tiles.length; t++) {
let ids = enemiesOnTile(mask.tiles[t])
for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
let id = ids[i]
if (id == directId || containsNumber(hitIds, id)) continue
let enemy = enemyById(id)
if (!validDefenderEnemyTarget(enemy, false)) continue
hitIds.push(id)
applyEnemyEffect(enemy, PRISM_SPLASH_AREA_DAMAGE, DAMAGE_ORDINARY, false, PRISM_KNOCKBACK_PX, aimX, aimY)
}
}
return direct.outcome
}

function sunbeamBeam(context: farmTypes.Context): number {
let defender = defenderById(context.actorId)
if (!defender) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
context.data[TD_COUNT_A] += 1
context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] = farmTypes.Action.Beam
if (context.resource <= 0 || defender.resource <= 0) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
createEffect("effect.shrug", 0, 160, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender) - 5, 0)
pause(SUNBEAM_PULSE_MS)
return OUT_DRY_RESOURCE
}
context.resource -= 1
defender.resource = Math.max(0, defender.resource - 1)
defender.resourceMs = 0
context.data[TD_RESOURCE_USED] += 1
showPreviewProgress(context, farmTypes.Action.Beam, 0)

let target = chooseThreatEnemyForDefender(defender, true, -1, SUNBEAM_RANGE_TILES)
let aimX = contextAimX(context, false)
let aimY = contextAimY(context, false)
if (target) {
aimX = target.visualX
aimY = target.visualY
setContextAim(context, false, aimX, aimY)
} else if (aimX == 0 && aimY == 0) {
aimX = defaultAimX(defender)
aimY = defaultAimY(defender)
}
setDefenderAttackImage(defender)
let x = Math.idiv(defenderAnchorX(defender) + aimX, 2)
let y = Math.idiv(defenderAnchorY(defender) + aimY, 2)
let effect = createEffect("effect.beam", 0, SUNBEAM_PULSE_MS, x, y, 0)
if (effect) {
effect.sourceActorId = defender.id
effect.targetActorId = target ? target.id : -1
effect.capturedX = aimX
effect.capturedY = aimY
}
let outcome = OUT_VISUAL_NO_TARGET
if (target) outcome = applyEnemyEffect(target, SUNBEAM_DAMAGE, DAMAGE_ORDINARY, false, 0, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender)).outcome
pause(SUNBEAM_PULSE_MS)
restoreDefenderImage(defender)
return outcome
}

function echoPulse(context: farmTypes.Context, value: number): number {
let defender = defenderById(context.actorId)
if (!defender) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
let capacity = contextPrimaryValue(context)
context.data[TD_COUNT_A] += 1
context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] = farmTypes.Action.Pulse
showPreviewProgress(context, farmTypes.Action.Pulse, value)
if (value <= 0 || value > capacity || value != Math.round(value)) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
createEffect("effect.ring", 0, 120, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender), 0)
pause(ECHO_PULSE_MS)
return OUT_INVALID_VALUE
}
let expected = context.data[TD_ECHO_LAST_RADIUS] + 1
if (value != expected) context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] += 1
context.data[TD_ECHO_LAST_RADIUS] = value
let mask = echoMask(defender, value)
if (!mask) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
pause(ECHO_PULSE_MS)
return OUT_INVALID_VALUE
}

setDefenderAttackImage(defender)
createEffect("effect.ring", 0, ECHO_PULSE_MS, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender), 0)
let hitIds: number[] = []
for (let t = 0; t < mask.tiles.length; t++) {
let ids = enemiesOnTile(mask.tiles[t])
for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
let id = ids[i]
if (containsNumber(hitIds, id)) continue
let enemy = enemyById(id)
if (!validDefenderEnemyTarget(enemy, true)) continue
hitIds.push(id)
applyEnemyEffect(enemy, ECHO_DAMAGE, DAMAGE_ORDINARY, true, ECHO_KNOCKBACK_PX, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender))
}
}
pause(ECHO_PULSE_MS)
restoreDefenderImage(defender)
return OUT_APPLIED
}

function healrootFinalizePrevious(context: farmTypes.Context): void {
if (!context) return
if (context.data[TD_INSPECT_EXPECTED] == 1 && context.data[TD_BRANCH_HANDLED] == 0) {
context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] += 1
}
context.data[TD_INSPECT_EXPECTED] = -1
context.data[TD_BRANCH_HANDLED] = 1
}

function healrootInspect(context: farmTypes.Context): number {
let defender = defenderById(context.actorId)
if (!defender) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
healrootFinalizePrevious(context)
let capacity = contextPrimaryValue(context)
if (context.cursor >= capacity) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
createEffect("effect.shrug", 0, 160, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender), 0)
return OUT_EXHAUSTED_ANATOMY
}
let index = context.cursor
context.cursor += 1
context.data[TD_COUNT_A] += 1
context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] = farmTypes.Action.InspectAlly
showPreviewProgress(context, farmTypes.Action.InspectAlly, 0)
let id = snapshotId(context, index)
let ally = defenderById(id)
context.data[TD_TARGET_ID] = ally ? ally.id : -1
context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_X] = snapshotX(context, index)
context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_Y] = snapshotY(context, index)
let damaged = ally != null && activeRootedDefender(ally) && ally.hp > 0 && ally.hp < ally.maxHp
context.data[TD_INSPECT_EXPECTED] = damaged ? 1 : 0
context.data[TD_BRANCH_HANDLED] = damaged ? 0 : 1
let linkX = ally ? Math.idiv(defenderAnchorX(defender) + defenderAnchorX(ally), 2) : defenderAnchorX(defender)
let linkY = ally ? Math.idiv(defenderAnchorY(defender) + defenderAnchorY(ally), 2) : defenderAnchorY(defender) - 5
createEffect("effect.heal", 0, 140, linkX, linkY, 0)
return ally ? OUT_APPLIED : OUT_NO_CURRENT_TARGET
}

function healrootDamagedAlly(context: farmTypes.Context): boolean {
if (!context || context.cursor <= 0) return false
let ally = defenderById(context.data[TD_TARGET_ID])
let damaged = ally != null && activeRootedDefender(ally) && ally.hp > 0 && ally.hp < ally.maxHp
context.data[TD_INSPECT_EXPECTED] = damaged ? 1 : 0
if (!damaged) context.data[TD_BRANCH_HANDLED] = 1
return damaged
}

function healrootHeal(context: farmTypes.Context): number {
let defender = defenderById(context.actorId)
if (!defender) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
context.data[TD_HEAL_ATTEMPTS] += 1
context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] = farmTypes.Action.Heal
showPreviewProgress(context, farmTypes.Action.Heal, 0)
if (context.cursor <= 0) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
createEffect("effect.heal", 0, HEALROOT_ACTION_MS, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender) - 5, 0)
pause(HEALROOT_ACTION_MS)
return OUT_NO_CURRENT_TARGET
}
let ally = defenderById(context.data[TD_TARGET_ID])
let x = ally ? defenderAnchorX(ally) : context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_X]
let y = ally ? defenderAnchorY(ally) : context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_Y]
if (!ally || !activeRootedDefender(ally)) {
context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] += 1
context.data[TD_BRANCH_HANDLED] = 1
createEffect("effect.heal", 0, HEALROOT_ACTION_MS, x, y, 0)
pause(HEALROOT_ACTION_MS)
return OUT_NO_CURRENT_TARGET
}
if (ally.hp >= ally.maxHp) {
context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] += 1
context.data[TD_BRANCH_HANDLED] = 1
createEffect("effect.heal", 0, HEALROOT_ACTION_MS, x, y, 0)
pause(HEALROOT_ACTION_MS)
return OUT_HEALTHY_NOOP
}
ally.hp = Math.min(ally.maxHp, ally.hp + HEALROOT_HEAL_AMOUNT)
context.data[TD_HEAL_GOOD] += 1
context.data[TD_BRANCH_HANDLED] = 1
createEffect("effect.heal", 0, HEALROOT_ACTION_MS, x, y, 0)
setDefenderAttackImage(defender)
pause(HEALROOT_ACTION_MS)
restoreDefenderImage(defender)
return OUT_APPLIED
}

function sporecapOpen(context: farmTypes.Context): number {
let defender = defenderById(context.actorId)
if (!defender) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
let caps = contextPrimaryValue(context)
let sporesPerCap = contextSecondaryValue(context)
if (context.group >= 0 && context.cursor != sporesPerCap) context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] += 1
let next = context.group + 1
if (next >= caps) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
context.group = -1
createEffect("effect.shrug", 0, 160, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender), 0)
pause(120)
return OUT_EXHAUSTED_ANATOMY
}
context.group = next
context.cursor = 0
context.data[TD_COUNT_A] += 1
context.data[TD_GROUP_TOTAL] = caps
context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] = farmTypes.Action.OpenCap
showPreviewProgress(context, farmTypes.Action.OpenCap, 0)
defender.sporeActive = true
defender.sporeNextIndex = next * sporesPerCap
setDefenderAttackImage(defender)
createEffect("effect.spore", 0, 120, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender) - 5, 0)
pause(120)
restoreDefenderImage(defender)
return OUT_APPLIED
}

function sporecapRelease(context: farmTypes.Context): number {
let defender = defenderById(context.actorId)
if (!defender) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
let sporesPerCap = contextSecondaryValue(context)
if (context.group < 0) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
createEffect("effect.drypump", 0, SPORECAP_RELEASE_MS, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender) - 4, 0)
pause(SPORECAP_RELEASE_MS)
return OUT_NO_CURRENT_GROUP
}
if (context.cursor >= sporesPerCap) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
createEffect("effect.drypump", 0, SPORECAP_RELEASE_MS, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender) - 4, 0)
pause(SPORECAP_RELEASE_MS)
return OUT_DRY_RESOURCE
}
let flatIndex = context.group * sporesPerCap + context.cursor
context.cursor += 1
context.data[TD_COUNT_B] += 1
context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] = farmTypes.Action.ReleaseSpore
showPreviewProgress(context, farmTypes.Action.ReleaseSpore, 0)
defender.sporeNextIndex = flatIndex + 1
if (flatIndex < 0 || flatIndex >= defender.sporeLoaded.length) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
pause(SPORECAP_RELEASE_MS)
return OUT_EXHAUSTED_ANATOMY
}
if (defender.sporeLoaded[flatIndex] == 0) {
createEffect("effect.drypump", 0, SPORECAP_RELEASE_MS, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender) - 4, 0)
pause(SPORECAP_RELEASE_MS)
return OUT_DRY_RESOURCE
}

defender.sporeLoaded[flatIndex] = 0
syncSporeResource(defender)
context.data[TD_RESOURCE_USED] += 1
let target = chooseSporecapTarget(defender)
let targetId = target ? target.id : -1
let aimX = target ? target.visualX : contextAimX(context, false)
let aimY = target ? target.visualY : contextAimY(context, false)
if (target) setContextAim(context, false, aimX, aimY)
if (aimX == 0 && aimY == 0) {
aimX = defaultAimX(defender)
aimY = defaultAimY(defender)
setContextAim(context, false, aimX, aimY)
}
setDefenderAttackImage(defender)
let travelMs = createMovingEffect("effect.spore", defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender), aimX, aimY, SPORECAP_PROJECTILE_SPEED, 100)
if (targetId >= 0) {
queueCommittedEnemyHit(targetId, travelMs, SPORECAP_DAMAGE, DAMAGE_ORDINARY, false, SPORECAP_KNOCKBACK_PX, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender))
}
// RELEASE blocks only for the physical release cadence. The projectile is
// already committed and resolves later through updateCommittedEnemyHits().
pause(SPORECAP_RELEASE_MS)
restoreDefenderImage(defender)
return targetId >= 0 ? OUT_APPLIED : OUT_VISUAL_NO_TARGET
}

function lanternleafTransfer(context: farmTypes.Context): number {
let source = defenderById(context.actorId)
if (!source) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
context.data[TD_COUNT_A] += 1
context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] = farmTypes.Action.TransferEnergy
if (source.resource <= 0) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
createEffect("effect.drypump", 0, LANTERNLEAF_TRANSFER_MS, defenderAnchorX(source), defenderAnchorY(source) - 4, 0)
pause(LANTERNLEAF_TRANSFER_MS)
return OUT_DRY_RESOURCE
}
if (removeDefenderEnergy(source, 1) <= 0) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
pause(LANTERNLEAF_TRANSFER_MS)
return OUT_DRY_RESOURCE
}
let recipient = chooseLanternleafRecipient(source)
if (!recipient) {
addDefenderEnergy(source, 1)
context.data[TD_TRANSFER_RETURNED] += 1
createEffect("effect.energy", 0, LANTERNLEAF_TRANSFER_MS, defenderAnchorX(source), defenderAnchorY(source) - 5, 0)
pause(LANTERNLEAF_TRANSFER_MS)
return OUT_NO_RECIPIENT_RETURNED
}
if (addDefenderEnergy(recipient, 1) <= 0) {
addDefenderEnergy(source, 1)
context.data[TD_TRANSFER_RETURNED] += 1
pause(LANTERNLEAF_TRANSFER_MS)
return OUT_NO_RECIPIENT_RETURNED
}
context.data[TD_RESOURCE_USED] += 1
context.data[TD_TRANSFER_GOOD] += 1
showPreviewProgress(context, farmTypes.Action.TransferEnergy, 0)
let x = Math.idiv(defenderAnchorX(source) + defenderAnchorX(recipient), 2)
let y = Math.idiv(defenderAnchorY(source) + defenderAnchorY(recipient), 2)
let effect = createEffect("effect.energy", 0, LANTERNLEAF_TRANSFER_MS, x, y, 0)
if (effect) {
effect.sourceActorId = source.id
effect.targetActorId = recipient.id
}
setDefenderAttackImage(source)
pause(LANTERNLEAF_TRANSFER_MS)
restoreDefenderImage(source)
return OUT_APPLIED
}

function rootsnareMask(defender: DefenderRuntime, reach: number): farmTypes.Mask {
if (!defender || reach <= 0) return null
return maskForSlotKindRadius(defender.slot, 5, reach)
}

function translatedRootMaskContains(defender: DefenderRuntime, mask: farmTypes.Mask, originTile: number, targetTile: number): boolean {
if (!defender || !mask || !activeLayout || activeLayout.width <= 0 || originTile < 0 || targetTile < 0) return false
let slot = slotById(defender.slot)
if (!slot) return false
let width = activeLayout.width
let sourceRow = Math.idiv(slot.tile, width)
let sourceCol = slot.tile % width
let originRow = Math.idiv(originTile, width)
let originCol = originTile % width
let targetRow = Math.idiv(targetTile, width)
let targetCol = targetTile % width
for (let i = 0; i < mask.tiles.length; i++) {
let maskRow = Math.idiv(mask.tiles[i], width)
let maskCol = mask.tiles[i] % width
if (originRow + (maskRow - sourceRow) == targetRow && originCol + (maskCol - sourceCol) == targetCol) return true
}
return false
}

function rootsnarePredicateOutcome(context: farmTypes.Context, reach: number): number {
let defender = defenderById(context.actorId)
if (!defender) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
let maximum = contextPrimaryValue(context)
if (reach <= 0 || reach > maximum || reach != Math.round(reach)) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
return OUT_INVALID_VALUE
}
let mask = rootsnareMask(defender, reach)
if (!mask || mask.tiles.length == 0) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
return OUT_INVALID_VALUE
}
context.data[TD_ROOT_LAST_REACH] = reach
let target = enemyById(context.data[TD_TARGET_ID])
if (!target || !target.alive || target.pendingDestroy) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
if (!target.targetable || target.phased) return OUT_PHASE_IGNORED
if (!target.groundContact) return OUT_GROUND_INCOMPATIBLE
if (!containsNumber(mask.tiles, target.tile)) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
return OUT_APPLIED
}

function rootsnareTighten(context: farmTypes.Context): number {
let defender = defenderById(context.actorId)
if (!defender) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
if (context.data[TD_COUNT_A] != context.data[TD_COUNT_B]) context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] += 1
// Count the learner primitive call before re-reading live state. A target
// may phase/die/leave after the while predicate returned true but before
// this body primitive executes; correct learner structure must not be
// marked wrong merely because the world changed during a cooperative yield.
context.data[TD_COUNT_A] += 1
context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] = farmTypes.Action.Tighten
showPreviewProgress(context, farmTypes.Action.Tighten, 0)
let reach = context.data[TD_ROOT_LAST_REACH]
let state = rootsnarePredicateOutcome(context, reach)
if (state != OUT_APPLIED) return state
let target = enemyById(context.data[TD_TARGET_ID])
if (!target) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
target.controlHoldMs = Math.max(target.controlHoldMs, ROOTSNARE_HOLD_MS)
createEffect("effect.roots", 0, ROOTSNARE_HOLD_MS, target.visualX, target.visualY, 0)
setDefenderAttackImage(defender)
pause(ROOTSNARE_HOLD_MS)
restoreDefenderImage(defender)
return OUT_CONTROL_APPLIED
}

function rootsnareSlow(context: farmTypes.Context): number {
let defender = defenderById(context.actorId)
if (!defender) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
if (context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] != farmTypes.Action.Tighten || context.data[TD_COUNT_A] != context.data[TD_COUNT_B] + 1) {
context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] += 1
}
// As with TIGHTEN, record that the learner actually called SLOW in the
// correct loop body even if the target invalidated during TIGHTEN's pause.
context.data[TD_COUNT_B] += 1
context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] = farmTypes.Action.Slow
showPreviewProgress(context, farmTypes.Action.Slow, 0)
let reach = context.data[TD_ROOT_LAST_REACH]
let state = rootsnarePredicateOutcome(context, reach)
if (state != OUT_APPLIED) return state
let target = enemyById(context.data[TD_TARGET_ID])
if (!target) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
target.controlSlowMultiplier = ROOTSNARE_SLOW_MULTIPLIER
target.controlSlowMs = Math.max(target.controlSlowMs, ROOTSNARE_SLOW_DURATION_MS)
createEffect("effect.roots", 0, ROOTSNARE_SLOW_ACTION_MS, target.visualX, target.visualY, 0)
setDefenderAttackImage(defender)
pause(ROOTSNARE_SLOW_ACTION_MS)
restoreDefenderImage(defender)
return OUT_CONTROL_APPLIED
}

function stormFinalizePrevious(context: farmTypes.Context): void {
if (!context) return
if (context.data[TD_BRANCH_HANDLED] == 0) context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] += 1
context.data[TD_EXPECTED_BRANCH] = -1
context.data[TD_BRANCH_HANDLED] = 1
}

function stormAwaken(context: farmTypes.Context): number {
let defender = defenderById(context.actorId)
if (!defender) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
stormFinalizePrevious(context)
let bulbs = contextPrimaryValue(context)
let sparks = contextSecondaryValue(context)
if (context.group >= 0 && context.cursor != sparks) context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] += 1
let next = context.group + 1
if (next >= bulbs) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
context.group = -1
createEffect("effect.shrug", 0, 160, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender), 0)
return OUT_EXHAUSTED_ANATOMY
}
context.group = next
context.cursor = 0
context.data[TD_COUNT_A] += 1
context.data[TD_GROUP_TOTAL] = bulbs
context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] = farmTypes.Action.AwakenBulb
showPreviewProgress(context, farmTypes.Action.AwakenBulb, 0)
setDefenderAttackImage(defender)
createEffect("effect.conductive", 0, 150, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender) - 6, 0)
pause(120)
restoreDefenderImage(defender)
return OUT_APPLIED
}

function stormFocus(context: farmTypes.Context): number {
let defender = defenderById(context.actorId)
if (!defender) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
if (context.group < 0) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
return OUT_NO_CURRENT_GROUP
}
let sparks = contextSecondaryValue(context)
if (context.cursor >= sparks) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
return OUT_DRY_RESOURCE
}
stormFinalizePrevious(context)
let target = previewStormTarget(context)
if (!target) target = chooseStormbloomTarget(defender)
context.data[TD_TARGET_ID] = target ? target.id : -1
context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_X] = target ? target.visualX : defaultAimX(defender)
context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_Y] = target ? target.visualY : defaultAimY(defender)
context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] = farmTypes.Action.Focus
showPreviewProgress(context, farmTypes.Action.Focus, 0)
context.data[TD_EXPECTED_BRANCH] = -1
context.data[TD_BRANCH_HANDLED] = 0
context.data[TD_FOCUS_COUNT] += 1
createEffect("effect.threat", 0, 160, context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_X], context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_Y] - 5, 0)
if (target && enemyConductive(target)) createEffect("effect.conductive", 0, 180, target.visualX, target.visualY - 7, 0)
pause(80)
return target ? OUT_APPLIED : OUT_NO_CURRENT_TARGET
}

function stormConductive(context: farmTypes.Context): boolean {
if (!context || context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] != farmTypes.Action.Focus) return false
let target = enemyById(context.data[TD_TARGET_ID])
if (!target || !validDefenderEnemyTarget(target, false)) {
context.data[TD_EXPECTED_BRANCH] = -1
return false
}
let conductive = enemyConductive(target)
context.data[TD_EXPECTED_BRANCH] = conductive ? farmTypes.Action.Zap : farmTypes.Action.Gust
return conductive
}

function stormGustTargetAllowed(defender: DefenderRuntime, target: EnemyRuntime): boolean {
if (!defender || !target || !activeLayout) return false
let sawMask = false
for (let i = 0; i < activeLayout.masks.length; i++) {
let mask = activeLayout.masks[i]
if (mask.slot != defender.slot || mask.kind != 6) continue
sawMask = true
if (containsNumber(mask.tiles, target.tile)) return true
}
// Compatibility fallback only if a peer layout omitted the optional gust
// mask; target acquisition is still bounded by the authored ordinary range.
return !sawMask
}

function stormSpendSpark(context: farmTypes.Context): boolean {
let sparks = contextSecondaryValue(context)
if (context.group < 0 || context.cursor < 0 || context.cursor >= sparks) return false
context.cursor += 1
context.data[TD_STORM_SPARKS_USED] += 1
return true
}

function stormZap(context: farmTypes.Context): number {
let defender = defenderById(context.actorId)
if (!defender) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
if (context.group < 0) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
return OUT_NO_CURRENT_GROUP
}
if (context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] != farmTypes.Action.Focus) context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] += 1
if (!stormSpendSpark(context)) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
createEffect("effect.drypump", 0, STORMBLOOM_ACTION_MS, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender), 0)
pause(STORMBLOOM_ACTION_MS)
return OUT_DRY_RESOURCE
}
if (context.data[TD_EXPECTED_BRANCH] < 0) context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] += 1
if (context.data[TD_EXPECTED_BRANCH] >= 0 && context.data[TD_EXPECTED_BRANCH] != farmTypes.Action.Zap) context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] += 1
context.data[TD_BRANCH_HANDLED] = 1
context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] = farmTypes.Action.Zap
showPreviewProgress(context, farmTypes.Action.Zap, 0)
let target = enemyById(context.data[TD_TARGET_ID])
let aimX = target ? target.visualX : context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_X]
let aimY = target ? target.visualY : context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_Y]
createEffect("effect.zap", 0, STORMBLOOM_ACTION_MS, aimX, aimY, 0)
setDefenderAttackImage(defender)
let outcome = OUT_NO_CURRENT_TARGET
if (target && validDefenderEnemyTarget(target, false)) {
if (enemyConductive(target)) outcome = applyEnemyEffect(target, STORMBLOOM_ZAP_DAMAGE, DAMAGE_LIGHTNING, false, 0, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender)).outcome
else outcome = OUT_WRONG_BRANCH_VISIBLE
}
pause(STORMBLOOM_ACTION_MS)
restoreDefenderImage(defender)
return outcome
}

function stormGust(context: farmTypes.Context): number {
let defender = defenderById(context.actorId)
if (!defender) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
if (context.group < 0) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
return OUT_NO_CURRENT_GROUP
}
if (context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] != farmTypes.Action.Focus) context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] += 1
if (!stormSpendSpark(context)) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
createEffect("effect.drypump", 0, STORMBLOOM_ACTION_MS, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender), 0)
pause(STORMBLOOM_ACTION_MS)
return OUT_DRY_RESOURCE
}
if (context.data[TD_EXPECTED_BRANCH] < 0) context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] += 1
if (context.data[TD_EXPECTED_BRANCH] >= 0 && context.data[TD_EXPECTED_BRANCH] != farmTypes.Action.Gust) context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] += 1
context.data[TD_BRANCH_HANDLED] = 1
context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] = farmTypes.Action.Gust
showPreviewProgress(context, farmTypes.Action.Gust, 0)
let target = enemyById(context.data[TD_TARGET_ID])
let aimX = target ? target.visualX : context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_X]
let aimY = target ? target.visualY : context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_Y]
createEffect("effect.gust", 0, STORMBLOOM_ACTION_MS, aimX, aimY, 0)
setDefenderAttackImage(defender)
let outcome = OUT_NO_CURRENT_TARGET
if (target && validDefenderEnemyTarget(target, false)) {
if (!stormGustTargetAllowed(defender, target)) {
context.data[TD_INVALID] += 1
outcome = OUT_INVALID_VALUE
} else {
outcome = applyEnemyEffect(target, 0, DAMAGE_CONTROL, false, STORMBLOOM_GUST_KNOCKBACK_PX, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender)).outcome
if (enemyConductive(target)) outcome = OUT_WRONG_BRANCH_VISIBLE
}
}
pause(STORMBLOOM_ACTION_MS)
restoreDefenderImage(defender)
return outcome
}

function evaluateSporecap(context: farmTypes.Context): farmTypes.RunResult {
let caps = contextPrimaryValue(context)
let spores = contextSecondaryValue(context)
if (context.group >= 0 && context.cursor != spores) context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] += 1
if (context.data[TD_INVALID] > 0 || context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] > 0) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "open each Sporecap cap once, then release every sac in that cap before moving on")
}
if (context.data[TD_COUNT_A] != caps || context.data[TD_COUNT_B] != caps * spores) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "complete every purchased Sporecap cap and spore-sac position")
}
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Success, "Sporecap nested cap-and-sac sequence complete")
}

function evaluateLanternleaf(context: farmTypes.Context): farmTypes.RunResult {
let supply = contextResourceStart(context)
if (context.data[TD_INVALID] > 0) return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "Lanternleaf tried to transfer more physical magic than was available")
if (context.data[TD_COUNT_A] != supply) return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "transfer exactly the captured compatible charge supply")
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Success, "Lanternleaf transferred its captured support charge")
}

function evaluateRootsnare(context: farmTypes.Context): farmTypes.RunResult {
if (context.data[TD_INVALID] > 0 || context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] > 0) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "while trapped, tighten first and then slow using only purchased snare reach")
}
if (context.data[TD_PRED_TRUE] <= 0 || context.data[TD_PRED_FALSE] <= 0) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "Rootsnare must keep checking the live trapped condition until it becomes false")
}
if (context.data[TD_COUNT_A] != context.data[TD_PRED_TRUE] || context.data[TD_COUNT_B] != context.data[TD_PRED_TRUE]) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "perform one tighten and one slow for every true trapped check")
}
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Success, "Rootsnare repeated control until the live target left the trap")
}

function evaluateStormbloom(context: farmTypes.Context): farmTypes.RunResult {
stormFinalizePrevious(context)
let bulbs = contextPrimaryValue(context)
let sparks = contextSecondaryValue(context)
let total = bulbs * sparks
if (context.group >= 0 && context.cursor != sparks) context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] += 1
if (context.data[TD_INVALID] > 0 || context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] > 0) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "awaken each bulb, focus every spark target, then zap conductive targets and gust the others")
}
if (context.data[TD_COUNT_A] != bulbs || context.data[TD_FOCUS_COUNT] != total || context.data[TD_STORM_SPARKS_USED] != total ||
traceCount(context, farmTypes.Predicate.Conductive) != total) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "complete every purchased Stormbloom bulb and spark with one focus and conductivity decision")
}
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Success, "Stormbloom nested conductivity sequence complete")
}

function evaluatePrism(context: farmTypes.Context): farmTypes.RunResult {
prismFinalizePrevious(context)
let count = context.data[TD_SNAPSHOT_COUNT]
if (context.data[TD_INVALID] > 0 || context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] > 0) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "inspect each marked target and choose piercing only for armored targets")
}
if (context.data[TD_COUNT_A] != count || context.data[TD_COUNT_B] != count ||
traceCount(context, farmTypes.Predicate.Armored) != count) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "inspect, classify and process every visible Prism marker exactly once")
}
if (count <= 0) return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "Prism scan contained no targets")
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Success, "Prism scan branches matched the snapshot")
}

function evaluateSunbeam(context: farmTypes.Context): farmTypes.RunResult {
let supply = contextResourceStart(context)
if (context.data[TD_INVALID] > 0 || traceHasOutcome(context, OUT_DRY_RESOURCE)) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "Sunbeam attempted to beam after its physical sunlight was empty")
}
if (context.data[TD_COUNT_A] != supply || context.data[TD_RESOURCE_USED] != supply) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "use exactly the sunlight available at the start of this discharge")
}
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Success, "Sunbeam discharged its captured sunlight supply")
}

function evaluateEcho(context: farmTypes.Context): farmTypes.RunResult {
let count = contextPrimaryValue(context)
if (context.data[TD_INVALID] > 0 || context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] > 0) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "Echo pulse radius must use the loop index plus one in ascending order")
}
if (context.data[TD_COUNT_A] != count || context.data[TD_ECHO_LAST_RADIUS] != count) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "pulse every purchased Echo radius from 1 through pulse count")
}
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Success, "Echo radii expanded through every purchased band")
}

function evaluateHealroot(context: farmTypes.Context): farmTypes.RunResult {
healrootFinalizePrevious(context)
let count = contextPrimaryValue(context)
if (context.data[TD_INVALID] > 0 || context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] > 0) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "inspect each ally slot and heal only damaged active allies")
}
if (context.data[TD_COUNT_A] != count || traceCount(context, farmTypes.Predicate.DamagedAlly) != count) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "inspect and classify every visible Healroot tendril slot")
}
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Success, "Healroot inspected all slots and skipped healthy allies")
}

function traceCount(context: farmTypes.Context, operationId: number): number {
let count = 0
for (let i = 0; i + 2 < context.trace.length; i += 3) {
if (context.trace[i] == operationId) count += 1
}
return count
}

function traceHasOutcome(context: farmTypes.Context, outcome: number): boolean {
for (let i = 2; i < context.trace.length; i += 3) {
if (context.trace[i] == outcome) return true
}
return false
}

function evaluateSixShooter(context: farmTypes.Context): farmTypes.RunResult {
let capacity = contextPrimaryValue(context)
if (context.data[TD_INVALID] > 0 || traceHasOutcome(context, OUT_DRY_RESOURCE)) return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "Six-Shooter fired beyond its loaded chambers")
if (traceCount(context, farmTypes.Action.FireChamber) != capacity || context.data[TD_COUNT_A] != capacity) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "use every visible Six-Shooter chamber exactly once")
}
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Success, "Six-Shooter chamber sequence complete")
}

function evaluateTwinbud(context: farmTypes.Context): farmTypes.RunResult {
let capacity = contextPrimaryValue(context)
if (context.data[TD_INVALID] > 0 || context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] > 0 || traceHasOutcome(context, OUT_DRY_RESOURCE)) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "Twinbud must alternate left then right for each cycle")
}
if (context.data[TD_COUNT_A] != capacity || context.data[TD_COUNT_B] != capacity) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "complete every purchased Twinbud firing cycle")
}
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Success, "Twinbud alternating sequence complete")
}

function evaluateMineberry(context: farmTypes.Context): farmTypes.RunResult {
let capacity = contextPrimaryValue(context)
if (context.data[TD_INVALID] > 0 || context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] > 0) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "move to each Mineberry patch before dropping one mine")
}
if (context.data[TD_COUNT_A] != capacity || context.data[TD_COUNT_B] != capacity || context.data[TD_MINES_ARMED] != capacity) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "arm every visible Mineberry trap patch")
}
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Success, "Mineberry trap field prepared")
}

function evaluateRage(context: farmTypes.Context): farmTypes.RunResult {
if (context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] > 0) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "Rage strike damage must start at the purchased value and increase by one")
}
if (context.data[TD_COUNT_A] <= 0) return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "Rage Orchid never struck its engaged target")
if (context.data[TD_PRED_TRUE] <= 0 || context.data[TD_PRED_FALSE] <= 0) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "Rage Orchid must keep checking the live enemy-nearby condition until it becomes false")
}
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Success, "Rage Orchid engagement escalated and ended naturally")
}

function performPowerPrimitive(context: farmTypes.Context, action: number, value: number): number {
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.SixShooter && action == farmTypes.Action.FireChamber) return sixShooterFire(context)
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Twinbud) {
if (action == farmTypes.Action.FireLeft) return twinbudFireLeft(context)
if (action == farmTypes.Action.FireRight) return twinbudFireRight(context)
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Mineberry) {
if (action == farmTypes.Action.NextTrap) return mineberryNextTrap(context)
if (action == farmTypes.Action.DropMine) return mineberryDrop(context)
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Rage && action == farmTypes.Action.Strike) return rageStrike(context, value)
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Prism) {
if (action == farmTypes.Action.InspectEnemy) return prismInspect(context)
if (action == farmTypes.Action.Pierce) return prismPierce(context)
if (action == farmTypes.Action.Splash) return prismSplash(context)
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Sunbeam && action == farmTypes.Action.Beam) return sunbeamBeam(context)
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Echo && action == farmTypes.Action.Pulse) return echoPulse(context, value)
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Healroot) {
if (action == farmTypes.Action.InspectAlly) return healrootInspect(context)
if (action == farmTypes.Action.Heal) return healrootHeal(context)
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Sporecap) {
if (action == farmTypes.Action.OpenCap) return sporecapOpen(context)
if (action == farmTypes.Action.ReleaseSpore) return sporecapRelease(context)
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Lanternleaf && action == farmTypes.Action.TransferEnergy) return lanternleafTransfer(context)
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Rootsnare) {
if (action == farmTypes.Action.Tighten) return rootsnareTighten(context)
if (action == farmTypes.Action.Slow) return rootsnareSlow(context)
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Stormbloom) {
if (action == farmTypes.Action.AwakenBulb) return stormAwaken(context)
if (action == farmTypes.Action.Focus) return stormFocus(context)
if (action == farmTypes.Action.Zap) return stormZap(context)
if (action == farmTypes.Action.Gust) return stormGust(context)
}
return OUT_INVALID_VALUE
}

function evaluatePowerContext(context: farmTypes.Context): farmTypes.RunResult {
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.SixShooter) return evaluateSixShooter(context)
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Twinbud) return evaluateTwinbud(context)
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Mineberry) return evaluateMineberry(context)
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Rage) return evaluateRage(context)
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Prism) return evaluatePrism(context)
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Sunbeam) return evaluateSunbeam(context)
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Echo) return evaluateEcho(context)
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Healroot) return evaluateHealroot(context)
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Sporecap) return evaluateSporecap(context)
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Lanternleaf) return evaluateLanternleaf(context)
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Rootsnare) return evaluateRootsnare(context)
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Stormbloom) return evaluateStormbloom(context)
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Wrong, "unknown combat task")
}

function appendTrace(context: farmTypes.Context, actionId: number, value: number, outcome: number): void {
if (!context) return
context.trace.push(actionId)
context.trace.push(value)
context.trace.push(outcome)
}

function contextIsCurrent(context: farmTypes.Context): boolean {
if (!context || context.cancelled || !entered) return false
if (context.area != currentArea) return false
if (context.data.length <= CTX_EPOCH) return false
return context.data[CTX_EPOCH] == epoch
}

function staleContext(context: farmTypes.Context, operationId: number, value: number): void {
appendTrace(context, operationId, value, OUT_CANCELLED_OR_STALE)
}

function makeResult(context: farmTypes.Context, code: number, message: string): farmTypes.RunResult {
let result = new farmTypes.RunResult()
if (context) {
result.task = context.task
result.area = context.area
result.actorId = context.actorId
result.mode = context.mode
result.token = context.token
for (let i = 0; i < context.trace.length; i++) result.trace.push(context.trace[i])
}
result.code = code
result.message = message
return result
}

// ---- Step 13: raid orchestration ----

function removeNumberOnce(values: number[], value: number): boolean {
for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
if (values[i] != value) continue
values.removeAt(i)
return true
}
return false
}

function raidWorldCommitted(progress: farmTypes.Progress, area: number): boolean {
if (!progress || !progress.phase || area < 1 || area >= progress.phase.length) return false
return progress.phase[area] == farmTypes.Phase.Raid
}

function allAreaPlacementsValid(progress: farmTypes.Progress, area: number): boolean {
if (!progress || !progress.placements) return area == 1
let seen: number[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < progress.placements.length; i++) {
let placement = progress.placements[i]
if (!placement || placement.area != area) continue
if (!validCrop(placement.crop) || !slotById(placement.slot) || containsNumber(seen, placement.slot)) return false
seen.push(placement.slot)
}
return true
}

function anyCombatRunnerBusy(): boolean {
if (activeRunners.length > 0 || runnerQueue.length > 0) return true
for (let crop = MIN_CROP; crop <= MAX_CROP; crop++) {
if (farmProgram.busy(taskForCrop(crop))) return true
}
return false
}

function restoreRaidDefenders(): void {
for (let i = 0; i < defenders.length; i++) {
let defender = defenders[i]
if (!defender || defender.epoch != epoch || defender.previewOnly || !defender.rooted || defender.pendingDestroy) continue
defender.hp = defender.maxHp
defender.wilted = false
defender.resource = defender.resourceCap
defender.resourceMs = 0
defender.actionMs = 0
defender.engagedEnemyId = -1
defender.sporeActive = false
defender.sporeNextIndex = 0
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) {
defender.sporeLoaded = []
for (let s = 0; s < defender.resourceCap; s++) defender.sporeLoaded.push(1)
}
restoreDefenderImage(defender)
}
}

function routeEntryTile(route: RouteRuntime): number {
if (!route || route.tiles.length < 1) return -1
return route.tiles[0]
}

function leftmostRaidRoute(): RouteRuntime {
let best: RouteRuntime = null
for (let i = 0; i < activeRoutes.length; i++) {
let route = activeRoutes[i]
let tile = routeEntryTile(route)
if (tile < 0) continue
if (!best) { best = route; continue }
let bx = tileX(routeEntryTile(best))
let x = tileX(tile)
if (x < bx || (x == bx && route.id < best.id)) best = route
}
return best
}

function rightmostRaidRoute(): RouteRuntime {
let best: RouteRuntime = null
for (let i = 0; i < activeRoutes.length; i++) {
let route = activeRoutes[i]
let tile = routeEntryTile(route)
if (tile < 0) continue
if (!best) { best = route; continue }
let bx = tileX(routeEntryTile(best))
let x = tileX(tile)
if (x > bx || (x == bx && route.id < best.id)) best = route
}
return best
}

function bottomRaidRoute(): RouteRuntime {
let best: RouteRuntime = null
for (let i = 0; i < activeRoutes.length; i++) {
let route = activeRoutes[i]
let tile = routeEntryTile(route)
if (tile < 0) continue
if (!best) { best = route; continue }
let by = tileY(routeEntryTile(best))
let y = tileY(tile)
if (y > by || (y == by && route.id < best.id)) best = route
}
return best
}

function raidRouteForPolicy(policy: number, index: number): number {
if (activeRoutes.length < 1) return -1
if (policy == RAID_ENTRY_CYCLE) return activeRoutes[Math.abs(index) % activeRoutes.length].id
if (policy == RAID_ENTRY_LEFT) {
let left = leftmostRaidRoute()
return left ? left.id : activeRoutes[0].id
}
if (policy == RAID_ENTRY_RIGHT) {
let right = rightmostRaidRoute()
return right ? right.id : activeRoutes[0].id
}
if (policy == RAID_ENTRY_BOTTOM) {
let bottom = bottomRaidRoute()
return bottom ? bottom.id : activeRoutes[0].id
}
let left = leftmostRaidRoute()
let right = rightmostRaidRoute()
if (!left) left = activeRoutes[0]
if (!right) right = activeRoutes[0]
if (policy == RAID_ENTRY_OPPOSITE) return index % 2 == 0 ? right.id : left.id
return index % 2 == 0 ? left.id : right.id
}

function addRaidGroup(phase: number, species: number, count: number, startOffsetMs: number, intervalMs: number, entryPolicy: number): void {
for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
let request = new SpawnRequest()
request.enemySpecies = species
request.routeId = raidRouteForPolicy(entryPolicy, i)
request.dueMs = startOffsetMs + intervalMs * i
request.phase = phase
request.generation = 0
raidScheduledSpawns.push(request)
}
}

function raidPhaseCount(area: number): number {
if (area == 1) return 1
if (area == 2) return 3
if (area == 3) return 4
if (area == 4) return 3
if (area == 5) return 3
if (area == 6) return 3
if (area == 7) return 3
if (area == 8) return 4
if (area == 9) return 4
if (area == 10) return 3
if (area == 11) return 3
if (area == 12) return 3
return 0
}

function earliestScheduledSpawnIndex(): number {
if (raidScheduledSpawns.length < 1) return -1
let best = 0
for (let i = 1; i < raidScheduledSpawns.length; i++) {
let candidate = raidScheduledSpawns[i]
let current = raidScheduledSpawns[best]
if (candidate.dueMs < current.dueMs) best = i
}
return best
}

function waveEntryClear(routeId: number): boolean {
let route = routeForSpawn(routeId)
if (!route || route.tiles.length == 0) return false
let x = tileCenterX(route.tiles[0]); let y = tileCenterY(route.tiles[0])
for (let i = 0; i < enemies.length; i++) {
let enemy = enemies[i]
if (!enemy.alive || enemy.pendingDestroy || enemy.previewOnly) continue
let dx = enemy.visualX - x; let dy = enemy.visualY - y
if (dx * dx + dy * dy < WAVE_ENTRY_GAP_PX * WAVE_ENTRY_GAP_PX) return false
}
return true
}

function emitRaidSpawn(request: SpawnRequest): boolean {
if (!request || request.routeId < 0) return false
if (request.generation == 0 && !waveEntryClear(request.routeId)) return false
return spawnEnemy(request.enemySpecies, request.routeId, request.generation) != null
}

function drainBlockedRaidSpawns(): void {
while (blockedSpawns.length > 0 && aliveEnemyCount() < MAX_LIVE_ENEMIES) {
let request = blockedSpawns[0]
if (!emitRaidSpawn(request)) return
blockedSpawns.removeAt(0)
}
}

function emitDueRaidSpawns(): void {
// Once a cap-blocked parent exists, later scheduled identities remain in the
// phase schedule until FIFO backpressure drains. This prevents overtaking and
// means no required enemy identity is silently discarded.
if (blockedSpawns.length > 0) return
while (raidScheduledSpawns.length > 0) {
let index = earliestScheduledSpawnIndex()
if (index < 0) return
let request = raidScheduledSpawns[index]
if (request.dueMs > raidPhaseElapsedMs) return
if (aliveEnemyCount() >= MAX_LIVE_ENEMIES) {
if (blockedSpawns.length < MAX_BLOCKED_SPAWNS) {
raidScheduledSpawns.removeAt(index)
blockedSpawns.push(request)
}
return
}
raidScheduledSpawns.removeAt(index)
if (!emitRaidSpawn(request)) {
// With valid authored routes the only ordinary failure is cap pressure;
// retain the request rather than deleting a wave identity.
if (blockedSpawns.length < MAX_BLOCKED_SPAWNS) blockedSpawns.push(request)
return
}
}
}

function raidPhaseResolved(): boolean {
return raidScheduledSpawns.length == 0 && blockedSpawns.length == 0 && pendingChildren.length == 0 && aliveEnemyCount() == 0
}

function beginRaidCountdown(): void {
if (!raidActive || raidStage != RAID_STAGE_SETUP) return
// Mineberry setup consequences (armed mines) persist, but all defender HP
// and physical stores begin the actual battle full. The hero has no HP.
restoreRaidDefenders()
raidStage = RAID_STAGE_COUNTDOWN
raidCountdownRemainingMs = RAID_COUNTDOWN_MS
raidCountdownShown = 3
farmWorld.notice("Raid starts in 3...")
}

function beginRaidWavePhase(phase: number): boolean {
if (phase < 0 || phase >= raidPhaseCount(raidArea)) return false
blockedSpawns = []
raidPhaseIndex = phase
if (!buildRaidPhaseSchedule(raidArea, phase)) return false
farmWorld.notice("Wave " + (phase + 1) + " of " + raidPhaseCount(raidArea))
return true
}

function beginRaidActive(): void {
if (!raidActive) return
raidStage = RAID_STAGE_ACTIVE
raidCountdownRemainingMs = 0
raidCountdownShown = -1
if (!beginRaidWavePhase(0)) settleRaid(false)
}

function beginRaidSetup(): void {
raidStage = RAID_STAGE_SETUP
raidSetupWaitingActorIds = []
// Every rooted Mineberry executes the student's CURRENT callback once before
// countdown. Missing/Wrong returns simply leave an incomplete trap field;
// only a callback that never returns keeps this setup stage occupied.
for (let i = 0; i < defenders.length; i++) {
let defender = defenders[i]
if (!activeRootedDefender(defender) || defender.crop != farmTypes.Crop.Mineberry) continue
raidSetupWaitingActorIds.push(defender.id)
if (!enqueuePowerRun(defender.crop, defender.id, farmTypes.Mode.Raid)) removeNumberOnce(raidSetupWaitingActorIds, defender.id)
}
if (raidSetupWaitingActorIds.length == 0) beginRaidCountdown()
}

function clearRaidBattleTransient(): void {
farmProgram.cancelAll()
for (let i = 0; i < effects.length; i++) destroyOwnedSprite(effects[i].sprite)
for (let i = 0; i < enemies.length; i++) destroyEnemySprites(enemies[i])
effects = []
enemies = []
occupancy = []
pendingEnemyHits = []
mines = []
blockedSpawns = []
pendingChildren = []
raidScheduledSpawns = []
raidSetupWaitingActorIds = []
enemyDestroyIds = []
effectDestroyIds = []
runnerQueue = []
activeRunners = []
}

function settleRaid(success: boolean): void {
if (!raidActive || raidResultSent) return
let finishingArea = raidArea
let finishingEpoch = epoch
let failureReason = farmTasks.livingCropCount() <= 0 ? "All plants were lost. Setup restored - plant, water, and try again." : "Raid setup could not start. Setup restored - check your plants and defenders."
raidResultSent = true
raidSettled = true
raidActive = false
raidStage = RAID_STAGE_SETTLED
clearRaidBattleTransient()

// This is the only durable raid-result call owned by Combat. World commits
// successful rooting/progression or restores its pre-raid snapshot on false.
farmWorld.raidFinished(success)
if (!success) farmWorld.notice(failureReason)

// raidFinished is synchronous in the service contract. Rebuild transient
// defenders from World's post-result authority so success revives rooted
// plants and failure visibly restores adjustable pre-Ready placements.
if (entered && currentArea == finishingArea && epoch == finishingEpoch) rebuildDefendersFromWorld()
}

function updateRaidSetup(): void {
if (!raidActive || raidStage != RAID_STAGE_SETUP) return
if (farmTasks.livingCropCount() <= 0) {
settleRaid(false)
return
}
if (raidSetupWaitingActorIds.length == 0) beginRaidCountdown()
}

function updateRaidCountdown(dtMs: number): void {
if (!raidActive || raidStage != RAID_STAGE_COUNTDOWN) return
if (farmTasks.livingCropCount() <= 0) {
settleRaid(false)
return
}
raidCountdownRemainingMs -= dtMs
if (raidCountdownRemainingMs <= 0) {
beginRaidActive()
return
}
let second = Math.ceil(raidCountdownRemainingMs / 1000)
if (second < raidCountdownShown && second > 0) {
raidCountdownShown = second
farmWorld.notice("Raid starts in " + second + "...")
}
}

function updateRaidActive(dtMs: number): void {
if (!raidActive || raidStage != RAID_STAGE_ACTIVE) return
if (farmTasks.livingCropCount() <= 0) {
settleRaid(false)
return
}

// Splitter children are given first chance at newly opened cap slots by the
// main update loop. Then drain any previously blocked scheduled parent. While
// a parent remains cap-blocked, freeze this phase's emission clock rather
// than compressing all later timing into a burst.
drainBlockedRaidSpawns()
if (blockedSpawns.length > 0) return
raidPhaseElapsedMs += dtMs
emitDueRaidSpawns()

if (!raidPhaseResolved()) return
let nextPhase = raidPhaseIndex + 1
if (nextPhase < raidPhaseCount(raidArea)) {
beginRaidWavePhase(nextPhase)
return
}

// Every enemy/queued child must be resolved, with actual crops surviving.
if (farmTasks.livingCropCount() > 0) settleRaid(true)
else settleRaid(false)
}

function updateRaidLifecycle(dtMs: number): void {
if (!raidActive) return
if (raidStage == RAID_STAGE_SETUP) updateRaidSetup()
else if (raidStage == RAID_STAGE_COUNTDOWN) updateRaidCountdown(dtMs)
else if (raidStage == RAID_STAGE_ACTIVE) updateRaidActive(dtMs)
}

// ---- Cross-package farmCombat service ----

export function enter(area: number): void {
if (!validArea(area)) return

// enter() is idempotent for the same live area. A changed area always gets
// a new epoch so delayed fibers/effects cannot mutate the new scene.
if (entered && currentArea == area) return
if (entered) hardCleanup()

epoch += 1
entered = true
currentArea = area
elapsedMs = 0
clearRaidState()
clearRuntimeCollections()
playerAttackCooldownMs = 0
playerFacingX = 0
playerFacingY = 1
ensureMonsterViews()
activeLayout = farmWorld.layout()
buildRouteCache(activeLayout)
buildEnemyReachLookups()

// Durable placement authority remains in World. Combat rebuilds only
// transient sprites/HP/resources for placements in the active area.
rebuildDefendersFromWorld()
// Entering an area never creates enemies by itself. The raid stage machine
// below is the only scheduler that emits required wave enemies.
}

export function leave(): void {
if (!entered) return
hardCleanup()
entered = false
currentArea = 0
}

export function update(dtMs: number): void {
if (!entered) return
let dt = clampDt(dtMs)
elapsedMs += dt
updateWeaponView()
if (raidActive) raidElapsedMs += dt
if (playerAttackCooldownMs > 0) playerAttackCooldownMs = Math.max(0, playerAttackCooldownMs - dt)
updatePlayerFacing()
for (let i = 0; i < defenders.length; i++) {
let defender = defenders[i]
if (!defender.wilted) farmPlantArt.animate(defender.visual, "crop." + cropArtStem(defender.crop) + ".rooted", elapsedMs)
if (defender.cueSprite && elapsedMs >= defender.cueUntil) defender.cueSprite.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Invisible, true)
}
updatePreviewScenario(dt)

// Advanced route enemies establish/maintain their bounded firing/siphon
// stances before movement. Phase Mite toggles targetability here but keeps
// ordinary route movement/contact/crop biting in both states.
updateAdvancedEnemyStances(dt)
updateEnemyControlTimers(dt)

// Ground actors advance only on their authored route. Sky Wisp direct
// flight is the sole route exception and still maintains currentTile.
updateEnemyMovement(dt)
updateStarterCropGuards(dt)
updateEnemyStates(dt)
updateEnergyRecharge(dt)
updateDefenderPowerTriggers(dt)
updateMines()
updateCommittedEnemyHits(dt)
updateEnemyVisuals()
updateEffects(dt)
flushDeferred()
// Splitter children are emitted only after the parent killing event has
// completed and deferred parent removal has flushed. Population cap delays
// rather than discards pending children.
processPendingChildren()
flushDeferred()
processRunnerQueue()
updateRaidLifecycle(dt)
}

export function interact(object: farmTypes.WorldObject): boolean {
if (!entered || !object) return false
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.DefenderSlot) {
// ART_CONTRACT: DefenderSlot.arg is the authored D-slot id.
return interactDefenderSlot(object.arg)
}
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.PracticePad) {
// ART_CONTRACT: arg is the required crop id; arg2==1 is reserved for
// the temporary Stormbloom projection. The projection still uses the
// same preview service and never becomes inventory/placement.
if (!validCrop(object.arg)) return false
if (object.arg2 == 1 && object.arg != farmTypes.Crop.Stormbloom) return false
if (!preview(object.arg)) {
// The pad was still the handled world object even when practice is
// temporarily unavailable (busy runner/layout issue).
return true
}
return true
}
return false
}

export function attack(): void {
if (!entered || playerAttackCooldownMs > 0) return
let player = farmWorld.player()
if (!player) return
updatePlayerFacing()

let weapon = equippedOwnedWeapon()
let reach = weaponReachPx(weapon)
let damage = weaponDamage(weapon)
let knockback = weaponKnockbackPx(weapon)

// A B press is one bounded swing event. Processing the bounded enemy list
// once guarantees at most one hit per enemy per swing without a hit cache.
for (let i = 0; i < enemies.length; i++) {
let enemy = enemies[i]
if (!enemyInsidePlayerSwing(enemy, player, reach)) continue
applyEnemyEffect(enemy, damage, DAMAGE_ORDINARY, false, knockback, player.x, player.y)
}
showWeaponSwing(player, weapon)
playerAttackCooldownMs = weaponCooldownMs(weapon)
}

export function beginRaid(area: number): boolean {
if (!entered || area != currentArea || area < 1 || area > 12) return false
if (raidActive) return false
if (previewActive || anyCombatRunnerBusy()) {
farmWorld.notice("Finish the current learner routine before the raid.")
return false
}
if (!activeLayout || activeRoutes.length < 1 || raidPhaseCount(area) < 1) {
farmWorld.notice("This area's raid layout is incomplete.")
return false
}
if (!allRouteCropPrioritiesValid()) {
farmWorld.notice("This area's raid routes need authored crop priorities.")
return false
}

// World must already have saved the adjustable pre-raid setup and entered
// Phase.Raid. Combat locks transient battle actors; permanent rooting is
// exclusively World's successful-raid commit.
let progress = farmWorld.progress()
if (!raidWorldCommitted(progress, area) || !allAreaPlacementsValid(progress, area) || (area > 1 && placementCount(progress, area) < 1)) {
farmWorld.notice("Raid setup has not been committed yet.")
return false
}

// Rebuild temporary battle actors from the committed placement snapshot
// and current purchased physical capacities without changing World data.
rebuildDefendersFromWorld()
raidActive = true
raidSettled = false
raidResultSent = false
raidArea = area
raidElapsedMs = 0
raidPhaseIndex = 0
raidPhaseElapsedMs = 0
raidScheduledSpawns = []
blockedSpawns = []
pendingChildren = []
raidInitialCropCount = farmTasks.livingCropCount()
starterGuardCooldowns = []

// Empty objectives are real soft failures. livingCropCount above also
// performs Farming's required raid-objective synchronization before any
// individual cropAlive queries occur during spawning/biting.
if (raidInitialCropCount <= 0) {
raidStage = RAID_STAGE_SETUP
settleRaid(false)
return true
}

beginRaidSetup()
return true
}

export function create(crop: number, actorId: number, mode: number): farmTypes.Context {
let context = new farmTypes.Context()
if (!entered || !validCrop(crop)) {
context.cancelled = true
return context
}
if (mode != farmTypes.Mode.Raid && mode != farmTypes.Mode.Preview) {
context.cancelled = true
return context
}
if (mode == farmTypes.Mode.Raid) {
let actor = defenderById(actorId)
if (!activeRootedDefender(actor) || actor.crop != crop) {
context.cancelled = true
return context
}
}

let progress = farmWorld.progress()
let primaryUpgrade = upgradeIdForCrop(crop)
let secondaryUpgrade = secondaryUpgradeIdForCrop(crop)
let primaryValue = capturedUpgradeValue(progress, primaryUpgrade)
let secondaryValue = capturedUpgradeValue(progress, secondaryUpgrade)
let resourceStart = contextActorResource(crop, actorId, primaryValue, secondaryValue)
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Lanternleaf) {
let source = defenderById(actorId)
if (source) resourceStart = Math.min(resourceStart, totalCompatibleMissingEnergy(source))
}
let resourceCap = resourceStart
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sunbeam || crop == farmTypes.Crop.Lanternleaf) resourceCap = primaryValue
else if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) resourceCap = primaryValue * secondaryValue

context.task = taskForCrop(crop)
context.area = currentArea
context.mode = mode
context.actorId = actorId
context.resource = resourceStart
context.cursor = -1
context.group = -1
context.data.push(epoch)
context.data.push(crop)
context.data.push(primaryValue)
context.data.push(secondaryValue)
context.data.push(resourceStart)
context.data.push(resourceCap)
context.data.push(0) // run serial is filled by startRunnerRequest()
initializePowerTaskData(context)
return context
}

export function action(context: farmTypes.Context, action: number, value: number): void {
if (!operationAllowed(context, action, value)) return
if (!actionAllowedForTask(context.task, action)) {
appendTrace(context, action, value, OUT_INVALID_VALUE)
pause(1)
return
}
let outcome = performPowerPrimitive(context, action, value)
appendTrace(context, action, value, outcome)
pulseDefenderOperation(context)
// Every learner primitive is one bounded world job and yields before the
// wrapper returns. This keeps intended while loops cooperative without
// moving repetition into supplied code.
pause(1)
}

export function read(context: farmTypes.Context, reader: number): number {
if (!operationAllowed(context, reader, 0)) return 0
if (!readerAllowedForTask(context.task, reader)) {
appendTrace(context, reader, 0, OUT_INVALID_VALUE)
pause(1)
return 0
}
let value = readCapturedValue(context, reader)
appendTrace(context, reader, value, OUT_APPLIED)
pause(1)
return value
}

export function test(context: farmTypes.Context, predicate: number, value: number): boolean {
if (!operationAllowed(context, predicate, value)) return false
if (!predicateAllowedForTask(context.task, predicate)) {
appendTrace(context, predicate, value, OUT_INVALID_VALUE)
pause(1)
return false
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Rage && predicate == farmTypes.Predicate.EnemyNearby) {
let answer = rageEnemyNearby(context)
if (answer) context.data[TD_PRED_TRUE] += 1
else context.data[TD_PRED_FALSE] += 1
appendTrace(context, predicate, value, answer ? OUT_APPLIED : OUT_STALE_TARGET)
pause(1)
return answer
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Prism && predicate == farmTypes.Predicate.Armored) {
let answer = prismArmored(context)
if (answer) context.data[TD_PRED_TRUE] += 1
else context.data[TD_PRED_FALSE] += 1
appendTrace(context, predicate, value, answer ? OUT_APPLIED : OUT_WRONG_BRANCH_VISIBLE)
pause(1)
return answer
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Healroot && predicate == farmTypes.Predicate.DamagedAlly) {
let answer = healrootDamagedAlly(context)
if (answer) context.data[TD_PRED_TRUE] += 1
else context.data[TD_PRED_FALSE] += 1
appendTrace(context, predicate, value, answer ? OUT_APPLIED : OUT_HEALTHY_NOOP)
pause(1)
return answer
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Rootsnare && predicate == farmTypes.Predicate.Trapped) {
let outcome = rootsnarePredicateOutcome(context, value)
let answer = outcome == OUT_APPLIED
if (answer) context.data[TD_PRED_TRUE] += 1
else context.data[TD_PRED_FALSE] += 1
appendTrace(context, predicate, value, outcome)
pause(1)
return answer
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Stormbloom && predicate == farmTypes.Predicate.Conductive) {
let target = enemyById(context.data[TD_TARGET_ID])
let valid = target != null && validDefenderEnemyTarget(target, false) && context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] == farmTypes.Action.Focus
let answer = valid && stormConductive(context)
if (answer) context.data[TD_PRED_TRUE] += 1
else context.data[TD_PRED_FALSE] += 1
appendTrace(context, predicate, value, valid ? OUT_APPLIED : OUT_NO_CURRENT_TARGET)
pause(1)
return answer
}
appendTrace(context, predicate, value, OUT_INVALID_VALUE)
pause(1)
return false
}

export function finish(context: farmTypes.Context): farmTypes.RunResult {
if (!context) return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Cancelled, "missing combat context")
if (context.cancelled || !contextIsCurrent(context)) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Cancelled, "combat context cancelled")
}
return evaluatePowerContext(context)
}

export function ready(area: number): boolean {
if (!entered || area != currentArea || area < 1 || area > 12) return false
if (raidActive) {
farmWorld.notice("A raid is already active.")
return false
}
if (previewActive || anyCombatRunnerBusy()) {
farmWorld.notice("Finish the current learner routine before Ready.")
return false
}
let progress = farmWorld.progress()
if (!isPrepPhase(progress, area)) {
farmWorld.notice("Finish this area's farm work before Ready.")
return false
}
if (!allRouteCropPrioritiesValid()) {
farmWorld.notice("This area's raid routes need authored crop priorities.")
return false
}

// A1 uses actual watered starter crops plus the hero sword. farmTasks.ready
// owns preparation; Combat contributes no placed power defender requirement.
if (area == 1) return true

let cap = defenderCapForArea(area)
if (placementCount(progress, area) > cap) {
farmWorld.notice("Too many defenders are staged for this area.")
return false
}

let requiredCrop = requiredDefenderCrop(area)
if (!powerEarned(progress, requiredCrop)) {
farmWorld.notice("A at the " + cropDisplayName(requiredCrop) + " practice pad before Ready.")
return false
}
if (placementCropCount(progress, area, requiredCrop) < 1) {
farmWorld.notice("Stage at least one " + cropDisplayName(requiredCrop) + ".")
return false
}

// A11 requires Lanternleaf plus an actual compatible energy-bearing ally.
// Only Sunbeam and Sporecap satisfy the companion requirement.
if (area == 11 && !compatibleEnergyCompanionPresent(progress, area)) {
farmWorld.notice("Stage Sunbeam or Sporecap with Lanternleaf.")
return false
}

// A12 uses Rootsnare in the raid, but the temporary Stormbloom projection
// must have completed successfully first. World owns the earned flag.
if (area == 12 && !powerEarned(progress, farmTypes.Crop.Stormbloom)) {
farmWorld.notice("Complete Stormbloom practice before Ready.")
return false
}
return true
}

export function preview(crop: number): boolean {
if (!entered || !validCrop(crop) || !activeLayout) return false
if (raidActive) {
farmWorld.notice("Power practice is unavailable during a raid.")
return false
}
if (previewActive) {
farmWorld.notice("Power practice is already running.")
return false
}
if (activeRunners.length > 0 || runnerQueue.length > 0 || farmProgram.busy(taskForCrop(crop))) {
farmWorld.notice("Finish the current learner routine first.")
return false
}

previewActive = true
previewCrop = crop
previewActorId = -1
previewEnemyIds = []
previewDefenderIds = []
previewStormTargetIds = []
previewElapsedMs = 0
previewCleanupMs = -1
previewExitEnemyId = -1
previewExitAtMs = -1
previewExitTile = -1

let pad = practicePadForCrop(crop)
if (!setupPreviewScene(crop, pad) || previewActorId < 0) {
clearPreviewScene()
farmWorld.notice("This area's practice layout is incomplete.")
return false
}

let progress = farmWorld.progress()
let primary = capturedUpgradeValue(progress, upgradeIdForCrop(crop))
let secondary = capturedUpgradeValue(progress, secondaryUpgradeIdForCrop(crop))
farmWorld.notice(previewAnatomyMessage(crop, primary, secondary))

// This always invokes the student's currently registered callback. Missing
// code returns Missing through farmProgram; wrong code leaves its visible
// physical consequences and evaluates Wrong. No accepted trace is cached or
// substituted on later practice/raid invocations.
if (!enqueuePowerRun(crop, previewActorId, farmTypes.Mode.Preview)) {
clearPreviewScene()
farmWorld.notice("Could not start power practice.")
return false
}
return true
}
}
